title: Yeh Fitoor Tera
summary: Yeh Fitoor Tera (transl. This Obsession Of Yours) is an Indian Hindi-language television drama series that premiered on 5 August 2026 on Star Plus and streames digitally on JioHotstar. Produced by Ved Raj under Story Square Productions, the series stars Debchandrima Singha Roy and Ishaan Dhawan.
plot: A reclusive girl named Saumya who finds the courage to reclaim her life as she adjust to co-ed college life, after meeting Jeet, a free-spirited rebel. Their passionate love story unfolds against the backdrop of Prayagraj.

title: Yakshini
summary:
Yakshini is an Indian Telugu-language fantasy romantic thriller television series directed by Teja Marni and written by Ram Vamsi Krishna. Produced by Shobu Yarlagadda and Prasad Devineni through Arka Media Works, it stars Vedhika, Rahul Vijay, Lakshmi Manchu and Ajay in important roles. 
It was released on 14 June 2024 on Disney+ Hotstar.
reception: Akhila Menon of OTTPlay gave a rating of 2 out of 5 and stated that it "is a complete yawn fest that fails to create any impact". 123Telugu opined that the plot needs a more gripping narration to keep the proceedings interesting. Eenadu is critical about screenplay and story.

title: Yashomati Maiyaa Ke Nandlala
summary: Yashomati Maiyaa Ke Nandlala is an Indian Hindi-language drama series produced by Contiloe Entertainment. It stars Neha Sargam, Rahul Sharma and Hitanshu Jinsi in lead roles and premiered on 13 June 2022 and ended its run on 2 December 2022 on Sony TV. It digitally streams on SonyLIV. The show suffered a time slot change from 9 PM to 8:30 PM in August 2022.
plot: The series is based on the childhood of Shri Krishna narrated in the Srimad Bhagavat Puranam. As the title, it depicts the affectionate relationship between mother and son in a tale based on the Bhagavata Puran.

title: Yeh Jhuki Jhuki Si Nazar
summary: Yeh Jhuki Jhuki Si Nazar is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series that premiered on 7 March 2022 on StarPlus. It stars Swati Rajput and Ankit Siwach. The series ended on 25 June 2022. It is the remake of Asianet's Malayalam series Karuthamuthu.
plot:
Diya Mathur, a topper in hotel management gets humiliated everywhere for her dark complexion. Being 32 years old she is not married as everyone rejects her for her complexion. Even though applying for front desk in her dream hotel, she was directed to the kitchen department due to her looks. Later she meets Armaan in a hotel, and he befriends her. Later Armaan's mother comes to Diya's house for alliance but instead of her chooses her younger sister Palki, who is fair-skinned and beautiful. Heartbroken Diya befriends Kajal Asthana in her workplace.
Diya and Armaan's constant meeting make them fall in love with each other. Armaan reveals his feelings to Krish, which Bhavna hears. Sudha and Bhavna plot and make Armaan misunderstand that Diya doesn't like him. Heartbroken, Armaan agrees for alliance with Palki.
On the engagement day, both families learn about Armaan and Diya's true feelings for each other. Sudha and Bhavna get tensed. On Palki's insistence that she doesn't love Armaan, Diya agrees for marriage with Armaan. Bhavna harms Diya's legs during the Haldi function. Against all odds, Diya and Armaan get married. Sudha is revealed to be a dominating woman who wants to control the lives of her family members. Though Sudha tries to adjust with Diya, Bhavna instigates her mind against the other. Sudha falls to Bhavna's words and tries to show Diya her place keeping her control superior over others. Armaan who is somewhat aware of Sudha's this behavior tries to balance situations for her. After marriage, Diya gets Armaan meet her friend Kajal who is revealed to Armaan's ex-wife who cheated on him.

title: Yeh Kaali Kaali Ankhein
summary: Yeh Kaali Kaali Ankhein (transl. These Black Black Eyes) is an Indian Hindi-language romantic crime thriller television series on Netflix created and directed by Sidharth Sengupta. The series stars Tahir Raj Bhasin, Shweta Tripathi and Anchal Singh in the lead roles with Saurabh Shukla, Surya Sharma, Arunoday Singh and Brijendra Kala playing supporting roles. The title of the series is derived from a song of the same name from the 1993 film Baazigar.

articleSections.text:
Yeh Kaali Kaali Ankhein was released on Netflix on 14 January 2022.
The second season of the show was released on Netflix on 22 November 2024.

title: Yeu Kashi Tashi Me Nandayla
summary: Yeu Kashi Tashi Me Nandayla (transl. How should I come to your house?) is an Indian Marathi language television series which aired on Zee Marathi. It starred Anvita Phaltankar and Shalva Kinjavadekar, with Shubhangi Gokhale, Nikhil Raut, Aditi Sarangdhar in supporting roles. It premiered from 4 January 2021 by replacing Tujhyat Jeev Rangala. It is produced by Tejendra Neswankar under the banner of Trrump Carrd Production.
plot: The story revolves around a middle-class girl, Avani (Sweetu), who gets hired for a job in Mumbai. Her mother Nalu asks her to stay with her mother's childhood friend, Shaku, to reduce the time needed to reach her new workplace. During their visit, Sweetu is introduced to Shaku's son Omkar. The plot then focuses on the love story between Sweetu and Omkar, and their conflict with Omkar's elder sister Malvika, who despises Sweetu and her mother due to their poor financial status.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Anvita Phaltankar as Avani Vasant Salvi / Avani Omkar Khanvilkar (Sweetu); Omkar's wife * Shalva Kinjawadekar as Onkar Khanvilkar (Om); Sweetu's husband

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text: The show is produced by Trrump Carrd Production. The show is written by Kiran Kulkarni.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text: The series is primarily filmed in Mumbai and Thane. On 13 April 2021, Chief Minister of Maharashtra Uddhav Thackeray announced a sudden curfew due to increased COVID-19 cases and production was suspended on 14 April 2021. The production location was temporarily moved to Daman. In early June 2021, the Government of Maharashtra allowed shooting within the state given certain restrictions. The cast and crew returned to Mumbai on 20 June 2021 and resumed filming.

title: Your Honor
summary:
Your Honor is an Indian thriller drama streaming television series, directed by Eeshwar Nivas, under the production house Applause Entertainment. The series stars Jimmy Shergill, Pulkit Makol, Mita Vashisht, Yashpal Sharma and Parul Gulati in the main roles. Despite its name being similar to the American adaptation, the series is adaptated from Israeli TV series Kvodo (Hebrew: כבודו). The story follows a judge who lets go of his moralities, relationships and goes on to undermine ethics in order to save his son. The series was released on June 18, 2020, on the Indian OTT platform of SonyLIV.
The second season of Your Honor was released on November 19, 2021. Gulshan Grover and Mahie Gill were the new major additions to the show.
plot:
;Season 1
The story of the series revolves around Bishan Khosla and his son. Bishan's son Abeer gets caught in a hit and run case. The boy who is hit in this case by Abeer is the son of the city gangster. Bishan Khosla sacrifices relationships and subverts the law to save his son from a vengeful gangster. The series portrays how even the pinnacle of law breaks in order to save their family.
;Season 2
After Judge Bishan Khosla shot Satnam Mudki, he finds himself in serious trouble, not only with the Mudki family but also the Tarn Taran mafia and Pandit gang that understands the importance of having a High Court Judge in its pocket.
reception:
Saibal Chatterjee from NDTV praised the performances of the cast stating "Mita Vashisht is brilliant. Varun Badola stands tall in the guise of a family man forced by circumstances to stoop low". Jyoti Kanyal from India Today expressed in her review on the series as a gripping tale of lies and manipulations. Arushi Jain from The Indian Express shared her first impressions on the series stating "The climax of every episode leaves you at the edge-of-your-seat, and the thrills keep coming as the episodes pass". Nandini Ramnath from Scroll.in explained and stated how the series depicts that the family comes before law.
Archika Khurana of The Times of India rated season 2 3.5/5 and stated "Your Honor will leave you at the point where you would want to know what will happen next. Most importantly, if you like the first season, this one is a perfect follow-up with some riveting performances."
Saibal Chatterjee from NDTV gave the second season, 3 stars out of 5 and stated "Your Honor Season 2 is the sort of web series that is easy to recommend - it is riveting all way."

episodesList.title: The Fall Guy
episodesList.summary: Bishan Khosla, who is likely to become a high court judge in Ludhiana, deals with a messy situation with the help of Kaashi, a deputy commander in CRPF, resulting from the accident involving his son and the son of a drug cartel, Mudkis.

episodesList.title: Protege
episodesList.summary: Bishan convinces Ruma not to leave Guddan's case as he is afraid Guddan might spill his name out, while Kiran continues the investigation after realizing the paint on Satnam's bike matches the colour of the car involved in the accident.

episodesList.title: Few Loose Ends
episodesList.summary: Kiran continues her interrogation with Guddan, but he refuses to reveal anything about Bishan, and Bishan lies about the stolen car to Kaashi who is enraged because Guddan continues to be in police remand for a week.

episodesList.title: Alibi
episodesList.summary: Ruma meets Shibbu Pandey who stole a lancer car with Guddan while Bishan's car was stolen, and Harman decides to carry out an acid attack at a Bhaiyya in jail when he gets to know about the involvement of a Bhaiyaa in the case.

episodesList.title: An Eye For An Eye
episodesList.summary: Pandit takes revenge for the acid attack by killing Harman's henchman, following which Bishan, after realizing Ruma wants to leave the case, goes to her house to convince her not to do that and finds her intoxicated there.

episodesList.title: Sacrificial Lamb
episodesList.summary: Ruma manages to get Guddan out of jail as he promises to reveal the name of the person involved in the accident, in return of protection, and Kaashi takes him under his custody. But Bishan plans a move that leads to something unexpected.

episodesList.title: Cause and Effect
episodesList.summary: As police start investigating Guddan's murder, Bishan continues telling Gursheel and Ruma lies in order to prevent them from finding out bitter truths regarding the case, following which Abeer decides to meet Satnam at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Deeper Waters
episodesList.summary: Harnam fails to catch the guy who paid Satnam a visit at the hospital, following which Satnam comes out of the coma, and Bishan records the meeting between Kiran and Harman regarding the toy car Kiran receives as a gift.

episodesList.title: The Downward Spiral
episodesList.summary: Bishan gets to know about the bomb attached to Kaashi's car from Kaashi while he is lying, wounded, in Bishan's house, and decides to pay Pandit a visit at his house. Indu moves Kaashi from his house to another place.

episodesList.title: All Out In The Open
episodesList.summary: Harnam and Pandit, after finding out that Bishan's son was involved in the car accident, make things better between each other, and Kiran is released from the jail, following which she enquires about the toy car she got as a gift.

episodesList.title: The Noose Tightens
episodesList.summary: Bishan decides to leave for London with Abeer after he is informed by Ruma that Kiran has proof of his involvement in the accident. But Indu meets Bishan to seek his help in finding Kaashi, and together, they meet Pandit alone.

episodesList.title: The Last Straw
episodesList.summary: Bishan decides to negotiate with Harman Mudki by promising him a favour once he becomes the High Court judge. When Bishan meets Abeer in jail later, Abeer's confession stuns him and compels him to take a decision to end this mayhem.

episodesList.title: That Open Wound
episodesList.summary: Post Satnam Mudki’s death the Mudkis are enraged. Bishan is cornered by a new crime gang of Ludhiana and is forced to pay a price to keep Abeer safe in jail. Indu gets abducted by Pandit’s brother, Jagda.

episodesList.title: The New Knight
episodesList.summary: Jagda assures his sister-in-law, Latika, of his brother’s revenge. Post Abeer being attacked in jail, Bishan is torn between a choice to save Abeer or Indu. Indu faces the consequences of Bishan’s judgement.

episodesList.title: The Black Sheep
episodesList.summary: The city erupts in riots due to Bishan’s judgement. Kiran is summoned by the DCP to join the force back. Bishan forewarns Yashpreet about the raid. An enraged Jagda decides to teach Bishan a lesson.

episodesList.title: Cat and Mouse
episodesList.summary: Harman gains a favour from Bishan. Bishan suspects that Jagda wanted him killed and gets him arrested. Bishan pulls a masterstroke and puts an end to Kiran tailing him like a hawk.

episodesList.title: Down the Rabbit Hole
episodesList.summary: DCP asks Kiran to back off from Bishan. Abeer lands up peddling drugs in jail with the help of Mahi and a liking brews. The Mudkis hatch a plan to get to Abeer as they are unable to get a hold on Bishan.

episodesList.title: A Deal With the Devil
episodesList.summary: Harman manipulates Abeer to go against his father. A restless Bishan tries to reach out to Abeer. Indu discovers a devious side of Jagda.

episodesList.title: The Calm Before the Storm
episodesList.summary: Jagda goes into hiding post Latika's death. Gurjot assures Bishan that he will get his son back from Harman. Abeer finally reaches out to Bishan but it backfires.

episodesList.title: The Whistle Blowers
episodesList.summary: Yahspreet joins hands with Kiran. Khaini double crosses Jagda. Harman makes Abeer confess. Bishan decides on a plan to get rid off the crime gangs in Ludhiana.

episodesList.title: The Grand Plan
episodesList.summary: Bishan and Indu entice Yashpreet by showing her the drug. Gurjot plays the waiting game with Bishan. Kiran gets Yashpreet to speak to Bishan to crack him. An unfortunate incident with Mahi leaves Abeer shocked.

episodesList.title: Checkmate
episodesList.summary: Bishan conducts a sting operation by colluding with the police to catch the crime gangs of Ludhiana red handed. In return he is guaranteed a clean chit for Abeer from the cops, but all doesn’t go as per plan.

title: Yeh Hai Chahatein
summary: Yeh Hai Chahatein (transl. This Is Desire) is an Indian Hindi-language drama television series produced by Ekta Kapoor for Star Plus. It streams on Disney+ Hotstar and is a spin-off of Yeh Hai Mohabbatein. The show aired from 19 December 2019 to 18 September 2024. One of the longest running Indian television soap opera, the series starred Sargun Kaur Luthra, Abrar Qazi, Shagun Sharma and Pravisht Mishra as the leads over two generations.
plot:
A passionate love story unfolds between a famous rock star, Rudraksh Khurana, and a gynaecologist, Dr. Preesha Srinivasan, who fall in love after raising their respective siblings' son together. They die promising one another that they will always remain soulmates and reunite in every lifetime.
Twenty years later, destiny brings together a reserved physiotherapist, Dr. Nayantara, and a famous rock star, Samrat.
After another twenty years, destiny offers Nayantara and Samrat a second chance at love. Their daughter, Kaashvi, is in love with her childhood friend Arjun, who in turn loves Mahima, leading to a complicated love triangle. Circumstances force Kaashvi to marry Arjun, and he eventually falls in love with her after realising the true meaning of love, but insecurities jeopardise their marriage.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Sargun Kaur Luthra as ** Dr. Preesha Khurana (née Srinivasan) (2019–2022) ** Dr. Nayantara "Nayan" Choudhary (née Iyer) (2022–2023) * Abrar Qazi as ** Rudraksh "Rudra" Khurana (2019–2022) ** Samrat "Sam" Choudhary (2022–2023) ** Bhuvan Garg (2021) * Shagun Sharma as IAS Kashvi "Kashu" Bajwa (née Sabharwal) (2023–2024) * Pravisht Mishra as IAS Arjun Bajwa (2023–2024)

articleSections.title: Guests
articleSections.text: Divyanka Tripathi as Dr. Ishita Bhalla from Yeh Hai Mohabbatein (2019) * Karan Patel as Raman Bhalla from Yeh Hai Mohabbatein (2019) * Abhishek Verma as Yug Sharma from Yeh Hai Mohabbatein * Sunny Kaushal as Sunny to promote his film Shiddat (2021) * Ashwini Kalsekar as Commissioner Deepali Handa from Rudra: The Edge of Darkness (2022) * Swati Rajput as Diya Mathur from Yeh Jhuki Jhuki Si Nazar (2022) * Neetha Shetty as Mayuri Ahuja (2022)

articleSections.title: Development and premiere
articleSections.text:
In June 2017, producer Ekta Kapoor revealed her plan for a spin-off of Yeh Hai Mohabbatein however stated, "I wanted to make a spin off of Yeh Hai Mohabbatein but it's not working out with the story line." The reports of the spin-off in making was then announced in April 2018. It was supposed to premiere in the same year but was delayed as the story was not finalized. Then, it was reported to premiere in June 2019 and the casting for it was going on while Aakanksha Singh and Karan Vohra were reported as the leads. In September 2019, the series was revived and fresh casting sessions began. Sargun Kaur Luthra was cast as Dr. Preesha Srinivasan and Abrar Qazi was cast as Rudraksh Khurana.
Talking about the series, producer Ekta Kapoor said "Yeh Hai Chahatein deals with another social issue. It's often said that it's easier for men with children to get married again, but very tough for a woman with a child to find a suitable groom."

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: The first promo of the series was released on 27 November 2019 where Sargun Kaur Luthra and Vidhaan Sharma were introduced by Divyanka Tripathi and Karan Patel as Dr. Preesha Srinivasan and Saransh Khurana. The next promo was released on 16 December 2019 featuring Abrar Qazi, Luthra and Vidhaan Sharma. The series premiered on 19 December 2019 on StarPlus.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Sargun Kaur Luthra was selected to play Dr. Preesha Srinivasan's character. Karan Wahi was approached to play Rudraksh Khurana, but Abrar Qazi was signed by the production team. Zebby Singh was potentially going to play Yuvraj Pillai before the role went to Siddharth Shivpuri. Parul Chauhan was supposed to play Ahana, but Aishwarya Sakhuja replaced her. When the shooting resumed after the COVID-19 outbreak, in early July 2020, Vidhaan Sharma was replaced by Yagya Bhasin as Saaransh and Gulshan Pandey replaced Vijay Kashyap as Gopal.
Luthra stated that she took inspiration from Neena Gupta for her role. Talking about playing a mother for the first time, she said, "When I was told that I will be playing a mother, I wasn't apprehensive at all. My only worry was that i am very young and I had to look mature on the screen which was a challenge. The team has helped me a lot to help me look a certain age and moreover with my body language to portray this character. Even Vidhaan (my on-screen son), has helped bring out the best in me. More than mother-son, we are like friends off the screen."
Sakhuja was hired to portray Ahana, her first negative role. Speaking about it she said, "I have auditioned for a lot of Balaji shows and whenever I auditioned for negative roles I was told I look very positive. So, when I bagged this role, I asked them why now? They said eventually you will get to know as to why we have chosen you, and I understand because they like to surprise their audience and that's exactly what they are doing. I was figuring how to go about it, but my team is helping. After every two sentences out of habit, I go into the positive zone but I have people to handhold me and help me."
In May 2021 Mister Supranational India Altamash Faraz was cast as Armaan Thakur.
In December 2021, the show took a leap of 5 years, after Preesha claimed the death of Vicky and arrested.after the leap she gave birth to a spunky girl, Ruhi and raise her as a single mother whereas Ruhi plays as a matchmaker for Rudraksh and Preesha.
In December 2022, the narrative underwent its first 20-year leap, Dr Nayanthara and Rockstar Samrat, re-incarnation of Preesha and Rudraksh, again played by Luthra and Qazi respectively whereas Samrat is seen having a funky look with long hair, really doesn't care about the love from his fans. On the other hand, Nayantara is a loner, knows how to embrace the same with confidence, who is a dark skinned girl and has a mole on her face with a tight braid.
In July 2023, After the second 20-year leap implemented, Sargun Kaur Luthra and Abrar Qazi, who had portrayed the leads roles for two generations, eventually exited the series, making way for the new generation characters, Kashvi and Arjun portrayed by Shagun Sharma and Pravisht Mishra respectively.
In November 2023, the show again took a leap of 5 years, whereas a young boy is caught stealing from a store, prompting the security guard to consider reporting the incident to higher authorities. Kashvi intervenes, claiming the boy as hers. Kashvi takes the opportunity to educate the boy about the consequences of stealing and advises him against it. Later, as the boy spots his father, it is unveiled that Arjun is the father, leaving Kashvi visibly surprised as she turns to see him.

articleSections.title: Filming
articleSections.text:
Set in Delhi, the series is mainly filmed in Film City, Mumbai. On 3 August 2020, heavy rains caused the shoot to be cancelled.
On 13 April 2021, Chief Minister Uddhav Thackeray announced a sudden curfew effective from 15 April. On 14 April, Ekta Kapoor and Balaji Telefilms decided to move all their shows' shooting to their sets at Goa.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak in India. The series was expected to resume on 1 April 2020 but could not and the series was last broadcast on 24 March 2020 airing its remaining episodes. After three months, the filming of the series resumed on 27 June 2020 while the broadcast resumed on 13 July 2020.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text:
Yeh Hai Chahatein maintained a consistent viewership profile on StarPlus, establishing a distinct audience footprint separate from its parent series, Yeh Hai Mohabbatein. The series premiered on December 19, 2019, with an initial TRP of 1.8. Over its first year of broadcasting, the show regularly placing within the top five most-watched Hindi daily fiction programs nationwide. Fans praised the on-screen chemistry between the leads Rudraksh (Abrar) and Pressha (Sargun), popularly called as "RuSha".
Viewership peaked between late 2021 and early 2022 during the narrative arc involving the central characters' memory loss and subsequent remarriage plots, reaching an all-time high weekly average of 3.1 TRP. During this phase, the program frequently ranked directly behind the network's top-rated soap operas, Anupamaa and Ghum Hai Kisikey Pyaar Meiin. To extend the run of the daily soap, a 20-year generation leap was introduced in late 2022. This narrative transition initially stabilized the show's ratings at a 2.2 TRP average. in February 2022, the series got a TRP of 2.7 at fifth place; in April, the show secured third position in BARC chart and in December, the show placed at fourth rank with 2.1 TVR. However, following the departure of the original lead actors, Abrar Qazi and Sargun Kaur Luthra in mid-2023, the series experienced gradual audience fatigue, with ratings dropping to a 1.4 TRP.
Subsequent timeline jumps and cast adjustments failed to reverse the downward trend. By mid-2024, the network shifted the series out of its primary prime-time lineup into a late-night 11:00 p.m. time slot, where it registered a low rating of 1.0. Due to the sustained decline in performance metrics, the network and production house concluded the show after a successful run of 5 years of 1400+ episodes.. The final episode broadcast in late 2024, registering a closing finale rating of 1.1 TRP.

articleSections.title: ''Ravivaar With Star Parivaar'' (2022)

plotHtml:
A passionate love story unfolds between a famous rock star, Rudraksh Khurana, and a gynaecologist, Dr. Preesha Srinivasan, who fall in love after raising their respective siblings' son together. They die promising one another that they will always remain soulmates and reunite in every lifetime.
Twenty years later, destiny brings together a reserved physiotherapist, Dr. Nayantara, and a famous rock star, Samrat.
After another twenty years, destiny offers Nayantara and Samrat a second chance at love. Their daughter, Kaashvi, is in love with her childhood friend Arjun, who in turn loves Mahima, leading to a complicated love triangle. Circumstances force Kaashvi to marry Arjun, and he eventually falls in love with her after realising the true meaning of love, but insecurities jeopardise their marriage.

title: Yeh Dil Mera
summary:
Yeh Dil Mera (Urdu: یہ دل میرا, lit. 'This heart of mine') is a 2019 Pakistani romantic thriller television series that premiered on Hum TV on 30 October 2019. It is directed by Aehsun Talish, written by Farhat Ishtiaq and produced by Momina Duraid under their banner MD Productions. The serial stars Ahad Raza Mir, Sajal Ali and Adnan Siddiqui in lead roles.
The series highlights mental health issues in both the lead characters of Noor ul Ain and Amaan Ullah respectively, Sajal Ali and Ahad.
The series received mostly positive reviews, with critics praising its plot, acting performances, and chemistry of the lead couple, but was critical of the pacing issues and poor direction.
plot:
Noor-ul-Ain Zaman, known as **Aina** (Sajal Aly), is the only daughter of influential businessman **Mir Farooq Zaman** (Adnan Siddiqui). Haunted by recurring nightmares and frequent panic attacks, Aina seeks treatment from psychiatrist **Dr. Arsalan**, but her condition does not improve. After losing her mother, **Neelofer**, in childhood, she is raised by her caretaker, **Nargis Bua**.
At the wedding of Saqib, the son of Farooq's close friend Ghauri, Aina meets the mysterious and charismatic **Amaanullah Khan (Amaan)** (Ahad Raza Mir). Although they have never met as adults, Amaan knows intimate details about Aina's life and past. While Aina interns at Amaan's company, the two grow close, and Amaan eventually proposes marriage. Meanwhile, it is revealed that Farooq has secretly kept a second wife, **Sahira**, hidden from the world.
Behind Amaan's affection lies a hidden motive. Years earlier, Farooq murdered Amaan's parents, **Humaira** and **Ubaidullah**, along with his sister. Determined to avenge his family's deaths, Amaan uses Ghauri's family to gain access to Farooq and Aina. He also joins forces with Sahira, who has long suffered abuse at Farooq's hands and wishes to expose his secret marriage and bring him to justice.
Amaan unexpectedly calls off the wedding and leaves for the UK, only to return later and marry Aina after she pleads with him. During the wedding festivities, Aina's maternal aunt **Farhana** arrives and becomes suspicious about Neelofer's death after Amaan questions her. She begins investigating the truth.
After the marriage, Amaan becomes distant and hostile toward Aina, straining their relationship. Although they eventually reconcile, they travel to **Daryabagh** for their honeymoon, where unsettling events begin to unfold.
Daryabagh holds painful memories from the past. As children, Amaan and Aina first met there. Their mothers, Humaira and Neelofer, were close friends. Farooq, who had been Humaira's college classmate, had once proposed to her, but she rejected him and married Ubaidullah. Obsessed with Humaira, Farooq repeatedly pursued her and eventually attempted to assault her. When she resisted, Farooq, aided by his loyal assistant **Ali Baksh**, murdered Humaira, Ubaidullah, and their daughter while they were on a family outing. Young Amaan survived the attack and was secretly sent to London by his family servant, **Abdul Rehman**, to live with his uncle **Abdullah**.
During the honeymoon in Daryabagh, Aina experiences disturbing hallucinations, hears mysterious voices, and begins seeing strange figures, leading her to believe the place is haunted or hiding a dark secret. Amaan dismisses her fears as delusions. At the same time, Farooq orders Ali Baksh to murder Sahira after suspecting that she has betrayed him.
After returning home, Amaan's increasingly suspicious behavior prompts Aina to investigate his past. He finally reveals the truth—that Farooq murdered his family and that his marriage to Aina was part of his plan for revenge. Shocked and heartbroken, Aina refuses to believe the accusations against her father and struggles to accept that Amaan manipulated her for his own purpose. Although their marriage becomes strained, they continue living together. Aina resolves to prove Farooq's innocence, while Farooq discovers that Amaan is the son of the family he destroyed.
Amaan and Aina return to Daryabagh, each driven by different goals—Amaan seeks revenge, while Aina searches for evidence to clear her father's name. As Aina investigates her family's old summer house, suppressed childhood memories resurface. She finally discovers the horrifying truth: Neelofer had learned about Farooq's attempted assault on Humaira and his murder of Amaan's family. While trying to escape with young Aina, Neelofer was murdered by Ali Baksh on Farooq's orders.
Meanwhile, Farhana and Nargis Bua arrive in Daryabagh after learning the truth. Farooq and Ali Baksh also reach the estate after Amaan reveals his identity and location. In a tense confrontation, Aina points a gun at herself and forces Farooq to confess all his crimes. Overcome with guilt, Farooq orders Ali Baksh to shoot him. After killing Farooq, Ali Baksh takes his own life.
One month later, Aina separates from Amaan without divorcing him. She closes her father's business empire and uses its wealth to establish a school for underprivileged children in Daryabagh. Amaan dedicates his life to serving an orphanage, burdened by remorse for the pain he caused. Although he sincerely regrets his actions, Aina cannot forgive him. They part ways, still deeply in love but unable to reunite. The story ends with both longing for each other, carrying the weight of love, loss, and loneliness.

articleSections.title: Production
articleSections.text:
The show was earlier titled Mujhay Vida Kar but later changed.
The writer, Farhat Ishtiaq said that Yeh Dil Mera was supposed to be a novel; 300 pages in she faced a writer's block so she left it incomplete. In 2017, she intended to finish the novel alongside the drama adaptation but scared of the comparison, she decided to leave the novel for later.
The drama highlights childhood trauma and mental health issues.
The production location of the serial Darya Baagh is a fictional place, the shooting was actually done in Shogran, situated between Kaghan valley and Neelum Valley.

articleSections.title: Critical reception
articleSections.text: The series received positive reviews for its haunting theme and performances of the lead couple. Sadaf Haider of DAWN Images, in her review of the first two episodes, praised the performances of the lead pair and the strong plot of Farhat Ishtiaq's script. A reviewer from Daily Times lauded the story of the serial stating, "It wasn’t only mysterious but also a show that heavily focuses on the theme of Mental Health, a subject that is spoken very briefly about and sometimes also ignored." Maliha Rehman of Dawn was appreciative of the Aly and Raza Mir's chemistry, writing "There are many scenes that are remarkable, in which revenge battles with love, confusion creates doubts, and the past threatens to tarnish the lead pair’s romance.", but was critical of bad direction. Sarah Hameed of The News International lauded the portrayal of mental health issues in the whole series but criticised its trivialising in the last episode.

articleSections.title: Controversy
articleSections.text: After the release of teasers of the show, the show was heavily criticised for the publicity of sexual harassment in the work place as a romantic genre, to which Farhat Ishtiaq replied that by watching the teaser of just 30 seconds, the whole story of the show cannot be predicted. Viewers will see that why she (Aina) went for the job interview with such a heavy makeup. It may be that both characters know each other already.

title: Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka!
summary: Yehh Jaadu Hai Jinn Ka! (transl.This Magic Is of the Jinn!) (international title: A Magical Love Story) is an Indian fantasy drama television series that aired from 14 October 2019 to 14 November 2020 on Star Plus. Produced by Gul Khan and Karishma Jain, it starred Vikram Singh Chauhan and Aditi Sharma as leads.
plot:
Aman Khan and Roshni Ahmed are described to be opposites but have the same goal. Their lives are connected through fate and magic.
Aman Khan is a Nawab who is cursed by the Dark Shadow of a Djinn. Roshni, the daughter of a Tawaif, is an Ayaana (A girl with the heart of an angel). Aman's family wants him to marry an Ayaana, they arrange his marriage with a girl named Ada, whom they are mistaken to be an Ayaana. During every test that they conduct to find out who is Ayaana, Roshni and Ada are both present at the same place. This leads to a case of mistaken identities making Ada the Ayaana who passes the tests when, in reality, it is Roshni who did. Parveen's (Aman's mother) life falls in danger because of the Jinn's magic and can be protected only if Aman marries an Ayaana thus revealing that Ada is not an Ayaana. Salma (Roshni's adoptive mother) pretends to be sick, forcing Roshni to marry Aman for money. Aman misunderstands Roshni to be a woman with ill intentions who will do anything for money. He detests her and gives her a cheque for marrying him. Aman and Roshni marry.
Roshni feels a connection with Aman but is hurt by his rude behaviour towards her owing to the misunderstanding that occurred. Later she falls in love with Aman, but he continues to dislike and insult her. Because of some misconceptions, Aman throws her out of his house and his life. Aman's brother, Kabir Khan, makes his entry. He tries to kill Aman, but to save Aman, Roshni takes the arrows herself and dies. Aman realizes his deep love for Roshni after her death and is left heartbroken and guilty for always misunderstanding her.
Kabir brings Roshni back to life but keeps her under his control, aiming to separate her from Aman. He erases all her memories with Aman. Kabir's hold on Roshni is destroyed when Aman stabs her with a magical dagger. Then Roshni regains her memory. Parveen is revealed to be evil who wants to use her sons to become the queen of jinns. Parveen kills Kabir but cannot kill Aman. Aman unintentionally touches a mighty sword and becomes 'Jinnat ka Badshah', the new most potent in the dark world. Aman and Roshni enjoy their life together.
Aliya, Aman's ex-girlfriend, returns with a baby and tries to separate Aman and Roshni. The baby is revealed to be Kabir's, and Aliya is revealed to be an Evil ayaana. Parveen tries to sacrifice the baby to regain her lost powers, but Aman saves the child with Roshni's help. Roshni tries to expose Aliya but fails. Aliya attacks Parveen resulting in Parveen going into a coma. Aman, believing it is Roshni's fault throw her out of the house.

articleSections.title: 1 year later
articleSections.text: Roshni opens a bakery while Aman is worried about Parveen's decreased health conditions. Despite their differences, Aman and Roshni again become close. Kabir returns. Aman gets stabbed while saving Roshni and becomes physically and emotionally weak. His genuine feelings for Roshni come out. In that intoxicated form only, they consummate their marriage after a year. Kabir makes Aman and Roshni break the Laal Chand, which annoys the Red Moon Princess, Laila. Laila had a twin sister Chandni who is good. Kabir joins hands with Laila and helps her seek revenge against Aman and Roshni. Chandni helps Aman by giving clues that Roshni is pregnant with twins which Roshni don't know. Chandni saves Aman's family from Laila's evil intentions. Later, Roshni stabs Laila to death. Before dying, Laila curses Roshni that she will die before the next moonrise. Aman races against time and succeeds in saving Roshni but temporarily.

articleSections.title: (Season 2)
articleSections.text:
The red moon soldier attacks Roshni, and she loses one of her unborn child and Aman. But the family thinks that the loss is of two babies. However, Roshni fights destiny and brings back Aman. She meets Aman's maternal cousin, Rehan Khan, a jinn, to help her in this war. After a failed attempt, she strikes a deal with Kala Jinn to give her firstborn child instead of Aman's life. Roshni hides this from Aman and the family till she finds a solution. Soon Roshni find that she is pregnant with twins and one baby is alive and another baby dies in a red moon soldier attack.
Here Rubina's niece Shayari appears. While Rehan, Aman's maternal cousin, finds trouble being targeted by a Jinn Shikari, unaware that it was his girlfriend, Natasha. He suspected Shayari, who was later revealed to be another Jinn Shikari but not a danger for Rehan. Rehan wanted to find his brother and decided to get engaged with Natasha. He accidentally gets engaged with Shayari, who became furious after this but agreed to help them after Aman requested her. To save her child, Roshni decided to surrogate it to a girl with Rubina, But Roshni changes her decision as Kala Jinn threatens her to kill Aman if she breaks her promise. Aman captures Kala Jinn for their child's safety. Roshni helps Aman do the task but later releases Kala Jinn from captivity to keep her promise. Aman finds this out and tricks Roshni to make her reveal the truth. After learning the truth, Aman was heartbroken. Roshni leaves Junaid Manzil to make him feel better, but he brings Roshni back.
Meanwhile, Rehan takes an arrow on his chest to save Shayari, saving her life from the deadly attack. Later on, Shayari's truth is revealed, and a furious Rehan breaks their engagement.
Ayana, the ancient warrior princess, comes to help Roshni save her child. She helps them trick Kala Jinn by giving a fake child while Roshni safely delivers her baby in the Ayanaa Corner. After learning this, Kala Jinn imprisoned Roshni and Armaan (Aman and Roshni's baby) in a cave. Aman was successful in saving Roshni and Armaan, but Kala Jinn found out. Aman agreed to Kala Jinn that they would find his actual name to save Armaan. Kala Jinn told them they could find his name after completing the three tasks.
Rehan and Shayari also decide to help the khans and go on a mission to find Kaala Jinn's name. Kaala Jinn, to defeat the Khans, sends Aman and Roshni's first child (who was killed by the red moon's arrow) as the third challenge. However, the Khans win over the baby's spirit (lovingly called baby rooh) with their unconditional love for it. After receiving the three clues, Aman and Roshni find the name when Rehan and Shayari discovered that whoever takes Kala Jinn's name dies immediately. Kala Jinn comes to the mansion and asks them to tell them his name. Roshni bursts out his name to save her child, shocking everyone, but her first child's spirit held her. Kala Jinn does not accept failure and challenges them to fight him. It is revealed that Armaan, being the son of Jinnad Ke Badshah and Ayaana, will end Kaala Jinn. Roshni, Aman, Rehan, and Shayari go on a quest to end Kala Jinn, and Armaan finally kills the danger that troubled his family for many years. This quest brought Rehan and Shayari closer and reinforced their trust in each other.
Later, after several other incidents, it is revealed that Rubina "Tabeezi", was an Ayaana earlier and wants her Angelic-heart back from Roshni and that Natasha was involved with her. It is also revealed that Roshni is Rubina's elder brother, Mansoor Ahmed Choudhary's daughter, and is the original owner of Junaid Manzil and Rubina's niece.
Roshni was devastated to learn this and promised to give her heart to Rubina but made her promise that she wouldn't hurt her family before The Night of the Golden Sun. But Rubina continued trying to hurt her and her family. Meanwhile, Rehan and Shayari try to help the family by searching for the Ilm-e-Jinn book, which would solve their doubts. To get answers, Rehan has to concentrate on his doubts, but all he can concentrate is on Shayari. This makes Rehan realize that he's madly in love with her. On the other hand, Roshni decides not to give her heart to Rubina and refuses to keep her promise, making Rubina furious.
Roshni again becomes pregnant. On the other hand, Rehan and Shayari are kidnapped and held captive, and Shayari is suffocated. Rehan breaks down on seeing this. Later they manage to remain alive. Rehan is unable to confess his love, but Shayari understands.
On the night of the Golden Sun, Rubina traps the entire Khan family in danger. Rehan and Shayari save them using their powers. Aman and Roshni lose their powers but are protected by Armaan's powers. Finally, with the help of the magical ring given by Roshni's mother's soul to her, they defeat Rubina, and she is taken away by two other Ayaanas from Ayaana Kumbh.
While the Khan family celebrates with joy that now all the problems from their lives are gone, they can live happily. Shayari confesses her feelings for Rehan, and they hug each other. Aman asks Roshni where the angelic heart went. Roshni asks him not to think about it as now problems are over, and they can lead a simple and happy life forever. The Angelic-heart is revealed to be with Aman and Roshni's child, who is inside her womb.

articleSections.title: Main
articleSections.text: Vikram Singh Chauhan as Aman Junaid Khan: Jinnat ka Baadshah; Parveen and Junaid's son; Rubina's step son; Kabir's twin brother, Sara and Saima's elder brother; Farah's half-brother; Aaliya's ex fiancee; Roshni's husband; Armaan and Ayan's father (2019–2020) ** Aayan Aman Khan: Aman and Roshni's son; Armaan's twin brother (2020) *** Shaurya Shah as Child Aman Khan (2019; 2020) * Aditi Sharma as Roshni Aman Khan: An Ayaana; Mansoor's daughter; Salma's adopted daughter; Aman's wife; Armaan and Ayan's mother (2019–2020)

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
The show was launched at Pataudi Palace, becoming the first television show to be launched at the Pataudi Palace. It initially was titled as Raaz Mahal but later changed its title to Yehh Jadu Hai Jinn Ka. It was originally planned to be a weekend show. However, it was later aired through weekdays.
Saloni Daini, who played Farah Khan narrated the first few episodes and was the voiceover artist for the promos of the series. In September 2020, the series received extension till December 2020 but went off air in November 2020 due to low ratings.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text:
Actress Aditi Sharma was selected to play Roshni Ahmed's character. Leenesh Mattoo was first approached to play Aman Junaid Khan opposite Sharma, but was replaced by Vikram Singh Chauhan.
In December 2019, Arhaan Behll joined the cast as Kabir Junaid Khan. In March 2020, Surbhi Jyoti was cast as the Red moon princess Laila/Chandni for few episodes cameo. In June 2020, Shruti Sharma and Shehzada Dhami were cast as Shayari Choudhary and Rehan Ahmed Khan, respectively.
After the shootings of television shows resumed after lockdown in late June 2020, several actors of the show such as - Smita Bansal, Arhaan Behll, Saloni Daini, Aamir Salim Khan and child actor Ayansh Mishra had to exit the show as limited crew and cast members were allowed on shootings as per government guidelines.

articleSections.title: Broadcast
articleSections.text: The production and airing of the show was halted indefinitely in late March 2020 due to the COVID-19 outbreak in India. Because of the outbreak, the filming of television series and films was halted on 19 March 2020 and expected to resume on 1 April 2020 but could not and the series was last broadcast on 27 March 2020 when the remaining episodes were aired. The filming of the series resumed after more than three months in early July and the broadcast resumed on 27 July 2020.

articleSections.title: Cancellation
articleSections.text: After the ratings dropped, post the shootings and broadcasting of television shows resumed in India during July 2020 after COVID-19 lockdown, the producer decided to off-air the show in November 2020 cancelling its extension.

episodesList.title: Meet Aman, Roshni

episodesList.summary: While the truth about Jinn's quest for Aman is revealed, his family struggles to keep him safe. During the engagement ceremony, the Jinn appears at his doorstep.

episodesList.summary: Aman comes face-to-face with the Jinn during his engagement ceremony. While his family bonds together to help him, Roshni steps into the mansion.

episodesList.summary: Aman's unexpected decision shocks the family while Anjum plans a test to find out Ayaana. Later, Jinn attacks the bride, Adaa after entering the house.

episodesList.title: Aman Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Chotu tries to show Aman a vital clue during the latter's wedding to Adaa. While Roshni rebukes the insults made against Salma, Aman learns a startling truth.

episodesList.title: Raakh Jinn's Return
episodesList.summary: Raakh Jinn returns to Junaid Manzil after Adaa leaves the house. Later, Roshni gets ready for her engagement with Sameer while Salma does the unimaginable.

episodesList.title: Aman's Magical Secret
episodesList.summary: Aman is shocked to learn that Adaa is not an Ayaana and reveals a secret to his sisters and nephew. Later, he learns a surprising truth about Roshni.

episodesList.title: Roshni Enters Junaid Manzil
episodesList.summary: Roshni visits Junaid Manzil after Anjum requests Aman to call her. While a strange symbol forms on Parveen's hand, Aman learns a shocking truth about Roshni

episodesList.title: Aman in a Tight Spot
episodesList.summary: Parveen's deteriorating health condition scares Aman while the latter is assigned a serious task. Later, Aman faces trouble when he decides to bring Roshni home.

episodesList.title: Tabeezi Visits Junaid Manzil
episodesList.summary: Roshni is offended by Aman's remarks about Salma while Tabeezi gives the Khan family some distressing news. Later at Roshni's wedding, Aman learns the truth.

episodesList.title: Aman Gives Roshni an Ultimatum Episode 12
episodesList.summary: Aman uses the magical doorway to take Roshni away from her wedding and gives her an ultimatum. Meanwhile, Salma loses consciousness.

episodesList.title: Roshni to Marry Aman
episodesList.summary: Roshni agrees to marry Aman while the latter takes her to save Parveen. Later, she uses her power to rescue Parveen from the evil's trap.

episodesList.title: Aman Threatens Roshni
episodesList.summary: Parveen refuses to accept Roshni as her daughter-in-law. While Adaa makes a deal with Raakh Jinn, Aman threatens Roshni against leaving the house.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Aman regrets his behaviour after Anjum reveals the truth. While the Khan family prepares for Aman and Roshni's sangeet function, they share a romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Sangeet Ceremony
episodesList.summary: Anjum and Parveen are at loggerheads about Roshni while Adaa strikes a deal with the Jinn. At Aman and Roshni's Sangeet ceremony, he gets into a fight.

episodesList.title: Aman Shocks Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman loses his cool when he overhears a guest talking ill about Roshni. While Anjum meets Tabeezi, Roshni falls in trouble on approaching a chained Aman.

episodesList.title: Aman Attacks Roshni!
episodesList.summary: Roshni is severely injured when Aman strikes her in his monster form. Later, Aman is terrified on finding an unconscious Roshni.

episodesList.title: Roshni's Cute Demand
episodesList.summary: Roshni punishes Aman with her cute demands while the latter apologises to the family for his acts. Later, Aman and Roshni get romantic.

episodesList.title: Raakh Jinn's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Roshni and Aman's bond gets stronger while an enraged Raakh Jinn executes her devious plan. Later, the Raj Sipayi shoot arrows at an unarmed Roshni.

episodesList.title: Aman Is Devastated
episodesList.summary: A depressed Aman and Roshni, along with the family's help desperately try to bring Bazigar back to life. Later, Raakh Jinn and Adaa visit Salma at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Aman Takes Care of Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman tends to Roshni's needs personally. While Salma joins hands with Raakh Jinn, Aman is shocked after learning about the latter's lie.

episodesList.title: Roshni's Life at Stake
episodesList.summary: Roshni is disheartened by Aman's rude behaviour. Later, she runs away to save herself when Bunty chases her with a vengeful motive. Can Aman rescue Roshni?

episodesList.title: Roshni, Aman Fall in Trouble
episodesList.summary: Roshni falls for Raakh Jinn's deceit after she is trapped in the jungle with Aman. While Tabeezi tries to help Anjum and Baby, Aman's life hangs in the balance.

episodesList.title: Roshni Uses Her Powers!
episodesList.summary: Roshni uses her powers to save Aman while Raakh Jinn asks Adaa to do the unthinkable. After returning home, Aman's life falls in grave danger.

episodesList.title: Aman's Firm Decision
episodesList.summary: Roshni is thrown out of the house by Parveen while Aman's decision leaves the latter shocked. Later, Roshni is heartbroken upon learning the truth from Salma.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Magical Ride
episodesList.summary: Aman takes Roshni on a magical ride while Raakh Jinn sets a trap for her. After returning home, Aman and Roshni are surprised to find Adaa with Parveen.

episodesList.title: Aman Tells Roshni His Secret
episodesList.summary: Parveen and Anjum get into a heated argument. While Aman tells Roshni the truth about him, Raakh Jinn places a trap for her inside the house.

episodesList.title: Aman's Strict Condition
episodesList.summary: Saima gets emotional after hearing Aman's condition for her marriage. Later, Roshni gets curious when a strange voice calls out her name.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Aman tells Parveen that Roshni will be staying with the Khans for a month. Later, celebrations begin for Saima, Aftab and Aman, Roshni’s engagement.

episodesList.title: Aman Feels Bad for Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman is left dumbstruck by Roshni's questions while she nears danger. Later, he feels bad for Roshni after overhearing her conversation with Parveen.

episodesList.title: Aman Misunderstands Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman saves Roshni from grave danger while they are shocked when Sameer arrives with Aftab and his family. Later, Aman hurts Roshni after misunderstanding her.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Despicable Ploy
episodesList.summary: Sameer lures Roshni out of the house at night by threatening her. While Aman makes a startling decision, Saima is flustered after getting a shocking video.

episodesList.title: Roshni Sneaks into the House
episodesList.summary: Roshni manages to sneak into the house to meet Saima while Aman is shocked to see her at the function. Later, Raakh Jinn places a trap and kidnaps Bazigar.

episodesList.title: Roshni to Save Chhotu
episodesList.summary: Roshni rushes to save Chhotu when he is attracted by a magical well. A deadly disaster awaits Roshni while Aman seeks Tabeezi's help.

episodesList.title: Roshni to Execute a Deal
episodesList.summary: Saima attempts suicide while Raakh Jinn uses magical shoes to discover the Chirag. Later, Roshni takes a bold step to deal with the blackmailer.

episodesList.title: A Twist in Saima's Wedding Event
episodesList.summary: Saima is overjoyed by her family's special dance act while Raakh Jinn snatches Aman's magical door. Later, Sameer's wife creates a scene at Saima's wedding.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni to Part Ways
episodesList.summary: Aman decides to evict Roshni from the house to complete Saima's marriage while Sameer relishes his success. Later, a disheartened Roshni leaves the house.

episodesList.title: Salma Shocks the Khan Family
episodesList.summary: Salma shocks Aman's family with her confession about her lies. While Tabeezi falls in grave danger, Aman is stunned by Saima's confession.

episodesList.title: Aman Regrets His Behaviour
episodesList.summary: Aman vents his anger after learning that Roshni has run away from her house. Elsewhere, Raakh Jinn helps Jinn escape captivity while the latter takes human form.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is in Danger?
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni reminisce about their time together. One month later, a trapped Roshni finds herself in a dangerous situation.

episodesList.title: Aman Witnesses a Shocking Sight
episodesList.summary: Roshni is speechless after witnessing the old lady easily stop her attack. While Parveen faces Junaid's second wife, Rubina shows Aman a shocking sight.

episodesList.title: The Jinn Wreaks Havoc
episodesList.summary: The disguised Jinn enters the Khan house while a monster Aman is tied with chains. Later, the Jinn stabs the family members one by one.

episodesList.title: Aman Seeks Vengeance!
episodesList.summary: Aman is horrified to see his family murdered right in front of him. While Roshni struggles to find a way to reach him, Aman sets out to seek revenge.

episodesList.title: Roshni Does the Unthinkable
episodesList.summary: Roshni reaches Aman with Baazigar's help while he walks towards the Laal Chaand to kill himself. To save Aman, Roshni fights him and does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is No More?
episodesList.summary: Anjum declares Roshni dead after Aman brings her home. While Aman receives a set of unexpected letters, Salma and the Khan family mourn her death.

episodesList.title: Kabir Confronts Parveen
episodesList.summary: Kabir visits Junaid Manzil to confront Parveen regarding her actions. Parveen's darkest secret comes to light while Kabir attacks Aman.

episodesList.title: Is Roshni Alive?
episodesList.summary: Anjum is puzzled when Parveen uses her power to cure Aman. While Kabir brings a lady into the house, Aman is shocked to spot Roshni.

episodesList.title: Aman Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: After an emotional family reunion, Aman learns the dark truth about Roshni's resurrection. Later, he is given a magical mirror while Kabir discusses his evil plan.

episodesList.title: Aman, Kabir on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Aman's magic terrifies Roshni as he tries to help her regain her memory. Later, Kabir joins hands with Aman to rescue Roshni from a whirlpool.

episodesList.title: Kabir Helps Aman
episodesList.summary: Aman seeks Kabir's help to relocate Roshni and Salma's house after it gets destroyed. Later, Aman expresses his love for Kabir along with the Khans.

episodesList.title: Aman Surprises Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman surprises Roshni by presenting her with a grand feast. Later, Roshni is delighted to meet Farah while Kabir is in for a shock.

episodesList.title: Aman Impresses Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman impresses Roshni by showing her some extraordinary magic. Later, Roshni falls unconscious when a disaster strikes at the Khan mansion.

episodesList.title: Kabir Is Exposed?
episodesList.summary: Aman discovers a shocking truth about Kabir while the latter attempts to kill Tabeezi. Later, Kabir tricks Roshni with his magical powers.

episodesList.title: Kabir to Marry Roshni
episodesList.summary: The Khans are left dumbstruck by Tabeezi's sudden death while Aman attempts to kill Baazigar. Later, Kabir announces about his marriage with Roshni.

episodesList.title: Kabir, Roshni to Tie the Knot
episodesList.summary: Aman kills Baazigar while Roshni and Kabir begin their marriage rituals. Later, Roshni mercilessly attacks Aman with her shurikens.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is Back!
episodesList.summary: Aman returns Roshni to her old self by stabbing her with the magical dagger. During Chotu's birthday party, Parveen sets her devious plan in motion.

episodesList.title: Roshni Has a Change of Heart?
episodesList.summary: During Chotu's birthday party, Roshni tells Aman that she doesn't want to be with him and leaves. Later, Kabir puts Aman through a daunting task.

episodesList.title: Is Kabir Dead?
episodesList.summary: Aman traps Roshni behind the magical bars while Parveen attacks Tabeezi. Later, Parveen shoots an arrow at Kabir as he fights Aman.

episodesList.title: Roshni to Save Aman's Life
episodesList.summary: Parveen rains thousands of arrows on Aman. However, Roshni rushes in to save his life. What are Parveen's intentions?

episodesList.title: Roshni Makes a Promise to Aman
episodesList.summary: While Chotu gains magical powers the family realises that there is still dark magic in the house. After a tender moment, Roshni makes a solemn promise to Aman.

episodesList.title: The End for Aman?
episodesList.summary: Aman wreaks havoc and attempts to kill his family members with the magical sword. Later, Roshni stabs Aman to fulfil her promise.

episodesList.title: Aman to Roshni's Rescue?
episodesList.summary: Aman races against time to rescue Roshni from the imminent danger. However, Parveen does the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Quality Time
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni spend some quality time together. While Roshni impresses the Khans with her culinary skills, Parveen generates a magical formula.

episodesList.title: Parveen's Diabolical Act
episodesList.summary: Parveen's magic causes Roshni to suffer from dementia. While the Khans are worried by Roshni's weird behaviour, she experiences a sudden blackout.

episodesList.title: Roshni Faces a New Challenge
episodesList.summary: Roshni faces a new challenge after discovering Parveen's true intentions. Aman plans a romantic surprise for Roshni while Parveen formulates an evil plan.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Romantic Time
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni enjoy their romantic time in the snow. Parveen acquires a poisonous fruit while the Khans gear up for Aman and Roshni's engagement.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Shake a Leg
episodesList.summary: Chotu interrupts Aman and Roshni while they spend some quality time together. Later at the function, Aman and Roshni shake a leg.

episodesList.title: Roshni Falls Unconscious
episodesList.summary: Roshni learns a shocking piece of information from Tabeezi. She falls unconscious while Tabeezi makes an unexpected discovery in the swimming pool.

episodesList.title: Parveen's Secret Is Out?
episodesList.summary: Aman is stunned when Roshni blames Parveen for all the strange occurrences. After Tabeezi puts the family through a test, Parveen's truth comes to light.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Learn the Truth
episodesList.summary: Parveen hunts for the magical ring while Aman and Roshni learn a shocking truth from Tabeezi. Later, Aliya makes a stunning confession to the Khans.

episodesList.title: A Shocker for Aman!
episodesList.summary: Aman makes a shocking decision after seeing the DNA reports while Roshni suspects Aliya. Later, Aman tries to console an emotional Roshni.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Get Close
episodesList.summary: Baazigar attacks Aliya while Roshni secretly pays a visit to Tabeezi. Later, Roshni makes a special wish and spends some alone time with Aman.

episodesList.title: Is Roshni Jealous?
episodesList.summary: Aliya is happy to see Roshni jealous because of her bond with Aman. Later, Parveen attempts to kidnap the baby from the Khan mansion.

episodesList.title: Aman Consoles Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman tries to pacify Roshni after she spots an odd photograph in the library. While Parveen executes a devious plan, Aman suddenly falls unconscious.

episodesList.title: Roshni Gets Suspicious
episodesList.summary: Roshni breaks down when Aliya informs her that Aman spent the night in her bed. While Roshni learns that some dark magic is at play, Aliya creates a huge scene.

episodesList.title: Aliya's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: After Aliya's plan backfires, Roshni attempts to expose her. While Roshni makes an emotional statement to Aman, Tabeezi discovers Kabir's heart.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Tender
episodesList.summary: Realising that he is suddenly able to touch her, Aman shares a tender embrace with Roshni. Later, Aliya resolves to hide her shocking truth from Roshni.

episodesList.title: Parveen's Cunning Trick
episodesList.summary: Roshni sees a strange sight in a locked room while Aman is put in a tough spot. Later, Parveen's cunning trick leaves the whole family in a state of desperation.

episodesList.title: Aman Stuns Aliya
episodesList.summary: While Parveen's selfish mission puts the baby's life at risk, Aman stuns Aliya with his magic. Can Aman's heroic act save the baby before it is too late?

episodesList.title: Aman Saves the Day!
episodesList.summary: Aliya is relieved as Aman saves her baby from the magical cave. Later, she confronts Roshni while Rubina agrees to keep Parveen's secret, but on one condition.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Unable to convince Aman, Roshni goes to Tabeezi for help regarding Aliya. Later, Roshni embarks on a mission to acquire one strand of hair from the baby's head.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Discover the Truth
episodesList.summary: Roshni attempts to expose Aliya's misdeeds during a function at the Khan mansion. Later, Aman and Roshni discover an alarming truth about Aamir.

episodesList.title: Aliya to Leave the House?
episodesList.summary: Aman makes a shocking announcement before Aliya leaves the house. Later, Chotu observes a peculiar statue while Parveen is in a tight spot.

episodesList.title: Aman Rescues Roshni!
episodesList.summary: While Aman learns about Parveen's miserable condition, Aliya lands in trouble. Later, Aman rescues Roshni and Chotu from grave danger.

episodesList.title: Aman Is Captured?
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni share a romantic moment while Aliya executes her evil plan. Later, Aman is taken by the Kaal Jinn while Roshni tricks Aliya.

episodesList.title: Roshni Pushes the Limit
episodesList.summary: Roshni pushes the limit in a battle with Aliya, resulting in devastating consequences. Later, Aman makes a promise to Parveen and prepares to face Kaala Jinn alone.

episodesList.title: Aliya Plays Her Trump Card
episodesList.summary: Aliya plays her trump card while the Khans are taken aback by Parveen's sudden demise. Later, Aman vents his frustration on Roshni.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni to Part Ways?
episodesList.summary: Aman shoots sharp accusations at Roshni. While the Khans are in a tight spot, Aman and Roshni decide to part ways.

episodesList.title: Roshni, Aman’s Drastic Leap
episodesList.summary: Roshni struggles with her memories of Aman. One year later, Aman gets into a fight at a club while Roshni's life takes a turn for the worse.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Awkward Meeting
episodesList.summary: While Aman receives a shocking piece of information from the hospital, Roshni gets an astonishing news. Later, Aman and Roshni have an awkward encounter.

episodesList.title: Aman Takes Revenge!
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Aman vows to take revenge against Roshni. While the Khans learn an eye-opening fact about Parveen, Roshni is in for a shock of her life.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Heated Dispute
episodesList.summary: A heated argument leads to a fierce combat between Aman and Roshni. While Salma's health deteriorates, Aman takes advantage of a helpless Roshni.

episodesList.title: Meet Mallika!
episodesList.summary: Meet Mallika, Aman's gorgeous business partner. While he assigns Roshni to take care of her, Tabeezi spots a black cat possessing an evil entity.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Romantic Moment
episodesList.summary: Aman beats up Yuvraj after the latter tries to molest Roshni. While Chottu struggles to get free, Roshni and Aman have an unexpected romantic moment.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Despite Roshni saving his life, Aman punishes her for a misunderstanding. While Kabir is back for revenge, Aman sends Roshni alone to face a dangerous situation.

episodesList.title: Aman Is Stabbed
episodesList.summary: Unaware that Kabir is the attacker, Aman gets stabbed trying to save Roshni. Elsewhere, Chhotu releases an angel called Locha Pari from her prison.

episodesList.title: Aman Is in Turmoil
episodesList.summary: During an argument, Aman is hurt when Roshni tells him that she has moved on. While Roshni decides to risk her life, Aman smashes his office in a rage.

episodesList.title: Kabir Is Back!
episodesList.summary: The doctor reveals surprising news to the Khans while an evil entity tortures Tabeezi. Later, Roshni is taken aback as Kabir wreaks havoc at the hospital.

episodesList.title: Aman to Roshni's Rescue
episodesList.summary: While Tabeezi creates a magical essence against the Zehrals, Aman rushes to Roshni's rescue. Elsewhere, Parveen's life is at stake as Kabir tries to anguish her.

episodesList.title: The Khans are in Danger
episodesList.summary: Kabir reveals to the family that one of them has turned into a Zehral. Later, Roshni is on a mission to fulfil Kabir's demand to save the family.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is on a Mission
episodesList.summary: While Roshni is on a mission to get a magical key, Salma tortures the Khans after turning into Zehral. Later, Roshni takes a risky step, unaware of a looming danger.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Join Forces
episodesList.summary: An infuriated Kabir sends the Khan house beneath the earth with the help of Lal Chand. Later, Aman and Roshni decide to break the Lal Chand.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Save the Day
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni use their powers to save the Khans from certain death. While Parveen regains her consciousness, Chottu lands in trouble.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni, Imran on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Aman attempts to save Chottu from grave danger while Parveen falls unconscious. Later, Aman, Roshni and Imran find themselves deep in the woods on a dangerous mission.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni Face a Challenge
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni face a challenge while the caretaker puts forth a set of questions. Later, they race against time to save Chottu.

episodesList.title: Roshni's New Enemy
episodesList.summary: Kabir joins hands with Shehzadi to plot against Roshni and Aman. While the Khans plan to celebrate their anniversary, Roshni puts forth a strange condition to Aman.

episodesList.title: Shehzadi to Punish Aman, Roshni
episodesList.summary: The Khans celebrate Aman and Roshni's wedding anniversary. Later, Shehzadi arrives at the Khan Mansion to punish the duo for breaking the Laal Chand.

episodesList.title: Aman's Ingenious Plan
episodesList.summary: Aman suspects Shehzadi when the Khans land in grave danger. Later, he hatches an ingenious plan to keep his family shielded.

episodesList.title: Kabir Hypnotises Tabeezi
episodesList.summary: The family is confused when they get caught up in a battle between the identical twins. Later, Kabir hypnotises Tabeezi to accuse the wrong person.

episodesList.title: Shehzadi's Sly Trick
episodesList.summary: Shehzadi tricks Roshni into bringing a piece of the moon while Tabeezi tries to attack Farah. Aman learns an alarming truth when Shehzadi goes missing.

episodesList.title: Aman's Race Against Time
episodesList.summary: Aman rushes to tell Roshni the truth and stop her from touching the moon before it is too late. Later, they are shocked by what they find upon returning home.

episodesList.title: Aman to Save Parveen
episodesList.summary: Laila lays a cunning trap to kill Aman and Kabir while Roshni rescues Chandni. Later, Aman attempts to save Parveen from danger.

episodesList.title: Laila Gets Stabbed!
episodesList.summary: Aman suspects Kabir's true intentions after witnessing his immense power. Later, Roshni stabs Laila with her spear when she is faced with a difficult choice.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is in Danger
episodesList.summary: While Roshni finds herself under a collapsing roof, Aman attempts to save her. During a party at the Khan Mansion, everyone witnesses the unthinkable.

episodesList.title: A New Challenge for Aman
episodesList.summary: The Khans are terrified as Roshni does not regain consciousness. While Farhah, Chhotu and Imran try to find the magical cave, Aman discovers a way to save Roshni.

episodesList.title: Aman's Drastic Step
episodesList.summary: The Khans are taken aback by Aman's drastic step. While Chhotu falls in danger, Aman and Roshni struggle to save the Khans.

episodesList.title: Time Is Running Out for Aman
episodesList.summary: Aman tries to change the outcome of the accidents as he relives the day of Roshni's death. Will he be able to save her from the upcoming danger in time?

episodesList.title: Aman's Heroic Act
episodesList.summary: Aman saves Roshni from falling down the stairs while Chhotu lands in trouble on his journey to a magical cave. Later, Aman is dumbstruck when Roshni disappears.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Tender Moment
episodesList.summary: While Chhotu risks his life to reach the door to the magical cave, Aman and Roshni share a tender moment. Later, Roshni makes a demand which puts her in danger.

episodesList.title: Junaid Khan's Questionable
episodesList.summary: Twenty years ago, a hopeless Junaid Khan had taken a drastic step after joining hands with the Jinn. Later, Parveen and Tabeezi feel disappointed with his way of life.

episodesList.title: Junaid Khan's Battle for Life
episodesList.summary: Junaid Khan plans to sacrifice Aman's life after throwing Tabeezi and Farah out of the house. Later, Junaid battles for life when his sins are unveiled.

episodesList.title: Danger Ahead for Aman, Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman and Roshni share a beautiful moment, watching the sunrise in a hot air balloon. Later, the Khans unite to protect Roshni from grave danger.

episodesList.title: Aman Is No More!
episodesList.summary: The Khans mourn Aman's tragic demise while a shattered Roshni loses consciousness. Later, she sets out on a mission to prove her love for Aman.

episodesList.title: Roshni Meets Rehan
episodesList.summary: Roshni meets Aman's long-lost brother Rehan Khan who agrees to help her out. While Nasreen tries to obstruct Roshni, the Jinn approaches Khan mansion.

episodesList.title: Roshni's Huge Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: The Jinn enters Khan mansion and takes away Aman's spirit. Later, Roshini agrees to make the ultimate sacrifice. Will the Jinn consider her appeal?

episodesList.title: Rehan Recalls the Past
episodesList.summary: Rehan is perplexed when Roshni hides the truth from Aman and his family. Later, he tells the Khans about his past and his family.

episodesList.title: Aman, Roshni's Special Night
episodesList.summary: The Khans surprise Aman by decorating his room elegantly. At night, Aman and Roshni share a romantic moment while Rehan heads off to the club.

episodesList.title: Big Day for Shayari!
episodesList.summary: The Khans remain unaware of the fact that a flying saucer is spying on their mansion. Meanwhile, Shayari heads off for an interview at Rehan's office.

episodesList.title: Rehan Is Furious
episodesList.summary: Roshni avoids consuming Aman's tablets while Rehan is outraged by Shayari's blunders. Meanwhile, a stranger enters Tabeezi's house.

episodesList.title: Rehan's Strange Decision
episodesList.summary: While Roshni makes an extraordinary request to Rehan, Shayari is in for a sweet surprise. Later, an infuriated Roshni wreaks havoc when Aman reveals the truth.

episodesList.title: Aman Consoles Roshni
episodesList.summary: Aman tries to console a distraught Roshni. While Rehan is worried about Farhan's whereabouts, another danger awaits the Khans.

episodesList.title: Aman, Rehan Land in Danger!
episodesList.summary: Roshni rushes to tell Aman about her pregnancy. While Rehan and Aman get trapped in a magical fume sent by the Jinn Shikari, Shayari visits the Khans.

episodesList.title: Rehan Is on a Mission
episodesList.summary: Aman gets a doctor home to check up on Roshni's health. Elsewhere, Natasha meets Rehan at his office while he decides to find out more about Shayari.

episodesList.title: Rehan Suspects Shayari
episodesList.summary: Natasha tries to seduce Rehan. He remains adamant that Shayari is a Jinn Shikari. Later, Aman suspects that Roshni is pregnant.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is Devastated
episodesList.summary: Roshni learns a shocking fact about her pregnancy through Tabeezi's magical ritual. While Rehan is stunned by Shayari's odd act, Tabeezi embarks on a mission.

episodesList.title: Natasha Hypnotises
episodesList.summary: While Shayari enters Rehan's cabin, Natasha hypnotises him to create an unexpected sight. Meanwhile, the Khans learn some unexpected news about Tabeezi.

episodesList.title: Shayari Faces Rehan's Wrath?
episodesList.summary: Aman is overwhelmed on hearing about Roshni's pregnancy. Elsewhere, Shayari is scared when Rehan decides to punish her in a unique way.

episodesList.title: A Surprise for Roshni
episodesList.summary: Unaware of the Jinn's presence, Roshni receives a pleasant surprise from the Khans. In the meantime, Natasha sneaks into Rehan's room with devious intent.

episodesList.title: Rehan to Marry Natasha?
episodesList.summary: With hopes of seeing Farhan return home, Rehan proposes to Natasha. Elsewhere, Shayari lands in grave danger.

episodesList.title: Natasha, Rehan's Engagement
episodesList.summary: Tabeezi offers to help Roshni save her child while Shayari vents out her anger on Rehan. Later, Natasha and Rehan's engagement ceremony commences at the Khan mansion.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is in a Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Tabeezi brings Zidra home to help Roshni. While Shayari cunningly tricks Rehan, Roshni struggles to hide her secrets from Aman.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is in a Fix
episodesList.summary: Natasha accidentally traps herself in a magical bottle. At the press conference, Roshni gets tensed as Aman plans to reveal her pregnancy.

episodesList.title: Shayari, Rehan Get Engaged
episodesList.summary: Natasha's sudden disappearance paves the way for Rehan and Shayari's engagement ceremony. During the celebrations, the Jinn arrives at the Khan Mansion.

episodesList.title: Aman's Life in Peril?
episodesList.summary: Jinn enters Zidra's body after she steps out of Tabeezi's golden circle. Later, Roshni saves Aman when Kala Jinn attacks him.

episodesList.title: Can Aman Trap the Jinn?
episodesList.summary: Roshni offers help when Aman prepares to trap the Jinn in a lamp. Later, on suddenly sensing the dark forces around them, Aman plays a smart trick.

episodesList.title: A Challenge for Aman, Roshni
episodesList.summary: In the middle of the woods, Aman and Roshni strive to trap the Jinn in the Chal Kua and seal its entrance. However, Aman later finds the well mysteriously opened.

episodesList.title: Aman Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Rehan sets off on a mission, unaware of Shayari hiding in the car. Meanwhile, Aman is heartbroken after he confronts Roshni about the truth.

episodesList.title: Roshni to Leave
episodesList.summary: The Khans are taken aback when Roshni decides go back to her house. Elsewhere, Rehan's life is in risk as he fights some deadly goons.

episodesList.title: Roshni Is Unwell
episodesList.summary: The Khans are concerned when Roshni falls ill after getting trapped in a circle of fire. Meanwhile, Rehan throws Shayari out of the Khan mansion.

episodesList.title: Can Aman Trick the Jinn?
episodesList.summary: Racing against time Tabeezi suggests a solution to save Roshni and her unborn child. As the Jinn closes in, can Aman fight him off?

episodesList.title: Roshni to Save Her Baby
episodesList.summary: Roshni comes up with a clever plan to fool the Jinn and save her child. Will a grand distraction by the Khans help Aman and Roshni to escape?

episodesList.title: Roshni Delivers Her Baby
episodesList.summary: Roshni delivers her baby while the Jinn manages to enter the Khan mansion. Later, the Jinn demands Roshni honour her promise.

episodesList.title: Aman's Wild Hallucinations?
episodesList.summary: The Khans believe that Aman is hallucinating about Roshni. While he tries to convince them about his unusual experiences, a magical event takes place by the pool.

episodesList.title: Aman's Heroic Act
episodesList.summary: Aman learns about Kala Jinn's ploy. After Tabeezi warns him about the menacing Pital Darwaza, he sets out to rescue Roshni and his child.

episodesList.title: Aman Begs for Mercy
episodesList.summary: Aman pleads with the Kala Jinn not to unleash his menace upon the family. Later, the Jinn puts forth a set of unthinkable challenges before him.

episodesList.title: Roshni's Eerie Encounter
episodesList.summary: Tabeezi asks Aman to keep an eye on the magical lamp while Roshni witnesses a strange phenomenon. Later, Chunmun Dai's unexpected entry shocks everyone.
