episodesList.summary: Sameer is appreciated by his teacher for saving the girls from the goons. Later, the students arrive at the lodge. Naina is dreaming about Sameer. Finding this out, Swati informs her to know for sure if Sameer truly loves her?

episodesList.title: Finding True Love
episodesList.summary: Naina wants to find out if Sameer is actually in love with her. Swati asks Naina if she trusts Sameer. She asks Naina to pray before god to find out if Sameer truly loves her. Will she find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Sameer's Truth
episodesList.summary: Naina wants to know if Sameer truly loves her. She meets Sameer, who gifts her a teddy bear. Swati is still unsure if Sameer loves Naina and asks her to be sure about this. Will Naina ever find out the truth?

episodesList.title: Sameer's Diary
episodesList.summary: Naina finds Sameer’s diary and hesitatingly reads it. Later, the students decide to turn the otherwise mundane atmosphere into fun by playing a few games. Swati mistakenly drops water on Naina’s dress. Having no other choice, Naina wears the same dress she worse on Sameer’s birthday.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Hesitation
episodesList.summary: During the trip, Naina and Sameer come close to each other. Playing dumb charades, Naina feels that Sameer might actually love her. They both spend time with each other and decide to go to the sunset spot. Will Sameer propose to Naina?

episodesList.title: Shefali's Disappointment
episodesList.summary: Naina believes that Sameer will never cheat her. Swati warns her about opposition she might face from her family. The students decide to boating. Here, Sameer and Naina come close to each other. Meanwhile, Shefali is disappointed with Arjun for falling to defend her.

episodesList.title: Arjun’s Apology
episodesList.summary: Sameer and his gang help Naina and Swati cook for the class. When Sameer burns his hand, Naina feels sorry for him. Meanwhile, Shefali finds a letter from Arjun, who wants her to play cricket and come to practice.

episodesList.title: Naina Scolds Sameer
episodesList.summary: After drinking wine that Sameer brought as a medicine, Munna and Pandit sleep outside only. Sameer didn't wear a sweater and got so cold that he started sneezing uncontrollably. Naina scolds him and tells him to wake Shanti mam up and get some medicines from her. She even threatens that she'll tell everyone that he brought wine.

episodesList.title: Sameer Gets Caught
episodesList.summary: Naina's father gets furious as he finds out Sameer in Naina's room. He beats him and disrespects Sameer for his habits and behavior. Naina tries to stop her father from beating Sameer, but Sameer stops her from telling the truth with a fear of her prestiage. Will Sameer get rusticate for his misbehavior?

episodesList.title: Sameer Fights
episodesList.summary: Shanti mam asks the students to plant the trees and also tells them the importance of nature. Naina looks for Sameer and asks Swati about Munna. Rakesh scolds the students. Shanti mam tells the students that as you sow, so you reap. Naina thinks just as this tree blossoms in future, we will also blossom. She plans to confess her love to Sameer in front of the plant and thinks that the plant will be an epitome of their love.

episodesList.title: Parents Refuse Identity
episodesList.summary: Sameer walks on the road after Vishaka and Mr. Sumani refused to identify him. He reaches the cliff of the mountain and cries aloud taking out his pain. Naina comes there and runs towards him. She sees him crying badly and sits near him to pacify him. Sameer gets up and asks her to go away from him.

episodesList.title: Sad Ending of the Trip
episodesList.summary: Naina falls down and gets unconscious. Swati runs to her and asks what happened to her. Naina looks on and recalls about the bet. Munna and Pandit search for Sameer. Naina’s voiceover tells that she wanted to take good memories and their pics, but was returning home with heart break, nobody knew where was he, may be he didn’t have the guts to face everyone. They all come and sit on the bus.

episodesList.title: Bad Luck
episodesList.summary: Sameer comes into the room and sees Vishakha and Mr. Somani. He recalls Mr. Somani saying they don’t know him. Preeti tells Naina about Megha and says guys are betrayal and we shall not trust them. Naina thinks about Sameer’s bet and asks how can anyone do this in love. Preeti says nobody is talking to them and says God saves us from time pass guys and asks Naina about her trip. Naina recalls the moments with Sameer. Naina runs to the washroom. Preeti asks who gave you the big teddy bear. Naina recalls their conversation and reminisces dancing with him. She reminisces confessing love and coming to know about the bet. She looks at her face in the bucket and puts water on her head.

episodesList.title: Memories
episodesList.summary: Taiji scolds Naina for trying to break radio. She warns Preeti not to help Naina in her work and asks Naina to get all stuff back that she broke. Sameer is also sad and he takes out his frustrations on Munna and Pandit. He calms himself and goes to get food for them. Munna and Pandit decide to do Sameer-Naina’s patch up.

episodesList.title: Naina Hospitalized
episodesList.summary: Naina thinks about Sameer and gets sad. Preeti says she won’t sleep there and goes. Bela tells Anand that since Naina came from the trip, she is not eating anything. Anand tells her that Naina might be emotional since she heard Megha’s story and says he will talk to her tomorrow and understand her psychology. Bela says if it is ghost matter. How Naina's health will be affected by the sadness?

episodesList.title: Sameer In Hospital
episodesList.summary: Swati tells Sameer that he can’t be happy making Naina sad and says if anything happens to her then she will cut his hair. Bela says since she came here, she was like a statue. Rakesh says she was fine on the trip and was playing. Don’t know what you have done. Taiji says that they spend their lives taking care of their children. Preeti says sorry to Naina for getting upset with her.

episodesList.title: Naina Cherishes The Moment
episodesList.summary: Naina hugs Swati and tells her that she won’t cry anymore and will be away from tears and the person giving it. She says she is Naina Agarwal, school topper, her best friend and dear to Chachaji and Chachiji. She says she will say bye bye to tears and love and welcome smile. Swati hugs her. Sameer thanks Munna and Pandit for opening his eyes and says you both are smart. They ask him to do as they said.

episodesList.title: Sameer Apologises
episodesList.summary: Naina does aarti and sings a bhajan. Bela tells that Naina is looking happy and singing a bhajan. Bela asks Naina to sit and says she will comb her hairs. Naina sees the sorry card in her cycle basket and looks at Sameer who is in disguise of a laundry guy. Sameer comes to her and says sorry. Naina slaps him. It turns out to be his imagination and he thinks he will be slapped hard on his face.

episodesList.title: Distress
episodesList.summary: Lochan Sir asks Sameer to become a cock if he has a concentration problem. He asks Munna and Pandit to also become cocks. Sameer, Munna, and Pandit sit for the punishment. Naina, Swati, Kamya and other girls smile. Naina tells Swati that whatever happened was a bad dream and now Sameer is just any other guy in the class, now she doesn’t see him. Swati says he was special to you. Naina says now my studies and my family are special to me and my life will be just like it was before Sameer came in my life. She asks Swati to come. Just then Rakesh comes there. He tells another sir that kids locked her in the library so that he couldn't go on the trip. Sameer and Pandit come there. Rakesh says I was sure that he was behind locking me.

episodesList.title: Toy Parrot
episodesList.summary: Naina thinks she shall not cry anymore and shall laugh at herself and her family. Preeti calls Naina and tells that Pralay has bought toy parrot. Anand asks him to return it as it belongs to someone else. Pralay refuses while Taiji asks to let him keep the toy. Bela says I was thinking the parrots will gather seeing it and will make the place dirty.

episodesList.title: Wait to Apologize
episodesList.summary: Sameer calls Naina but Preeti picks the phone call. Pandit and Munna bring more coins as he faces lack of coins and tell him that Naina will pick the phone at last. Sameer thanks them for being their his true friend. They ask him to apologize to Naina instead of thanking them. Preeti picks the call again and asks why he not one is replying anything from the other end. Naina comes out in balcony and sees Sameer in public booth. Sameer looks at he and comes out of booth to apologize.

episodesList.title: A Friend in Need
episodesList.summary: Munna and Pandit bring a blanket as Sameer feels cold and food for him. They say they are his shadow, they can’t leave him alone. Sameer says it’s his fight and he will fight alone. Munna tells Sameer that the sweater Naina made for him is looking good. Sameer says she’s just his friend whose heart he broke and now she is not accepting his apology. Munna and Pandit say Naina will definitely melt. Sameer says he will be restless till he says sorry for her, so he will stay there till he gets the answer to his sorry.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Gift
episodesList.summary: In a heated argument, Bela ends up insulting Rakesh. Bela’s harsh words, which are directed at Rakesh’s inability to pay for the gift, which was bought by Anand. When Anand learns about this, he asks Bela to leave the house.

episodesList.title: Naina's Visit
episodesList.summary: Preeti convinces Naina that since her cycle is broken she should keep the cycle she won as a gift. Meanwhile, Sameer falls unconscious and is admitted to the hospital. Naina decides to pay him a visit. Shefali gives a few lessons of life to Arjun to improve his batting.

episodesList.title: Naina Confronts Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina meets Sameer in the hospital. She tells him how she feels betrayed by him. And how she has lost faith in love. Will Sameer be able to fix things with Naina?

episodesList.title: Arjun Confronts Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina's brother starts a fight at school. The students tell him about Naina's love affair with Sameer. He goes home to ask Naina if this is true.

episodesList.title: Sameer Faces Off Arjun
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina's brother go against each other in a cricket match. Sameer and Naina's brother get into an argument about making the bet.

episodesList.title: Sameer The Servant
episodesList.summary: Naina's brother is injured. So Sameer is asked to be his servant. Nanina is against Sameer living in her house.

episodesList.title: Sameer In Naina's House
episodesList.summary: Sameer is adjusting to his life in Naina's house. He is happy to see her family life. Naina is still angry with him. Her father comes over and scolds Sameer for not doing any work.

episodesList.title: Sameer Is Impressed
episodesList.summary: Naina makes tea for Sameer. He tells her that he doesn't drink tea. He asks her for some coffee for which he gets scolded. Naina's brother tells him that it is not necessary to come to his house anymore. He asks him to stay away from him and Naina.

episodesList.title: Sameer and Naina Cook Together
episodesList.summary: Sameer is tasked with cooking breakfast for Naina's brother. Naina helps him. She teaches him how to cook, even though she is still angry with him.

episodesList.title: The Cricket Match
episodesList.summary: Sameer puts on a cricket match to lure Naina's brother out of his room. Naina tells him that it won't work but Sameer says it will. He asks her to bet on it. Sameer is successful in bringing Naina's brother out of his room, but while watching the match a player gets injured which makes Naiana's brother angry again.

episodesList.title: Clothes For The Wedding
episodesList.summary: Naina and her family are going shopping for clothes. Sameer has to stay back to take care of Naina's brother. Sameer asks Naina's father for permission to leave early so that he can meet his grandfather before he leaves on a foreign trip. Naina's father refuses.

episodesList.title: The Broken Promise
episodesList.summary: The family members find Arjun injured. They hold Sameer responsible for this and ask Naina to take them to Sameer’s house. Will Sameer reveal the reason behind his absence from home?

episodesList.title: Sameer Designs The Wedding Card
episodesList.summary: Pooja asks Naina if she wrote anything. Sameer goes into Naina’s room and sees her on the balcony. He keeps the card on the table and hides. Naina sees the wedding card which Sameer made for their wedding. Naina recalls all the good moments with him and smiles.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Proposal
episodesList.summary: The teacher tells everyone that Naina will get an award for the best student. Taya Ji asks Rakesh to go somewhere with Preeti and spend some time with her. Pooja, Preeti, Naina and Tai Ji play cards at home and argue overseeing each other's cards. Naina informs Rakesh about the parent-teacher meeting.

episodesList.title: Drive
episodesList.summary: Sameer asks Naina to sit in the car and opens the door. Taiji asks if she is waiting for an invitation to enter as Maharani and asks her to sit. Naina sits inside the car. Taiji and Tayaji go to the relatives house and invites them for marriage. Taiji introduces him as Sameer Maheshwari. Naina gets surprised to see Sameer eating the snacks and have tea. They go to other relative house and Sameer continues to eat.

episodesList.title: The PTA Meeting
episodesList.summary: Sameer wants to convince Naina's father to attend the PTA meeting. Meanwhile Dadiji has taken control of Naina's household. She doesn't want anything to go wrong.

episodesList.title: Naina's Award
episodesList.summary: Rakesh, Naina’s father, receives an award from Sameer. Meanwhile, Dadi gives a minor scare to her family members. Later, Naina too receives an award. But, Sameer asks Rakesh to give the award to Naina.

episodesList.title: The Poem
episodesList.summary: Naina's father presents Naina with an award. Sameer convinces him to speak a few words. Naina's father doesn't know wat to say, he is given a poem, which he reads.

episodesList.title: The Tent
episodesList.summary: Naina's father wants a tent to be fixed. He tells Sameer and his friends to help in fixing the tent. Meanwhile Preeti and Naina are fighting over a dress.

episodesList.title: Planning The Wedding
episodesList.summary: The wedding planning is going on in full swing. Naina's house is full of people. Meanwhile Preeti is angry with Naina.

episodesList.title: Preeti Agrees to Help Sameer
episodesList.summary: Preeti asks Naina to forgive Sameer. But she leaves without forgiving him. Preeti assures Sameer that she will convince Naina to forgive him.

episodesList.title: The Wedding Responsibilities
episodesList.summary: The wedding preparations are still going on. And Preeti is trying her best with Naina, but she isn't budging. Meanwhile Sameer is trying to flatter and butter Naina's father with Preeti's help.

episodesList.title: Sameer Unites Bela & Anand
episodesList.summary: Sameer asks Bela to help Rakesh. Sameer throws flowers on Naina during Pooja’s marriage function. Sameer is happy to see Naina crying with happiness.

episodesList.title: Sameer Decides to Marry Naina
episodesList.summary: Sameer asks Bela to bless him and pray for him to get a loving girl like herself. Sameer showers flowers on Naina during the Haldi function. Sameer tells Pandit and Munna that he has decided to marry Naina.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Secret
episodesList.summary: Arjun’s father gets a phone call and learns that the cricket team selections are going on. As Arjun cannot take part in the selection process, Arjun’s father puts the blame on Sameer. Then, Sameer meets Arjun and sees that he can walk.

episodesList.title: Naina Gets Upset
episodesList.summary: Sameer sees Arjun walking on his feet easily and gets happy thinking that he has recovered now. He tells this to Naina but Arjun lies to Naina and turns her against him. Naina gets upset and scolds Sameer.

episodesList.title: Arjun's Truth Comes Out
episodesList.summary: Sameer with the help of his friends forms a plan to bring out Arjun's truth. Shefali and Sameer shout together and act as if Naina has got electrocuted from the wires. Arjun comes to know about this and suddenly stand up. Naina is surprised to see him running.

episodesList.title: Arjun Decides to Play
episodesList.summary: Arjun asks Naina not to tell anything about Arjun's Fake injury to Rakesh. Naina gives credit to Sameer for Arjun’s recovery. Naina tells Arjun that he can’t back off and asks him to play the match. Finally, he decides to play the match and Rakesh gets emotional and hugs him.

episodesList.title: Naina Forgives Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina wants to talk to Sameer and searches for him everywhere. She asks Swati about Sameer and that's when Sameer enters the house. She tries to talk to Sameer but gets called for some work again and again. Finally, she talks to Sameer and reciprocates his love.

episodesList.title: Sameer Is Humiliated
episodesList.summary: Sameer is humiliated by Arjun, who asks him to leave. Arjun’s father joins in on the act, and pushes Sameer. Arjun’s family intervene and support Sameer. Will Sameer be allowed to stay at the wedding?

episodesList.title: Naina Gets Emotional
episodesList.summary: After Sameer had a spat with Arjun and his father, they tell him to leave. Arjun's father even pushed him and told him to get out of there. Sameer leaves but stand that night outside Naina house and talks to her. Naina tells him not to go but Sameer says that he has to but he would come back for her and will take her with him after the marriage is done.

episodesList.title: Grand Entry
episodesList.summary: Sameer plans with Munna, Pandit, and his Nanu to enter the wedding somehow. Naina misses Sameer very much which makes her sad so she decides to watch the movie Chitrahaar. She waits for her favorite song but the signal on the Tv gets interrupted and the Baraat arrives. When she goes out to check the Baraat she is shocked to see Sameer dancing in front of the Baraat.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Courage
episodesList.summary: Sameer enters the wedding house with the Baraat dancing in the front. Naina's father and her brother are furious to see him but can't do anything as he came in by the groom's side. Naina is happy to see him but gets jealous when another girl starts dancing with him.

episodesList.title: Naina Is Jealous
episodesList.summary: Naina gets jealous of Varun's sister when she is continuously talking to Sameer and is not letting him go out of her sight. Naina's frustration reaches another level when she sees Varun's sister flirting with Sameer. Sameer and Naina's love for each other blossoms during the entire function.

episodesList.title: Naina's Trick
episodesList.summary: Naina meets Sameer and offers him sweets. Without his knowledge, she makes away with the bridegroom’s shoes. Now, Sameer and his friends have to somehow get the shoes back in order to avoid humiliation.

episodesList.title: Rakesh's Apology
episodesList.summary: The friction between Sameer and Rakesh results in the wedding nearly getting stalled. Rakesh is forced to apologize to Sameer in order to continue with the marriage ceremonies. The bridegroom’s family threatens to walk out if Rakesh does not apologize to Sameer. Will Rakesh apologize?

episodesList.title: Three Magical Words
episodesList.summary: The wedding ceremony culminates and Pooja receives a teary departure from her family. Arjun warns Naina and Sameer and asks them to never see each other. But, another phone call and thus continues Sameer and Naina’s rendezvous.

episodesList.title: The Cricket Match
episodesList.summary: Pooja and Varun visit Pooja's mom and dad for the various post-marriage rituals. The day of the cricket match arrives and Sameer is supposed to play as a substitute. Arjun is confident to win the match and take the car home. Naina and Preeti are also there to cheer Arjun and Sameer. Arjun injures his foot during the match which forces Sameer to be his runner.

episodesList.title: Sameer Saves The Day
episodesList.summary: Arjun is playing in the cricket match extremely well and is taking his team towards an amazing win but in between the match he gets injured and is no longer able to run. Clearly, he needs a runner to run for him and that's when Sameer steps up.

episodesList.title: The Wait
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina's wait is finally over as they both put their feeling into words and share them with each other and embrace each other beautifully. Naina's father is happy after getting a car in prize when Arjun becomes the man of the match and Naina gives the credit to Sameer. Sameer talks to his parents on the phone.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Request
episodesList.summary: During their phone conversion, Sameer asks Naina to be a pillion rider on his motorbike. Naina is hesitant as this could prove troublesome. But, Naina and Sameer come up with a plan to avoid being caught. Will Rakesh find out about it?

episodesList.title: Holding Hands
episodesList.summary: Naina is decorating the class for the function and Sameer helps her in doing so. Sameer wants to hold Naina's hands so he plans to act angry as she didn't sit with him on his bike, to try to hold her hand. Sameer and Naina finally hold hands for the first time end don't use their right hand for the entire day.

episodesList.title: The Farewell Party
episodesList.summary: The buzz for the farewell party starts and everyone is in the rush of getting the perfect look for the party. Sameer and his friends are confused about the suits that they are going to wear and Naina and her Sister about their dresses. Sameer's Nana Ji tells him that he is a grown man now and its time for him to take the responsibilities of the family business.

episodesList.title: The Gift
episodesList.summary: Sameer comes to Shefali's house to meet Naina and give her a saree as a gift but Arjun also comes there to meet Shefali. Shafali's mom comes home and Screams after seeing Sameer and Naina there. Arjun urges to see what's wrong but Shafali doesn't let him inside. Later Naina's family questions her where she got such an expensive saree.

episodesList.title: Heart Attack
episodesList.summary: The day of the farewell comes and everyone is getting ready for the part. Naina wants to wear the saree that Sameer gave her but her family gets to know about the saree so she lies to them saying that she borrowed it from Shefali's mother, gets ready and reaches the party. Sameer also gets ready for the party and is about to leave when his Nanu gets a heart attack and collapses. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Life And Death
episodesList.summary: Naina waits for Sameer to come to the farewell party but he never comes. Naina's father takes her to the bus station to leave and she doesn't even get a chance to see Sameer before leaving. Naina leaves for their village. Sameer calls up his parents and tells them about Nana Ji.

episodesList.title: Sameer Is Shattered
episodesList.summary: Sameer breaks down and faints after the doctor tells him Nanu's condition. Naina is in her village and has no idea about Sameer's situation. Sameer's parents come to meet Nana Ji. Nana ji's condition starts to worsen and Naina feels as if something is wrong.

episodesList.title: Sameer Leaves
episodesList.summary: Sameer is shattered after Nana Ji's death and decides to leave Vishaka and go with his mother and father. Sameer completes Nana Ji's last rites. Munna and Pandit inform Naina about Nanu's death and Sameer leaving. Will Naina be able to meet Sameer one last time before he leaves?

episodesList.title: Solitude
episodesList.summary: Sameer's parents are worried for his health as after Nana Ji's death Sameer refuse to eat anything so they ask Sameer's friends to make him eat. Sameer's friends come to know that Sameer will be leaving for Delhi in the next two days so they get emotional and decide to inform Naina about everything.

episodesList.title: So Near Yet So Far
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are in the same bus station but never meet. Sameer is headed to his father’s home and has not informed Munna and Pandit, who regret that Sameer could not meet Naina before he left. Will Sameer and Naina meet?

episodesList.title: The Numbness
episodesList.summary: Sameer has gone with Vishaka to his father's house and couldn't even meet Naina for the last time. Munna and Pandit are sad and regret that they could not make Naina meet Sameer. Naina reads the news of Nana Ji's demise and starts crying in denial. Sameer tries to adjust in the new home but the numbness is too much for him to bear alone.

episodesList.title: Naina Gets To Know
episodesList.summary: Naina visits Sameer's house after she gets to know about Nana Ji's death but is shocked to hear that Sameer has gone to Delhi with his mother and might never come back here. Sameer tries to adjust in his new house with his step-brother Rohan and Step-sister Deepika. Naina cries and thinks about Sameer and how much pain he might be going through.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Phone Call
episodesList.summary: Naina waits in anticipation of Sameer’s call. She misses school so that she can answer Sameer’s phone. When Preeti arrives from school, Naina asks her if she has Sameer’s number. But, Naina has to be disappointed as Sameer has not given his new number to his friends. How will Naina and Sameer get back together?

episodesList.title: Naina's Phone Call
episodesList.summary: Naina’s sorrow turns into joy when she gets Sameer’s new number. But to her disappointment, the last digit of the number is missing. Naina tries her luck and dials various numbers to contact Sameer. Finally, she is able to contact Sameer’s number but Sameer does not answer the phone. Will Naina be able to speak with Sameer?

episodesList.title: Tensions Rise Up
episodesList.summary: Tensions rise up between Sameer and Mr. Somani after Mr. Somani's mother locks the telephone and forbids Sameer to call anyone. Sameer takes Rohan's bike out on a ride to let out his frustration and slips on the road which injures breaking the headlight of Rohan's Bike. How will Mr. Somani and his mother react to this?

episodesList.title: The Phone Call
episodesList.summary: Sameer keeps on getting frustrated at his mother's house as Dadi keeps on instigating Vishaka and her husband. Naina somehow convinces her father not to call her teachers at school. Sameer somehow gets a telephone from his neighbor's house and calls Naina and they finally talk

episodesList.title: Swati Saves the Day
episodesList.summary: Taiji sees Naina sleeping next to the telephone and suspects that she was talking to a boy. The family members gather and ask Naina who she was talking to last night. Taiji asks Anand to redial and check who Naina had spoken to. Will Naina and Sameer’s love story come to an untimely end?

episodesList.title: More Trouble
episodesList.summary: Dadi Ji makes their servant Keshav wipe the floor with Sameer's favorite sweater to make Sameer furious. Naina and her family watch Pooja's wedding video on their VCR in which Taiji catches Naina giving random signs to Sameer and confronts her. On the other hand, Sameer is constantly being targeted by Dadi Ji. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The Letter
episodesList.summary: Naina gets into trouble after Tai Ji decides to take Naina to her home and make her stay with them as she believes that Naina is having an affair with either Munna or Pandit. Sameer has a fight with Vishakha's husband after Dadi Ji manipulates him. Dadi Ji also decides to send Rohan's young sister to the hostel to protect her from Sameer's bad influence. Sameer decides to write a letter to Naina.

episodesList.title: Exams
episodesList.summary: Sameer writes a letter and sends it to Naina which will reach her in five days. Sameer waits for the five days to get over and gets restless. Finally, Munna and Pandit receive the letter and give it to Naina but at the wrong time as her exam is about to start. Sameer finds out something about Dadi Ji which he can use against her. Will Naina be able to read the letter?

episodesList.title: Sameer's Letter
episodesList.summary: Naina reads Sameer’s letter and breaks down. She is overjoyed to learn that Sameer is coming to Ahmedabad to meet her. Meanwhile, Sameer decides to take revenge on his grandmother by embarrassing her in front of the guests. Will this cost Sameer dearly?

episodesList.title: The Photoshoot
episodesList.summary: Naina gets her photos clicked to send them to Sameer so he has some memories of her with him and also has something to look forward to. Sameer decides to go to Ahmedabad and give Naina a gift. Amrita helps her in getting the perfect gift for Naina and also gives him earing to give Naina from her side.

episodesList.title: Exam Results
episodesList.summary: Pandit predicts that Naina will come first in the exam but when Shanti teacher announces the results everyone is shocked to know that Naina has failed while Dipali has come first.

episodesList.title: The Consequence
episodesList.summary: Preeti calls to ask Munna of the whereabouts of Naina, but nobody had seen her or herard from her. They finally come to the conclusion that she might be in the school, but Preeti tells them that she had not told of the results at home and needed Naina back fast.

episodesList.title: The Darkest Hours
episodesList.summary: Sameer heads back to Delhi just when the Prime Minister is killed. In the state of emergency, Sameer is not able to get a ride home. Sameer realizes his mistake and decides to call Naina. On the other hand, Sameer's mother and her family are worried about his whereabouts.

episodesList.title: Sameer Returns Home
episodesList.summary: Naina asks Sameer to calm down his mind and go home. Sameer leaves for home but is surrounded by some goons on the way. Somehow he gets out of the situation and reaches home where Vishaka gets emotional after seeing him. Naina's family gets to know about Naina failing in the exams.

episodesList.title: The Promise
episodesList.summary: After Naina made Sameer Promise him that he'll not behave badly with anyone at his mother's home, Sameer apologizes to his mother and also tries to improve his relations with everyone. Will Sameer be able to adjust at his mother's house even with Dadi Ji and his mother's husband?

episodesList.title: The Love Letter
episodesList.summary: Naina writes a love letter to Sameer and gives it to Munna to post it but Munna losses and the letter and forgets where he left it. Naina gets worried about the letter and thinks about what would happen if anyone was to find it. To her fear, her teacher finds the letter and gives it to the principal.

episodesList.title: Naina Gets An Advice
episodesList.summary: Naina’s teacher learns that Naina has written the letter to Sameer and advises her against it. Meanwhile, Sameer starts hanging out with his new friends and gets into trouble. A fight ensues between two groups and Sameer gets caught in the middle of the fight.

episodesList.title: No Smoking
episodesList.summary: Dadi plays a cheap trick to instigate Vishaka's husband against Sameer by putting a cigarette box in Sameer's bag but Vishaka saves the day at the last moment by taking the box out of his bag. Sameer sends a letter to Naina.

episodesList.title: Naina Tops The Class
episodesList.summary: Naina works hard and tops her class. She decides to end the animosity between Munna and Pandit. Meanwhile, Sameer begins hanging out with his new friends more often and turns into someone his grandmother predicted he would become. How will this affect Sameer and Naina’s relationship?

episodesList.title: Influence
episodesList.summary: Sameer starts hanging out with his new friends and turns into something that Dadi Ji would want him to become. The influence of his friendship is seen when he gets late for Naina's call. When he is called by his friends, Dadi Ji somehow hears them talking about a movie plan. Will Sameer get into a much worse trouble than before?

episodesList.title: The Surpise
episodesList.summary: Munna and Pandit surprise Sameer by paying a visit to his house. But, their joy turns into sorrow seeing Sameer partying with his new friends. Sameer realizes his mistakes and asks his new friends to get out of the house.

episodesList.title: Sameer's True Friends
episodesList.summary: Shanti is asked to leave as her students watch helplessly. Naina is still unsure why Shanti was asked to leave. Meanwhile, Munna and Pandit are allowed to stay in Sameer’s room. What will be the reaction of Sameer’s grandmother?

episodesList.title: Taking The Blame
episodesList.summary: Dadi Ji finds out the cassette that Sameer's friends gave him and when Sameer is confronted about it, Munna and Pandit take the entire blame. Shanti teacher takes the blame for Naina's love letter and is kicked out of the school. Munna and Pandit are also kicked out of Sameer's house. Naina and her friends plead the principle to give Shanti teacher a proper farewell.

episodesList.title: Love Over Letters
episodesList.summary: Naina is successful in convincing principal sir to take Shanti teacher back in the school. Naina's dad is furious at her for doing this. Sameer and Naina exchange letters and their love blossoms. Sameer decides to get a job and seeks Amrita's help with it.

episodesList.title: Radio Station
episodesList.summary: Naina fails to impress her teacher with her Semi-classical dance performance. Sameer goes for his first interview for a job in a Radio Station where Amrita's father works as a manager but he gets scolded by the manager on the first day itself and gets a taste of the real world.

episodesList.title: A Familiar Voice
episodesList.summary: Naina and Preeti are tuned in to the radio. A familiar voice greets the listeners on the channel. Sameer, who is speaking on the radio, expresses his love for Naina without naming her. Naina realizes that the voice is Sameer’s and her happiness knows no bounds.

episodesList.title: Shares For Sameer
episodesList.summary: Vishakha asks her husband to buy some shares for Sameer as they did for Rohan and Deepika. Naina gets selected to represent her school as the lead classical dancer in a competition in Delhi. Naina tries to convince her parents to send her to Delhi for the dance competition.

episodesList.title: Delhi Diaries
episodesList.summary: Naina decides to write a letter to Sameer informing him that she was visiting Delhi for a dance competition in Sameer's school but later decides to give him a surprise visit instead. Naina reaches Delhi and tries to visit Sameer's house but is caught by Sameer's Dadi Ji.

episodesList.title: Will They Meet?
episodesList.summary: Naina comes to Sameer's house but is caught by Dadi Ji and so she is not able to meet Sameer. The day of the competition arrives and Sameer is ready to go to school but Vishakha gets seriously ill so he refuses to go but Vishakha convinces him otherwise. Will Sameer and Naina meet?

episodesList.title: Sameer's Hapless Situation
episodesList.summary: Sameer is arrested by the police for breaking into Khanna’s house. Mr. Khanna arrives and asks the police officer to release Sameer, who then rushes to his mother’s aid. There, Sameer’s grandmother begs him to leave as he holds him responsible for Vishakha’s condition. What choice will Sameer make?

episodesList.title: Dance Performance
episodesList.summary: Rohan gives Sameer the letter that Naina wrote for him. and he reaches there just in time for Naina's dance performance but just before her performance Naina slips on the stage and hurts her leg. After the performance, Sameer is not able to meet Naina which breaks his heart.

episodesList.title: Pick Up The Call
episodesList.summary: Naina returns home after winning the dance competition in Delhi. Everyone is happy and celebrating her achievement but she is saddened by the thought that she was not able to meet Sameer. Arjun realizes that he is falling in love with Shefali. Vishakha's health improves and Sameer is much relaxed now. Naina calls Sameer but Sameer entangled in the problems of his own life, refuses to talk to her.

episodesList.title: Closer
episodesList.summary: Munna and Pandit give Sameer's letter to Naina. Arjun and Shefali's innocent romance flourishes. Sameer and Rohan finally act like brothers and Vishakha get emotional upon seeing it. Dadi Ji doesn't approve Sameer and Rohan hanging out together.

episodesList.title: Emotional Roller-Coaster
episodesList.summary: Its the last few days of school left and Shanti teacher handout some postcards to the students to write messages to their friends in the future. Munna gets emotional while writing the postcard. Naina wonders as to why Sameer's letters have been short and to the point in the last few weeks. Shefali tries to get Arjun spill his feelings to her.

episodesList.title: Blooming Rose
episodesList.summary: Sameer's mother defends her son before Dadi Ji. While Sameer packs his bags, his mother recalls the promise she made to her father - that she will take care of Sameer. As Sameer leaves for Ahmedabad, Naina notices that a rose is blooming, a sign that Sameer is arriving.

episodesList.title: The Last Day
episodesList.summary: Everyone is emotional on the last day of school so they try to celebrate the memories. All the students write each other's names and their best memories and messages to their best friends on each other's uniforms. Sameer comes to visit the school and watches his friends from a distance.

episodesList.title: The Love Letter
episodesList.summary: Sameer travels to Ahmedabad to his Mama’s place and is greeted generously, he hets to meet his relatives and the extended family. Arjun falls for a girl named Shefali. Naina calls Sameer’s friends and tells them that there is something wrong about Sameer’s recent letters, she doubts Sameer is in trouble.

episodesList.title: Shefali's Proposal
episodesList.summary: Naina is at a crucial juncture. She has to decide which college she will join. Meanwhile, Shefali surprises Arjun and proposes to him. Arjun is shocked to see Shefali getting down on her knees to propose to him.

episodesList.title: The Planned Coincidence
episodesList.summary: Sameer’s and Naina’s paths meet in the most coincidental way she could have ever imagined in the rush of the Ahmadabad market scene. Naina doubts that something is wrong with her and Sameer. Naina gets a dress which her aunt is not happy with, and punishes Naina with a slap across her face.

episodesList.title: Looking For Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina is convinced that she had seen Sameer in Ahmadabad, but Sameer is trying to dupe everyone into thinking he is at Delhi. Arjun takes Shefali out on a date. Sameer’s friend Munna spots Sameer in Ahmadabad.

episodesList.title: Reunion
episodesList.summary: Munna and Pandit find out that Sameer is back in Ahmedabad and try to tell this to Naina but Sameer makes them promise not to tell Naina anything about him until she is done taking admission in the college. Some might call it coincidence and some might call it destiny but unknowingly Sameer comes to take admission in the same college as Naina. Will Naina and Sameer reunite?

episodesList.title: The Fee Fuss
episodesList.summary: When Naina comes to know that Sameer is also getting admission to the same college as Swati, she tries to convince Chacha Ji to get her admission there itself but Chacha Ji is not convinced so Naina, to stall some time, pretends to have lost the fee money given to her by Chacha Ji.

episodesList.title: The Misplaced Envelope
episodesList.summary: Anand find the envolpe with money inside Naina’s washroom, although disappointed with Naina, he forgives her. Naina sneaks her way to Sameer’s place to catch a glimpse of him after a year, but Sameer is still angry with Naina.

episodesList.title: Mango Shake Massacre
episodesList.summary: Naina is at Sameer’s house, helping with the household chores. She is told to make a mango shake, but instead she shakes everyone around her with by making a mess. Arjun and Shefali’s love story grow further.

episodesList.title: Meeting in the Rain
episodesList.summary: It’s Naina’s first day in college, she is as excited as she could be but also sad that it isn’t the same college as Sameers. Arjun and Shefali takes the next step in their relationship. Sameer and Naina make an un-coincidental meeting in the rain, memories floods over both of them!

episodesList.title: The Freshmen Are Here
episodesList.summary: It’s the first day of college and Naina and Sameer are on their way. Sameer and his friends take a car ride to college, but embarrass themselves miserably when their car breaks down and they are left with no option but to push it forward. Naina and Sameer encounter each other in their first class. Then there is a dance mob where Sameer, Naina and their friends take part.

episodesList.title: The Introduction
episodesList.summary: The classes are over and Naina and her friends head to the cafeteria, there she comes across Sameer. They exchange a moment of love. Seniors take Nanina’s introduction which quickly turns into a heated moment, Sameer jumps in to save the day.

episodesList.title: Grown Ups
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are still not on talking terms. Sameer thinks that Naina is unlucky for him. Naina tells Sameer that whatever happens she will stick by his side forever. Sameer tears his jean pocket and a mess follows around this situation.

episodesList.title: Dance Off
episodesList.summary: There is a dance completion at Sameer and Naina’s college and all the freshers are preparing for it. Sammer gets into a tug with a fellow class mate. Naina is left with tears.

episodesList.title: Fight and Making Up
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer go through a nasty fight ending with both of them slapping each other. Sameer tells Naina she is unlucky for him. Naina runs away and Sameers finds her, to apologise and then comes the happy ending.

episodesList.title: The Preparation Begins
episodesList.summary: Sammer, Naina and all their friends are getting ready for the dance competition. Sammer sets to organize for all the costume. Sameer and Naina patch things up and they are at good terms.

episodesList.title: Freshers
episodesList.summary: Sameer and his friends come outside of Naina’s place to give the girls a visit. All the kids are preparing for the dance off. Pandit has an admirer.

episodesList.title: Chance Pe Dance
episodesList.summary: It’s finally competition day at the college and everyone is wishing the best for Naina and Sameer. Naina hopes that she and Sameer will bring home the title of Mr. & Mrs. Fresher.

episodesList.title: The Missing Cassette
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Naina and all of their friends are off to the dance completion. They are desperate to become the Mr. and Mrs. Fresher, of their college, but the biggest mishap happens when their music cassette goes missing. What will the kids do?

episodesList.title: Dance To The Beats
episodesList.summary: It’s the competition day, and Sameer’s music cassette goes missing. They go above and beyond to get it back.

episodesList.title: The Results
episodesList.summary: The Mr and Miss Fresher winner names are finally here, but it all ends on sad note, when Naina loses the competition.

episodesList.title: The Apology
episodesList.summary: Pooja narrates the incident that occurred at Bittu's house to Varun and informs him that though she went with the intention of apologizing, things went south. Meanwhile, Naina dreams of sitting behind Sameer on his bike. But, little known to her, she has a competition.

episodesList.title: Naina's Competition
episodesList.summary: Naina has a new competition, Suniana, who also likes Sameer. Naina's friends ridicule her, which leaves Naina furious. Naina decides to find out from Sameer about the Suniana situation while in the midst of the class. How will Sameer deal with this new problem?

episodesList.title: New Chapter
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Naina and all of their friends share some fantastic time together at the cafeteria. Later Sameer tells Naina that it’s the start of a new chapter in their love story. Arjun is still trying to impress his crush.

episodesList.title: The First Bike Ride
episodesList.summary: Naina somehow gathers up the courage and meets Sameer for their first ride on Sameer's bike. Sameer is worried about something going wrong and it does when eventually Naina's father catches them both on the road. Will Sameer and Naina be able to get out of this one?

episodesList.title: The Waxing Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Naina is embarrassed after Sameer saw the unshaved hair on her leg when she fell down during their bike ride so she decides to wax her legs. Munna and Pandit tease Sameer about his first bike ride with Naina. Preeti suggests Naina visit a salon but Naina, too scared to go to a beautician, decides to get some wax and do it herself.

episodesList.title: The Beauty Treatment
episodesList.summary: Trying to impress Sameer, Naina heads over to the salon to get waxed. Naina is joined by her friends and Sameer, and all of them together enjoy a salon day together.

episodesList.title: The Cover Up
episodesList.summary: Sameer trying to impress Naina does his first shave but cut himself on the face and Naina trying to impress Sameer does her eyebrows but messes it up. So they spend the entire day to fix it somehow before going to college the next day.

episodesList.title: The Secret Comes Out
episodesList.summary: Sameer gets to know about Naina getting her eyebrows done. Arjun and Shafali grow closer. Sameer, Munna, and Pandit get into an argument with some guys teasing Sameer in the college about him shaving for the first time.

episodesList.title: That Time of the Month
episodesList.summary: Taya Ji comes to Bela and asks her to prepare some amazing food as their family friends are visiting them in their house for dinner. But the Problem is its Bela Ji's and Naina's that time of the month and they can't enter their kitchen. Naina shares the problem with Sameer so Munna and Pandit decide to help them with a plan.

episodesList.title: Munna & Pandit Save the Day
episodesList.summary: The guests are almost there and the food isn't even there yet. Naina and Bela Ji are worried as to what would Chacha Ji and his guests think of them. But then Munna-Pandit save the day with their plan and Sameer delivers the food just in time making Naina happy.

episodesList.title: Series of Apologies
episodesList.summary: Swati is upset after the incident in the class and blames Munna for it. Everyone tries to make her understand that what Munna's intentions were not wrong but she rushes out. Arjun tries to apologize to Shefali after she saw the magazine.

episodesList.title: The Boys Come Over
episodesList.summary: As Naina starts missing Sameer, she gets an idea of calling him and his friends over to her house, as Naina’s immediate family is out. Watch as all of the kids enjoy their time together.

episodesList.title: Lighten The Mood
episodesList.summary: Everyone gathers at Naina's house to spend some time together and also to resolve the conflict between Munna and Swati so they lock Swati and Munna in a room. And finally, they resolve their conflict and continue their friendship but will these happy moments last for long?

episodesList.title: The Love Confession
episodesList.summary: Munna and Swati confess their love for each other. Arjun misses his outing with his coach and teammates to spend time with Shefali. But the problem arises when Arjun returns home while all of Naina's friends are still there. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Crossing Paths
episodesList.summary: Arjun comes back home to get the toolbox and Sameer, Munna and Pandit take the toolbox to fix the fuse. Arjun encounters Naina, Preeti and her friends and on the other side Sameer, Munna and Pandit encounter Shefali on their way to the fuse box. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Sameer The Carpenter
episodesList.summary: Naina’s immediate family is out, and as her house is empty, she calls for Sameer and all of her friends. Munna breaks a chair over and over and Sameer fixes it over and over again. Finally, as Naina and Sameer spend some quality time together her family drops in.

episodesList.title: Munna In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Munna and Swati go out to get ice cream, in the mean time Naina’s family returns. They witness Munna and Swati holding hands. Taiji threatens to call Swati’s family.

episodesList.title: Friends Forever
episodesList.summary: Naina and Swati are sad about what happened the other day because of which they now can't even visit each other at their houses. Sameer plans a movie outing to lighten the mood and proposes this idea to Naina during the lecture but is caught by their professor.

episodesList.title: A Whole Lot of Convincing
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Munna try to convince Naina and Swati to go to the cinema hall with them to watch a movie but they are too afraid to go. Naina and Sameer are almost caught by the college peon alone in a room. Tai Ji tries to rat out Shefali's phone call conundrum to her mother. Will Naina and Swati agree to go to the movies? Will Shefali and Arjun's truth come out?

episodesList.title: The Movie Conundrum
episodesList.summary: Naina is confused about going to the movies with Sameer as she is afraid that someone may see them so she calls up Swati to discuss it with her and gets to know about Munna and Sameer's little game to convince them. So they decide to play a little game of their own.

episodesList.title: The Movie Date
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Naina, Swati, and Munna plan to go out for a movie. There is a lot of convincing going on but the most dramatic part is that Naina’s family is also in the same movie hall watching the same movie. It’s a huge risk, but it’s all worth for love.

episodesList.title: Cinema
episodesList.summary: Naina-Sameer and Munna-Swati go on their first movie date and spend some quality time together but little do they know that their happiness was going to be turned into chaos as Bela Chachi and Chacha Ji are in the same cinema hall just two rows away from them. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: The Movie Massacre
episodesList.summary: As Naina, Sameer, Swati, Munna and Pandit skip their classes for a movie, surprising Naina’s uncle and aunt visit the same movie hall for that exact same movie. Naina gets caught and slapped. Shefali talks over the phone with her lover.

episodesList.title: The Regret
episodesList.summary: After Swati and Naina are caught by Bela Chachi in the cinema hall, everything is in chaos as Naina tries to mend thing with Preeti, Chachi Ji, and Tai Ji. Shefali gets seriously sick and Arjun takes care of her the entire night but is caught by Shefali's mother in the morning. What will happen now?

episodesList.title: Romance Is In The Air
episodesList.summary: Naina is asked to leave the class by JBR. Sameer follows suit by deliberately creating mischief in order to be with Naina. Be it the library or the class, Sameer expresses his undying love for Naina. Meanwhile, Bela gets suspicious of Taiji's secret talk with Pooja.

episodesList.title: Where's Sameer?
episodesList.summary: In order to find Sameer, Naina has to solve a few puzzles. Meanwhile, Varun meets Bela and informs her that Pooja had a tiff with Bittu. Pooja and Taiji have arrived at a clinic for a checkup and at the same time, Bittu also has an appointment. An altercation breaks out between Pooja and Bittu. Bela arrives with Varun at the hospital and tries to resolve the issue.

episodesList.title: That Special Dress
episodesList.summary: It’s time for Naina’s birthday and Sameer has planned a surprise birthday party for her, and gifted her a very special dress. While at home Bela also has planned something for Naina.

episodesList.title: Road Trip
episodesList.summary: It’s Naina birthday and Sameer has taken her out on a car ride on the outskirts of town, but at home, Bela and her husband have organized a party for Naina. How will she be able to attend two parties at the same time?

episodesList.title: The Birthday Surprise
episodesList.summary: Sameer takes Naina on a picnic date and surprises her with a cake and a beautiful setup. Chacha Ji and Bela Chachi also prepare for a surprise birthday party for Naina and invite everyone. But just when everything seemed to be going smooth, Naina and Sameer get into trouble.

episodesList.title: Out Of Control
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer make their way back home, their car break down in the middle of the road. They take a lift from a passerby but they don’t know what kind of a mistake they’ve made. Back at home everyone is waiting for Naina for her birthday party.

episodesList.title: What Has Naina Done?
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer get into a mess of a life time, involving unlicensed liquor and the police. As Naina makes her way back home, her father is on the verge of a breakdown and about to give up his life.

episodesList.title: A Love That Never Was
episodesList.summary: Rakesh confronts his son, Arjun. He has presumed that Arjun and Shefali had run away to get married. But, on the contrary, Arjun was only trying to help Shefali. When Rakesh asks Arjun about the truth, he keeps quiet, but Shefali reveals to the family members that though they didn't run away, they are in love with each other. Shefali reveals that Arjun had promised to marry her but Arjun denies making such promises, which leaves Shefali shattered.

episodesList.title: Arjun is Weakhearted
episodesList.summary: Everyone showers anger at Arjun and Shefali. Shefali's mother intrudes and trolls Arjun calling him a coward. She urges Shefali to leave. Naina feels disgusted on witnessing her brother's behavior but is proud of Shefali's daring antics. Sameer, on the other hand, is worried about Naina unaware of the mayhem going on at her home.

episodesList.title: Shefali's Words of Wisdom
episodesList.summary: Sameer and his friends wait to see if Naina is okay, and they get their assurance. Next morning Arjun and Shafali cross each other, Shefali gets disgusted with Arjun and tells him, that he is unworthy of love. Naina comes around to console Shefali, then Shefali claims to Naina that if she can’t admit her love for Sameer then their relationship should not continue.

episodesList.title: Will Naina Break Up?
episodesList.summary: Naina takes a tough decision following the fiasco at her house. Naina meets Sameer and informs him that they should end their relationship as their love will never be accepted by her family. Naina stops talking with Sameer, but he doesn't give up and tries to speak to Naina. Is this the end of Naina and Sameer's love story?

episodesList.title: Naina's Bold Decision
episodesList.summary: As Naina breaks up with Sameer, she is devastated so is Sameer, but then she explains that she doesn’t want to relive what Arjun and Shefali went through, and she knows that she will break from her family pressure. Later at home Anand and Bela surprises Naina with her birthday gift. Naina to erase all memories of Sameer, starts throwing away all the signs of him.

episodesList.title: Sunaina Proposes to Sameer
episodesList.summary: As per Munna and Pandit's plan, Swati informs Sunaina that Sameer is in love with her and encourages her to propose to Sameer. While Sameer and Naina are in the class, Sunaina arrives with roses and proposes to Sameer. Naina is in tears and Sameer notices that the plan has worked.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Plan Backfires
episodesList.summary: Sameer is advised by Munna and Pandit to meet Taiji. As per the plan, Sameer meets Taiji and Bela and informs them that his classmate wants to marry Naina. Sameer's plan backfires as Taiji slaps Naina and accuses her of having a romantic relationship.

episodesList.title: The Breakdown
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer and are still not on talking terms and after Sameer’s plan failed miserably, Naina is now furious with him. One thing leads to another and ultimately all the composure gets shattered and Naina and Sameer start fighting like cats and dogs at their college. Back at home, Taiji is despare to get Naina married off and starts the hunt for a groom.

episodesList.title: The Painful Withdrawal
episodesList.summary: Taiji tricks Naina, into taking her photographs in a Saari. What Naina doesn’t know is that Taiji plans to use them as her matrimony portfolio pictures. Naina misses Sameer but stays strong on her will to be single. Back at Sameer’s place, he is drowning in sorrow, and sad songs have become his favourite company now. His friends and family understand that Sameer is going through something, and he is breaking day-by-day.

episodesList.title: Music Speaks Volumes
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are still separated, while Sameer is choosing an unfamiliar path of meditation to get Naina off his mind. Naina’s life is getting more and more complicated. Taiji is rushing to get Naina married off, and her demands are that it has to be a simple mediocre family. At last Naina and Sameer call each other, but what they can’t express with words their choice of music does it for them. One play their song for the other over the phone, romantic and silly.

episodesList.title: Naina's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Taiji and Rakesh are keen on getting Naina married. After having found a prospective bridegroom, Taiji and Rakesh are adamant that Naina gets married even though Anand tries to convince them to drop the idea. Sameer remains unaware of the events happening in Naina's life and takes a spiritual path to forget Naina.

episodesList.title: Slipping Out of the Hands
episodesList.summary: Taiji is all set and prepared to get Naina married and the groom has already approached their family. Naina has her mind set to obey to whatever makes her family happy, However, she realizes that all this will never make her happy. Sameer on the other side is going through a complete change.

episodesList.title: No Turning Back Now
episodesList.summary: Naina’s life turn upside down, as Taiji and her father confirms the marriage and starts preparing for the wedding. Naina wants to scream and fight it out, but her hands are tied. She isn’t strong enough to confront them, about what she actually wants. Sameer on the other hand, plans on leaving his regular life and to become a Yogi, he decides to get admitted into an ashram to live a stale life. Things are getting pretty out of control. Anand and Bela are trapped in this confusion and are helpless.

episodesList.title: Sameer Moves On
episodesList.summary: After around a month of separation Naina and Sameer meet each other, both of them are shocked to see the drastic changes in them. Sameer after hearing that Naina is getting married to someone else decides it’s time for him to move on as well. He makes a move on Sunaina.

episodesList.title: Letting Go
episodesList.summary: Sameer shares his grief with Sunaina and informs her that Naina never truly loved him. He seeks Sunaina's help in forgetting Naina. Later, Preeti decides to write a letter to Naina's fiance in order to end Naina's sorrow and also the proposed marriage. Unfortunately for Naina and Preeti, the letter lands in the hands of Rakesh.

episodesList.title: Naina's Miserable Fate
episodesList.summary: Taiji gets her hands on the letter Preeti had written for Naina’s in-laws. Preeti admits the letter was her doing and saves Naina from all the thrashing; she tries to make Taiji understand Naina’s problems but no one seems to care. Back at college, Sameer is going around with Sunaina and thing seem to progress.

episodesList.title: The Broken Heart
episodesList.summary: Naina takes a fall at her college and she gets a leg injury. Taiji calls Naina’s supposed in-laws without notice, and things turn pretty random. Sameer brings Sunaina over to his place, his family welcomes her with open arms, but Sameer is still stuck with Naina on his head.

episodesList.title: Clipped Wings
episodesList.summary: Naina realizes that her feelings matter little to her future husband when she is asked to walk even when her leg is injured. Bela tries to pacify Naina and in the midst of the conversation, Naina nearly ends up revealing her love for Sameer. While Preeti saves the day for Naina, the two sisters are left contemplating whether Sharath will prove to be a better husband.

episodesList.title: The Ego Clash
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are still separated but their feelings for each other are off the charts. While Naina is getting ready for her marriage, Sameer is spending all his time with Sunaina. Bela and Taiji go through a verbal conflict.

episodesList.title: The Unplanned Encounter
episodesList.summary: While Taiji has set a plan to visit Naina’s future in-law’s restaurant, Sameer has planned to book the same place for his uncle and aunt’s wedding anniversary. Naina is in deep confusion about what to do next, and Sameer is anxious to see who Naina wants to get married to.

episodesList.title: An End to Dreams
episodesList.summary: Naina expresses the desire to study further but Naina's future in-laws make it clear that she should sacrifice her dreams after marriage. The sound and grief of Naina's crashing desires reach Sameer, who realizes that Naina needs to be saved. Later, Naina's future mother-in-law reaches the college to inquire about Naina.

episodesList.title: The Never-ending Feud
episodesList.summary: Anand and Bela get into a dispute with the rest of the family regarding whether Naina should continue her future studies or not. Naina’s supposed mother-in-law visits her college to find out more about Naina. In turn, she meets Sameer.

episodesList.title: It's Complicated
episodesList.summary: Anand calls Naina’s fiancé to tell him that Naina has to continue her future studies. Sameer breaks up with Sunaina, much to his surprise Sunaina takes the news quite easily, but what he doesn’t know that Sunaina is plotting something.

episodesList.title: A New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Sameer asks Naina to meet him at the temple, which is the place they first acknowledge their love for each other. Meanwhile, Naina's fiance is irked by Anand's advise. Fearing that the marriage alliance might fall apart, Taiji asks Anand to stay calm. Later, Naina and Sameer decide to start their friendship afresh and be there for each other through thick and thin.

episodesList.title: Naina Says No
episodesList.summary: Sharath gets into a hand brawl with Anand, and demeans women saying they don’t deserve equal respect as men. Finally the rest of the family arrives just to negate what Anand claimed. Naina learns what happened and builds up the courage to deny her marriage with Sharath. Naina stands up for Anand and herself.

episodesList.title: A Father Figure
episodesList.summary: There is happiness all around, Anand, Bela, Naina and Preti are all happy that Naina isn’t getting married to Sharat. The way Anand stood up for Naina has assured her that her uncle will be there for all the way. Sameer gets the news and a new mess is brewing in his head. Finally Anand gets his hands on Sameer’s letters.

episodesList.title: Faith is All She Had
episodesList.summary: Anand gets his hands on Sameer and Naina’s love letters, fitted with fury he heads to Naina’s college to have a one-on-one conversation with her, but instead he gets a misconception that Naina has denied her marriage with Sharat just to be with Sameer. Meanwhile Sameer is over-excited that Naina is single again.

episodesList.title: Naina vs. Sunaina
episodesList.summary: Munna gets fed up with Sameer’s intentions of getting back together with Naina. The college student council elections are on the way and Sameer, Munna, Pandit and all of Naina’s friends convince her to be nominated for the elections. Mean-while Sunaina also decides the same. Back at home Naina gets the hint that Anand might have found out about her relations with Sameer.

episodesList.title: A Series of Heartbreaks
episodesList.summary: Naina understands that Anand has somehow learned about Sameer and her relationship. Sameer plans a surprise proposal for Naina, but as the time comes Naina breaks his heart into pieces claiming that both of them can never be together.

episodesList.title: Broken Ties Mended
episodesList.summary: Anand going against Naina's wishes asks Taiji to fix Naina's marriage. When Naina comes to know about it, she rebukes her fiance. Sharath. In a fit of rage, Sharath slaps Naina. Then, a fight breaks out between Sameer and Sharath.

episodesList.title: The Confrontation
episodesList.summary: Sharat finds Anand and tells him a fabricated version of the truth, skipping on the part where he hit Naina. Anand furious meets Sameer and tries to talk him down, but instead he learns how deep and loyal Sameer’s love for Naina is, and what Sharat had actually done. Later Anand hears Preeti and Naina’s conversation.

episodesList.title: The Meeting
episodesList.summary: Anand and Naina visit Sharath's house, where Naina teaches a lesson to Sharath. Then, Anand informs Naina that he wants to meet Sameer. Naina hesitatingly calls up Sameer. Will Sameer agree to meet Anand?

episodesList.title: Anand Embraces Naina's Wishes
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina tell Anand the whole truth about their love story, and he understands their prespective. He agrees on Naina and Sameer’s future and assures them that if the world is against them, he will be with them.

episodesList.title: Leap of Faith
episodesList.summary: Munna gets furious with Naina as she keeps on breaking Sameer’s heart. Finally to prove her point Naina dares to take a jump. Munna and Sameer stop her somehow. After all the chaos it’s finally a happy time among the friends, but the college elections are coming soon.

episodesList.title: The New Rivalry
episodesList.summary: Sunaina confronts Sameer and Naina. Along with Karthik, Sunaina teases Sameer and Naina and thus begins a new rivalry. Rivalries aside, Sameer and Naina start their relationship afresh. Meanwhile, a family member returns to the Agarwal household.

episodesList.title: Seeds of Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Sunaina meets Swati and creates doubts in her mind about the friendship she shares with Naina, Sameer, Munna, and Pandit. Swati is unaware of the ploy Sunaina has hatched along with Karthik, which is to separate Swati from her friends.

episodesList.title: Resentment Builds
episodesList.summary: Swati gets hurts, as all of her friends put her name down from the election to push forward Naina’s name. She gets into a fight with Munna as well. Although she trusts Naina but deep down in her heart she knows that she is second in the list.

episodesList.title: The Sabotage
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Munna and Pandit spend all night preparing posters for Naina, and paste them in the college, the next day to their surprise all the posters get ruined. Someone from the inside has done it.

episodesList.title: A Friend in Need
episodesList.summary: Amidst the elections, Naina and Swati's friendship has taken back seat. Swati is feeling neglected as Naina is gearing up for a tough election. Sunaina wants to exploit Swati's vulnerability and thereby separate Naina and Swati. Will Naina save her friend?

episodesList.title: The Moonwalk Fever
episodesList.summary: Swati is being slowly driven away from Naina, without Naina realizing that she is losing her friend. As the elections are around the corner, the two groups are leaving no stone unturned.

episodesList.title: Swati Gets Sidelined
episodesList.summary: All is well between Sameer and Naina, but not for Swati. She feels neglected by Naina’s behavior, at the end she seeks refuge from Sunaina. When thing seems alright, they actually aren’t.

episodesList.title: The Winning Speech
episodesList.summary: Swati steals the notebook in which Naina has written her speech and hands it over to Sunaina. While addressing the students, Sunaina plagiarises the ideas of Naina. Sameer and Naina are left wondering about the person who might have betrayed them. Now, how will Naina bounce back and deliver her speech?

episodesList.title: Swati the Spy
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Pandit get the hint that Swati might be exposing Naina’s strategy to Sunaina. They devise a plan and Swati gets caught, but Naina stands with Swati and defend her.

episodesList.title: Who Will Swati Choose?
episodesList.summary: It’s finally election day, and all the kids and dropped their votes. Naina has given Swati the responsibility to look after the ballot box. Will Swati be righteous and stick with Naina or is she planning something else?

episodesList.title: The Results Are Out
episodesList.summary: Finally the election results are here and it’s a sad loss for Naina. Sunaina wins with a huge number of votes. Although Sameer claims that there has been a mishap with the votes but no one seems to belive him.

episodesList.title: What Has Swati Done?
episodesList.summary: The college principal has given the Naina just thirty minutes’ times to find the missing votes. Sameer and the gang start searching everywhere for the votes. Finally by a lucky accident Naina finds the missing votes from Swati’s bag.

episodesList.title: Naina Wins
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Munna, and Pandit find out about Swati's betrayal. The missing votes are produced before JBR and after counting, Naina is declared the winner. Munna refuses to forgive Swati but Naina stands beside her friend. Sunaina tries to break Swati and Naina's friendship. Will Swati let go of her best friend?

episodesList.title: First Day As The G.S
episodesList.summary: It’s Naina first day as the G.S in college, all goes well, and she even gets a new haircut. Excitement and joyous all the way, but Swati is a bit sad, there is still resentment deep seated in her heart.

episodesList.title: Naina Has Got Some Opposition
episodesList.summary: Sunaina and her group has now Swati with them, and they aren’t letting Naina breathe easy. Back at home there are more trouble waiting. But in the midst of it all Naina and Sameer’s love for each other stays strong.

episodesList.title: A Personal Victory
episodesList.summary: Naina bats for a sports team for girls. She faces opposition initially but succeeds in getting a nod for a girls sports team. Her friends are ecstatic to hear the news and consider it a personal victory for Naina. Meanwhile, Sunaina is jealous of Naina's victory and plans her next move to embarrass Naina.

episodesList.title: The Team Selection
episodesList.summary: While Naina is busy trying to bring in new players in her team, Sunaina is trying to disrupt the process. Nevertheless, Naina and Sameer manage to sign new players in the volleyball team. Later, Sameer tries to encourage girls to join the sports team. Will Sameer succeed?

episodesList.title: The Rising Star
episodesList.summary: Sameer succeeds in getting new players to join the volleyball team. Meanwhile, Arjun finds Shefali's photo in a magazine. The news that Shefali is a rising star reaches Bela and Taiji. Arjun tries to avoid the past to focus on this future.

episodesList.title: Naina Hits Rock Bottom
episodesList.summary: The whole world comes crashing, and Naina falls in the middle. A un-needed confrontation with the girls sports team makes her miss one of the important moments at her college, leading up to the head mistress getting insulted. While Sunaina and her gang plots a sabotage plan against Naina. It’s Naina against the whole world right now.

episodesList.title: Sunaina Crosses All Limits
episodesList.summary: When a simple negation for the G.S was enough, Sunaina is just not letting Naina breathe easy. Insult after insult, trying to put her down in whatever way possible. Arjun starts his new job today and things are still a little unclear to him.

episodesList.title: The Challenge
episodesList.summary: Sunaina has challenged Naina, that if she can somehow talk the principal to organize the Navaratri function, then Sunaina will do the unthinkable and replace all the posters for Naina. Naina falls sick and Sameer gets worried.

episodesList.title: The Three Magical Words
episodesList.summary: It’s Ganesh Puja and at Naina’s no one is home. Naina takes this opportunity to ring up Sameer and claim her love for him. Ganesh Puja has taken everyone’s ease and from the entire neighborhood, everyone wants to be present for the moment.

episodesList.title: The Sweet Escape
episodesList.summary: When a nice gesture from Sameer turns out to scare Naina, it’s all in the name of love. Sameer picks up Naina’s medicine and tries to deliver it to her, mid-night. But Anand might get a glimpse of both of them.

episodesList.title: Rules for Dandiya Raas
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Munna, and Pandit convince the principal to let the students celebrate Navratri and organize Dandiya Raas. Though the principal allows students to organize Dandiya Raas, she sets the rules that girls and boys should play Dandiya Raas separately, and asks Naina to make sure the rules are followed.

episodesList.title: The Challenge
episodesList.summary: Sameer wants Karthik and Sunaina to apologize and put up the posters around the college. But, Sunaina refuses to do it as the principal has allowed girls and boys to play Dandiya separately. Sameer accepts this challenge and informs that girls and boys will play Dandiya together. However, Naina doesn't want to break the rules.

episodesList.title: The Question Paper
episodesList.summary: While Sameer and Naina are talking to each other, Karthik photographs them and decides to give these photographs to the principal. Meanwhile, Sameer, Munna, and Pandit stumble upon exam question paper. Will Sameer take the question paper?

episodesList.title: The Chief Guest
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Munna, and Pandit learn that the principal is infatuated with singer Kumar Sanu. In order to impress the principal, and in an attempt to have the girls and boys perform Dandiya together, Sameer decides to get Kumar Sanu as the chief guest.

episodesList.title: The Photographs
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer win the challenge and force Karthik and Sunaina to put up the posters around the college. The photographs given for development are here and it turns out that the image was not captured on the reel. Karthik and Sunaina's plan turns out to be a dud, leaving them red-faced.

episodesList.title: Dandiya Preparations
episodesList.summary: The principal is eager to find out if Kumar Sanu is really attending the Dandiya. Sameer and friends begin preparations for Dandiya. As a punishment, Naina asks Sameer to wear the dress of her choice. Why did Naina want to punish Sameer?

episodesList.title: The Dandiya Evening
episodesList.summary: Naina and Preeti are dressed up for an evening of Dandiya. Sameer, Munna, and Pandit are also all set for Dandiya. Meanwhile, Sunaina and Karthik are planning to humiliate Naina and Sameer. Fortunately, Sameer overhears this conversation and learns about their plan.

episodesList.title: A Fun-Filled Evening
episodesList.summary: Sameer asks Munna and Pandit not to talk about Sunaina's plan with Naina as it might ruin the evening. The celebrations begin and the students play Garba. Sunaina and Karthik wait for the moment where they get an opportunity to humiliate Naina in front of everyone, unaware that Sameer already knows their plan.

episodesList.title: Kumar Sanu is Here
episodesList.summary: Sunaina finds a reason to humiliate Naina. Swati learns about Sunaina and Karthik's plan and decides to help Naina. Meanwhile, Kumar Sanu arrives and the principal is searching for Naina as she was supposed to welcome the singer. What has happened to Naina?

episodesList.title: The Celebration Continues
episodesList.summary: While Kumar Shanu performs his hits back to back. Sunaina devises a cruel plan to trick Naina and Sameer. They are in the verge of getting in trouble once again.

episodesList.title: The Plot Thickens
episodesList.summary: As chief guest Kumar Shanu leaves after his grand show, Sameer and Naina are nowhere to be found. When the principal find them inside her office, nothing can stop her from punishing them. While Sunaina successfully tricks Naina in the worst way possible, it’s time for revenge.

episodesList.title: Friends to the Rescue
episodesList.summary: Right when Sunaina and Karthik believe they have claimed victory against Sameer and Naina, Munna-Pandit come to the rescue. Thanks to Munna-Pandit, the principal learns that it was Karthik's plan to humiliate Sameer and Naina. Meanwhile, Sameer's mother decides to surprise her son and pay her a visit.

episodesList.title: The Surprise
episodesList.summary: Naina and Preeti return home and are surprised to find a stranger sleeping in their room. The stranger turns out to be Juhi, their relative. Naina and Preeti are surprised to know that Juhi is an air hostess. Meanwhile, Sameer returns home and meets his mother. With Juhi's arrival, what new twists await the Agarwal household?

episodesList.title: The Punishment
episodesList.summary: Naina asks the principal to suspend Karthik for a week. Sunaina believes that Karthik will be saved as his father is influential. But, Sunaina is proved wrong and Karthik ends up getting suspended for a week. Now that Karthik will be paying a price for his mistakes, Naina and Sameer are relieved. But, as college holidays are around the corner, Naina and Sameer are concerned whether they will be able to meet during the holidays.

episodesList.title: Sameer Opens Up
episodesList.summary: It's the festive time in the household, and Sameer and Naina are on vacation. While the meetings have become rare but their love hasn't. Later when Sameer's mom asks him about his love life, Sameer tells his mom about Naina.

episodesList.title: The Anticipation
episodesList.summary: When Sameer tells his mom about Naina, her first reaction is to meet Naina in person, but when poor Naina hear about this, her anxiety breaks all bounds. Excitement and nervousness, it all comes in a package. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: The First Meeting
episodesList.summary: It's time when Naina meets Sameer's mom. Butterflies in the stomach and Niana can't wait. While Sameer's mom has her fair share of doubts, only time will tell what happens next.

episodesList.title: Naina's Interview
episodesList.summary: Naina is nervous ahead of her meeting with Sameer's mother. Sameer wants this meeting to go well. Naina finds it hard to control her anxiety in front of Sameer's mother, who has a set of questions to ask Naina. Will Naina pass this interview and impress her future mother-in-law?

episodesList.title: A Mother Knows Best
episodesList.summary: Sameer's mom disapproves of Naina. While her claims are exactly true, but Sameer's heart just won't listen to any of that. there is a new professor at the college and someone has a crush.

episodesList.title: The Drama Competition
