episodesList.summary: There is a new professor at VJN college, a drama teacher and he has organized an audition for the kids. Now only time will tell who'll be the hero and who'll be the heroine.

episodesList.title: Rejected
episodesList.summary: The students audition for various roles for the play. Poonawala has high standards and expects only the best. Many students get rejected till Sameer's turn to audition arrives. Sameer auditions in a unique way but Poonawala rejects him. Naina is enraged at Poonawala and expresses her displeasure to him. Instead of venting out his anger on Naina, Poonawala offers the lead role to Naina.

episodesList.title: Who's The Hero?
episodesList.summary: While Naina decides to quit the play as Sameer has gotten rejected, but all hell breaks loose when she overhears the Principal, putting a lot of faith on Naina. Now Naina is the heroine, but whos the hero?

episodesList.title: The Big Fight
episodesList.summary: Sameer gets upset that Naina has said yes for the role, and opposite to her is Karthik. Well, the world shakes and Naina, Sameer gets apart. A little issue turns into a big fight.

episodesList.title: The Elusive Apology
episodesList.summary: Munna, Pandit, and Preeti conspire to resolve the differences between Sameer and Naina. However, Sameer and Naina, instead of calling a truce, end their fierce debate with the question: who will apologize first? Meanwhile, the preparations for the play is in full swing but Naina is somewhat missing Sameer. Will Naina and Sameer resolve their differences anytime soon?

episodesList.title: Flames Of Jealousy
episodesList.summary: Sameer is super frustrated with Naina, as she is opposite to Karthik in the college play. Full of jealousy he fakes an accident to grab Naina's attention. Soon Naina reveals to Sameer that she and Karthik are playing a brother-sister duo.

episodesList.title: Lights Camera Action
episodesList.summary: It's the day of the inter-college drama event and Naina is preparing for her scene. While there are some last minute changes in the script Naina isn't holding back, but a new twist is waiting to emerge.

episodesList.title: Three Forbidden Words
episodesList.summary: Naina's fate is just so unforgiving, Karthik spoils the end with hugging Naina in front of the audience inappropriately. Sameer gets agitated. Later when Naina tries to calm Sameer down, Taiji gets a glimpse of the scene and hears her saying "I love you" to Sameer. Things get more interesting now.

episodesList.title: The Suspicion
episodesList.summary: Taiji suspects that Naina is having an affair and decides to search her room to find some clues. Meanwhile, Sameer is still upset with Naina and refuses to answer her phone. When Naina pays a visit to the temple, she hopes that Sameer will meet her. Taiji, on the other hand, is hoping to catch Naina red-handed.

episodesList.title: The Acting Offer
episodesList.summary: Taiji learns that Naina visits the temple every Monday with a boy. While her attempts to find out the identity of the boy fails, she hasn't given up just yet. Meanwhile, the principal calls up Anand and informs that Naina has received acting offers. Anand ecstatically informs Naina about the news but she is worried about Taiji's opinion.

episodesList.title: Sameer Steps Back
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer's fight is on the brink of an explosion. While Sameer is totally accusing Naina of whatever happened between her and Karthik. Naina is slowly crumbling inside. In the midst of it, all the college Principal catches Sameer with Naina red-handed.

episodesList.title: Love Comes At A Price
episodesList.summary: The Principal as caught Sameer red-handed, but favorably missed Naina by a glimpse. Now the Principal has given Sammer two choices, either to tell her the girl's name or to skip a year in his study.

episodesList.title: The Worthy
episodesList.summary: It's time for the exams and Naina is full on prepared for it. While Sammer is skipping his exams this year, Naina is totally unaware of this. Taiji's snooping continues, as she finds a locket under Naina's pillow.

episodesList.title: The Results Are Out
episodesList.summary: While Naina has topped the class, Sameer is marked absent in the results. Naina is shocked to see Sameer's results and confronts him about it. Sameer finally reveals that he had to sacrifice his studies in order to protect Naina's identity from the principal. What will Naina do next?

episodesList.title: The Lie
episodesList.summary: Sameer lies to Anand about his marks in the exam. Vishakha overhears this conversation and believes that Sameer has passed the exams. Then, Sunaina pays a visit to Sameer's house and spills the beans about Sameer's result.

episodesList.title: The Tough Choice
episodesList.summary: Vishakha learns from Naina the reason behind Sameer's absence in the exams. Vishakha holds Naina responsible for Sameer's failure and asks him to either choose between her or Naina. Meanwhile, Anand is all set to leave for the US and spends the last few moments with his family.

episodesList.title: Naina Against The World
episodesList.summary: While Anand is leaving the country for his work, Taiji and Naina's dad find Naina and Sameer in the worst situation possible. Love has its complexities and pitfalls and unfortunately, Naina's life has started slipping through.

episodesList.title: Is This The End?
episodesList.summary: Taiji and Naina's dad has caught Naina and Sameer red-handed. They drag Naina home and starts beating her black and blue, and finally they decide to get Naina married to Sharat on the very same day.

episodesList.title: Saving Naina
episodesList.summary: Taiji and Rakesh force Naina into getting married. Sameer and his friends learn that Naina is being taken to the temple. When Rakesh makes a stop to purchase a few items, Sameer manages to convince Bela to let Naina come with him. What will be the repercussions of this event?

episodesList.title: The Aftermath
episodesList.summary: While Sameer and Naina are contemplating their future course of action, an enraged Rakesh barges into Sameer's house. Unable to find Sameer, Rakesh unleashes his wrath on Sameer's relatives. Sameer and Naina have the support of their friends who are standing beside them through thick and thin.

episodesList.title: Too Late To Apologise
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are waiting for Anand to land so they can go back home. At Naina's, Taiji and Rakesh are going insane and are on the edge of filing a missing person's report. Vishakha hurries back as well to find what has happened to his son. Thing's aren't looking all that well.

episodesList.title: Chasing A Dream
episodesList.summary: Anand arrives to see a distorted family. He gets furious with Naina, not giving her a chance to clear her part. Now what will happen is up to Anand and Naina.

episodesList.title: Forgiveness
episodesList.summary: Vishakha isn't happy with the way the situation has unfolded and wants Sameer to stay away from Naina. Meanwhile, Anand is still disappointed with Naina. Bela reveals the truth to Anand and makes him realize the pressure Naina was under when she ran away with Sameer. Will Anand forgive Naina after learning the truth?

episodesList.title: Moment Of Relief
episodesList.summary: When Anand learns what actually happened with Naina, he rushes to meet Sameer and talk to him about Naina and Sameer's marriage. Vishakha is very unhappy with whatever is going on.

episodesList.title: Naina's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Anand with his convincing power has made Taiji and the rest of the family say yes to meet Sameer's family. Meanwhile, Vishakha's husband is planning something else.

episodesList.title: The Moment Has Arrived
episodesList.summary: The moment Naina and Sameer have been waiting for has finally arrived. Sameer's parents are visiting Naina's house to finalize the marriage between Naina and Sameer. Naina is nervous ahead of the meeting and is unsure how the meeting will turn out.

episodesList.title: Dejection
episodesList.summary: Naina is eagerly awaiting the moment when she will meet Sameer's parents but the moment never arrives. Sameer's parents never bring up Sameer and Naina's marriage for discussion. As Anand tries to raise the topic of marriage, Sameer's parents leave without discussing it.

episodesList.title: Love Has No Limit
episodesList.summary: Finally, Sameer has convinced his mother and the rest of his family to meet with Naina's household again, and this time he wants them to ask for Naina's hand in marriage.

episodesList.title: Sameer Wins
episodesList.summary: Sameer’s parents finalize the marriage after being pressurized by Sameer. Naina is curious to find out how Sameer managed to convince his parents. Taiji and Rakesh are irritated after finding that Naina’s marriage has been fixed without their consent.

episodesList.title: Baby Steps
episodesList.summary: Taiji tries to poison Naina's mind, putting negative thoughts into her, but Naina and Sameer's love is stronger than that. Naina's household visit Sameer's.

episodesList.title: The Final Meeting
episodesList.summary: While the two families meet each other. Naina's heart is jumping out of her chest. The trouble starts when their bloodlines do not match each other and the Pandit says something uncanny.

episodesList.title: The Date Is Fixed
episodesList.summary: Anand breaks the superstitious vows and finally says yes to Sameer's family. While both the families are a bit tensed but nothing can stop Naina and Sameer from being together.

episodesList.title: The Engagement Ring
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina are overjoyed about their engagement and are in a dilemma about choosing the engagement ring. Meanwhile, Rakesh and Taiji are displeased with the engagement. Rakesh lashes out at Sameer's mother while choosing the venue for the engagement. This leads to differences between the two families.

episodesList.title: The Differences
episodesList.summary: Taiji is unhappy with Naina’s engagement with Sameer and wants to get the engagement canceled at any cost. Meanwhile, Sameer is enraged at his parents for creating differences between them and Naina’s family. Sameer’s parents agree to get the engagement done as per the terms set by Rakesh.

episodesList.title: Money Matters
episodesList.summary: No matter what Sammer's family says in front of everybody, but even they dislike the fact that Naina's family isn't as affluent as theirs. Vishakha and Sammer's aunt says some nasty stuff about Naina and she, unfortunately, overhears it.

episodesList.title: The Distraction
episodesList.summary: When Vishakha hears that Naina has told Sameer about the little incident that happened earlier, she gets furious with Sameer and blames Naina for all of this. The mood for celebration has arrived, and everyone is preparing for the wedding.

episodesList.title: When Two Becomes One
episodesList.summary: The special occasion has arrived, when Naina and Sameer's name will be bound as one. Naina and Sameer are excited to the brim. However Sameer's family is still disproving Sameer's choice, and how badly off, Naina's family are.

episodesList.title: The Missing Ring
episodesList.summary: On the all-important occasion, Bela is in a state of panic after failing to find the ring. Her attempts to find the ring fails and Rakesh blames Bela for misplacing the ring. Finally, the ring is discovered but Sameer's parents haven't had enough and continue to mock Naina and her family.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Promise
episodesList.summary: Sameer notices that Naina has felt bad about the demeaning comments from his relatives and decides to set things right. Sameer makes a promise to Naina in front of the gathering that he will never leave her. Bela is overwhelmed and in tears after hearing Sameer's kind words. However, Sameer's parents aren't happy about it.

episodesList.title: Congratulations
episodesList.summary: Love is in the air, Naina and Sameer are finally together. Their marriage ceremony is a full blast. In midst of all the lights and smiles, Sameer's family keeps disapproving and demeaning Nanai's household in every step of the way. Seems like money means more than love to them.

episodesList.title: Humour Turns Into Humility
episodesList.summary: A simple stand up from Sameer's uncle and aunt turns into insults after insults, about Naina's father, their social status. Rakesh doesn't back down and prepares for an opposition, but for Naina and Sameer this might be the end.

episodesList.title: Clash Of The Egos
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina are on the edge of their relationship, with limitless family pressure to break up with each other. While Rakesh wants Vishakha to apologize, Vishkha wants the same.

episodesList.title: Dirty Tricks
episodesList.summary: While both Sameer and Naina are expecting their families to end the fight. Sameer overhears his uncle talking with Naina's uncle about how happy they are that Naina and Sameer are together no more. Sammer's frustration crosses the limit.

episodesList.title: Anand Learns the Truth
episodesList.summary: Sameer is furious about what his Uncle did and creates a mess at his home. Anand is informed about this conspiracy by Sameer and Anand confronts Tauji resulting is an exchange of arguments.

episodesList.title: Anand's Promise
episodesList.summary: Tauji doesn't approve of the marriage but Anand assures Sameer and Naina that he will get them married. Naina and Sameer's friends come in support for the marriage and take on the responsibilities that the elders should have. Meanwhile, Sameer decides to leave home if Kamlesh doesn't stop creating problems for his wedding.

episodesList.title: Sameer Leaves His House
episodesList.summary: Sameer decides to leave his house even though Kamlesh tries to persuade him to stay. Munna invites Sameer to his house and asks him to stay with him. Sameer feels Munna's father isn't happy about his stay. Meanwhile, Naina is unaware of the storm raging through Sameer's life and Sameer doesn't want her to find out about it. But, for how long can Sameer keep it a secret?

episodesList.title: Separation Anxiety
episodesList.summary: Sameer is taking a big step to be on his own. Naina is on his side, but Sameer's family has totally changed their faces, no support, no communication. Will Sameer and Naina be able to do this on their own?

episodesList.title: Insecurities
episodesList.summary: Naina learns that Sameer is leaving his house. Sameer is supported in his decision by Naina and Anand. Kamlesh calls up Munna's father and informs him that Sameer is staying in his house. Bela overhears Taiji's conversation and begins to feel insecure about Preeti's future.

episodesList.title: Slow Poison
episodesList.summary: Bela gets the idea from Taiji that if Naina is marrying someone outside her caste, Preti will face problems getting a suitable groom. Munna's father tells Sameer on his face to move out. Sameer finalizes the contract for his new house.

episodesList.title: A Big Sacrifice
episodesList.summary: When Naina understands why Bela is so annoyed, she calls up Sameer and both of them confess to Bela that they won't get married before Preeti.

episodesList.title: Power Of Love
episodesList.summary: Sameer agrees to listen to what Bela had to say, and things seem alright for a moment. The bond between Sameer and Naina grow stronger. Kamlesh pays a visit to Sameer.

episodesList.title: Wedding Bells
episodesList.summary: The wedding is around the corner and Naina is excited about it. The wedding cards have been printed and the relatives have started arriving for the big wedding. But, amidst the happiness, there is also broken relations. Tauji has refused to attend the wedding and Rakesh too isn't pleased about the whole event.

episodesList.title: The Mistake
episodesList.summary: Sameer hands over the wedding cards to Naina's family members. Rakesh is shocked after seeing the wedding cards and creates a scene in front of the family members. Rakesh reveals the reason and informs that on the wedding card his name has been printed as 'Late Rakesh Agarwal'. Rakesh is dejected and vows to never attend Naina's wedding.

episodesList.title: Switching Sides
episodesList.summary: Taiji finds Sameer's mistake as an opportunity to drive Rakesh away from her own daughter's wedding. The festive mood might be set, but Anand and Sameer try their best to convince Rakesh.

episodesList.title: Shopping Session
episodesList.summary: Sameer plans his honeymoon trip with Naina and his friends chime in. Bela, Preeti and Naina fo out for shopping, intimate wear and Sameer lands on the same store. It's humiliation to another level.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Plans
episodesList.summary: Bela and Preeti humiliate Naina for the incident which happened and make fun of her. Naina asks Sameer about the honeymoon plans he is making for them. But Sameer keep a condition for telling her the plan for honeymoon. What will happen next? Stay tuned!

episodesList.title: A New Chapter Of Life
episodesList.summary: Vishakha has come all the way to meet Sameer. Sameer and Naina get saved by a slight inch from the police. Rakesh denies attending Naina's wedding but when there is a will there is a way.

episodesList.title: The Preparations
episodesList.summary: All is set and Sameer is setting up his new house for Naina. Naina is still going through the withdrawal, as she is leaving her house. Rakesh gets sensitive about not attending Naina's marriage. Now only time will tell how this goes forward.

episodesList.title: Haldi Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The Haldi Ceremony is about to begin and Sameer and his friends are excited about it. But, Sameer's happiness turns into shock when Munna and Pandit notice a scar on Sameer's neck. Meanwhile, Taiji and Tauji have made sure the relatives and Rakesh won't be attending Naina's marriage until Anand doesn't apologize to them.

episodesList.title: Celebrations Begin
episodesList.summary: The Haldi Ceremony carries on and the family members celebrate the occasion. Sameer's aunt humiliates him by revealing the scar on Sameer's neck. The scar is mistaken to be a love bite and Vishakha calls up Bela and asks her to teach manners to Naina.

episodesList.title: The Big Day
episodesList.summary: It's the day before the wedding and all are at the chaos, a perfect scenario where people are running about, hosts trying to accommodate guests. It's just happiness all around. Midst of it, Sameer's household try to bring Naina down, with the claim that her father is not present on this occasion.

episodesList.title: The Sangeet Ceremony
episodesList.summary: The henna ceremony is going on and Sameer's mother applying henna on his hand and mother and son share a moment of happiness and joy. Meanwhile, Sameer gets an idea from his mother on how to call Naina's father for the marriage.

episodesList.title: The Surprise
episodesList.summary: Sameer takes the help of his principal to convince Rakesh to attend the wedding. Meanwhile, Naina is waiting for Sameer and is clueless that Sameer is making sure Rakesh doesn't miss the Sangeet Ceremony. When Rakesh finally arrives, Naina's happiness knows no bounds.

episodesList.title: Celebrating Love
episodesList.summary: Preeti and Pooja present on stage the performances by the Agarwal and Maheshwari family members. The moment the Agarwal family has waited for is finally being realized as they celebrate togetherness in Naina's sangeet ceremony. One by one, Naina's family members deliver emotional performances on stage. Sameer and Naina aren't left behind and they too celebrate being together.

episodesList.title: The Calm Before The Storm
episodesList.summary: Celebration and love all around, everyone seems so happy with Naina and Sameer's wedding. Even Rakesh is present on this beautiful day, and Naina is elated that things are okay with her dad. Later a big storm heads their way, the weather disappoints them, but the marriage will be a success.

episodesList.title: Nothing Will Stop Naina And Sameer
episodesList.summary: The huge storm has come, and all the open air preparations are going to waste. Anand tries his best to manage the situation as much as he could, but nothing against nature. Tai ji becomes elated that her wishes to stop the marriage is coming true, but Naina and Sameer are stuck to the will.

episodesList.title: The Big Day Approaches
episodesList.summary: The family members are relieved that the rain has finally stopped. As the family member rejoice and renew their faith in God, another problem arises. The horse on which Sameer was supposed to arrive at the wedding has been canceled at the last moment. Munna and Pandit try to book a new horse but find it difficult.

episodesList.title: The Bad Hairdo
episodesList.summary: Sameer has to battle Kartik and his team in a kabaddi match. The two teams engage in an intense match while Naina is busy getting ready. The day turns out to be the worst for Naina has she gets a bad hairdo. Naina is in a state of panic when the hairdresser informs that she can't do anything about the hair. What will Naina do now?

episodesList.title: The Time Has Come
episodesList.summary: Naina's hair and Sameer's injury make them delayed for the wedding, but when there is a will there has to be a way. Vishakha supports Sameer, and even when the rest of the family try to make a mishap.

episodesList.title: Two Becomes One
episodesList.summary: A new chapter in Sameer and Naina's life, the day they've been dreaming about is finally here. it's the wedding day. Gold and glitter all around, smiles and laughter surround.

episodesList.title: The Union
episodesList.summary: It's the final day of the wedding, everyone is super excited and elated that Sameer and Naina are getting married. In the middle of all the celebration Taiji plans a nasty move to take Rakesh out of Naina's wedding.

episodesList.title: Unspoken Affirmations
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina are at it again with their cute and mischevious attitude. While Taiji calls up Rakesh, claiming that Arjun is in trouble. Her whole plan all along was to make Rakesh miss Naina's wedding.

episodesList.title: The Tough Decision
episodesList.summary: Munna is heartbroken after finding out that Swati has been engaged. Meanwhile, Anand gets a call from Rakesh, who informs him that he won't be attending the wedding. Anand requests Rakesh to perform the rituals at the wedding, but Rakesh has a condition to be fulfilled. Why isn't Rakesh attending the wedding?

episodesList.title: Just Married
episodesList.summary: Naina asks Anand not to go to Taiji's house and request Rakesh to attend the wedding. As the wedding rituals are taking place, Rakesh watches without anyone noticing his presence. Bela confronts Rakesh and asks him to perform the rituals. Rakesh reveals his situation and the pressure he is in thanks to Taiji and Tauji. The wedding rituals are finally completed and Naina and Sameer are officially married.

episodesList.title: The Happy Farewell
episodesList.summary: It's time for Naina to leave her family and become a Maheshwari. Sadness touches all, but Naina is happy that she has finally married the one she loves. Vishakha's husband doesn't seem to be pleased with the events at all.

episodesList.title: Naina's First Night
episodesList.summary: Now that Naina and Sameer are happily married, they are excited to be in the same room together, but as per the rituals, a bride must stay all by her self the first night if her marriage. Now, this event has to be a little more exciting than this.

episodesList.title: Misunderstanding
episodesList.summary: Naina and Preeti are missing eachother and Preeti decides to call up Naina. Bela snatches the phone from Preeti's hands and asks her not to speak with Naina at the moment. But, Preeti gets a call from Naina, who is also dearly missing Preeti. Later, Sameer wakes up Naina and decides to show his room to her. The family members find Sameer and Naina together and misrepresent the entire incident.

episodesList.title: Wake Up Sameer
episodesList.summary: A new day begins for Naina in her new home and she gets ready to perform the rituals. Meanwhile, Preeti is dearly missing her sister, Naina, who is finding it difficult to handle the situation in Sameer's absence. When Naina is asked to get ready, she is afraid how the family will react seeing her hair and wishes Sameer was with her but unfortunately, Sameer is having a sound sleep in his room.

episodesList.title: The Settled Life
episodesList.summary: It's Naina and Sameer's first day and all of the women relatives are here for the customs. Naina is still worried about her bad hairdo.

episodesList.title: The Trouble Never Stops
episodesList.summary: When the time arrives for the Mu Dikhai custom, Sameer picks up Naina on his arms and Nanina's cloak falls. The bad hairdo becomes a joke for everyone. Naina feels insecure and lost, and in this time of need, Sameer isn't much of a support for her.

episodesList.title: The Halwa Tragedy
episodesList.summary: As per the new custom of a bride, Naina is supposed to make Halwa for everyone in the house and in doing so, Sameer and Naina's aunt are worried about she being able to take care of it alone or not and in this caring attitude they add a lot of extra sugar in the Halwa.

episodesList.title: An Upset Sameer
episodesList.summary: After seeing what Naina has done with her hair, Sameer is upset and is trying to enquire in different salons on how can it be fixed. He gets to know that nothing can be done before three months of getting that style and decides to cancel his honeymoon. What will Sameer do?

episodesList.title: The Chaos
episodesList.summary: After Naina has lost her Mangalsutra, the whole house is looking for it. Sameer's mother calls up at Naina's place to find out when will they leave from there. Sameer asks Naina to recollect where has she kept it, in turn suggests her to find it in a secret place. Will Naina find the mangalsutra?

episodesList.title: The Honeymoon Plans
episodesList.summary: Good news all around, Sameer and Naina become a new aunt and uncle, and their honeymoon vacation is right around the corner. While everyone is happy and elated, Sameer has to choose between Vishkha and Naina.

episodesList.title: Naina's First Flight
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are on their way to their ultimate honeymoon destination. Naina is anxious and excited for the flight, it's her first time by air. She makes a scene in the plane and annoys Sameer with her cute and weird ways.

episodesList.title: Love Is In The Air
episodesList.summary: As Sameer and Naina settle down, after the flight, Sameer isn't happy with anything, the hotel, the services even Naina's hair, but the fun has begun.

episodesList.title: Honeymoon Blues
episodesList.summary: The honeymoon has started for Sameer and Naina and it's not what they had planned. They meet a couple who sarcastically try to mock Naina, but they don't care about it and enjoy amongst themselves. Back in the hotel room, things might just get out of hands for Naina and Sameer.

episodesList.title: Naive Naina
episodesList.summary: Sameer is upset with Naina, that she doesn't even know what people do in their honeymoon. Back at home, Taiji's husband collapses on the ground and Anand stays unaware of the tiny accident. Both of them make a huge scene and give Anand an ultimatum.

episodesList.title: Unsettled Love
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer go for a toy-train ride through the beautiful hills of Ooty. Finally, Sameer arranges a special dance for Naina, but she makes a mess with her shoes and the miss the beautiful chance to dance. Sameer gets upset with Naina.

episodesList.title: Romantic Breakfast
episodesList.summary: After all the mishap which has happened, Sameer is pissed with Naina and scolds her for the stupidity she has done. Naina is really embarassed after being scolded upon. To make up for the rude behaviour of his, Sameer organises a very romantic breakfast for Naina.

episodesList.title: Sameer Is Annoyed
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina are out to have some fun in the city but as Naina has got cold and fever she keeps sneezing and her sneezing has annoyed Sameer to the core and then they have an argument. What will this argument result to?

episodesList.title: The Tiff
episodesList.summary: Sameer calls up Taiji and expresses his displeasure for the situation she put Naina under. The next day, Sameer and Naina go sightseeing. Naina's dress is torn while walking in the coffee plantations. Sameer is annoyed with Naina and the two quarrel about their not so happening trip. Will Sameer and Naina's trip turn out to be memorable?

episodesList.title: Home Sweet Home
episodesList.summary: Sameer sees a stranger lurking around the room and calls the security. Naina appreciates Sameer and the two resolve their differences. Sameer and Naina finally return home and find that Naina switched off the fridge, which has resulted in a stench in the house.

episodesList.title: Anand's Trip
episodesList.summary: Anand announces to Bela and Preeti that he is going to get another chance to go to America and this time he wouldn't be going alone and is taking Bela with her for a long duration of three months. Sarla overhears their conversation and is jealous of it.

episodesList.title: Dreams And Reality
episodesList.summary: While troubling each other, Naina spills water on aunts face and she is not happy about it. She screams at Naina for being reckless in the house and criticises her for being like this as she has never been in a house this big. Sameer apologises for the fault.

episodesList.title: The Pearl Necklace
episodesList.summary: Both Sameer and Naina are preparing for their respective exams. Elsewhere, Anand's elder brother calls Anand and asks him to get all the jewllery that Bina had received from her mother-in-law, so that they can be divided too. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Conspiracy Over A Necklace
episodesList.summary: Naina starts mocking Sameer of not even able to fit a gas cylinder while he mocks her back and they start having a funny fight. Meanwhile Anand's elder brother asks Anand to get the necklace back which he gave to Naina and his new family as a present or else they will tell their family that they got the necklace out of theft.

episodesList.title: Sameer And Naina's Lifestyle
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina spend the night in the lawn as they loose their keys. Kaanchi bhaiya comes and wakes them up and tells Naina that he like to work at their place more than any other household. That's when Naina realises that their lifestyle is quite unique from other people.

episodesList.title: Preeti's Father Has A Deadline
episodesList.summary: Preeti's Father recieves a deadline from his elder brother formpaying him an amount of fift thousand by today evening which he had no option other than agreeing with it. Sameer lies to Naina and goes off watching a cricket match.

episodesList.title: The Problems Of A Girl
episodesList.summary: Sameer to seek forgiveness, wakes up early and is ready before Naina is up. Naina is suffereing from her periods and is very shy in talking about it to Sameer. She goes to the market alone for the pads and no matter whatsoever, Sameer has no clue about what has happend to Naina.

episodesList.title: The New Year Plan
episodesList.summary: Now that the exams are over and new year is on the brink, Naina plans for the new year eve when suddenly, Mamaji who was supposed to come tomorrow for dinner at their place, are coming tonight itself and Naina has gone into panic mode.

episodesList.title: Things Get Worse
episodesList.summary: Now that Anand and his wife and Sameer's uncle are there to have dinner, Naina did her best of what she could do, but then things don't go as planned and Mamaji criticises Naina and instead of defending Naina, Sameer scolds her.

episodesList.title: The Differences
episodesList.summary: Now after the havoc which Kamlesh created about the shabbiness of the house, there's a rift between Sameer and Naina. Both of them are arguing about every small thing. What will this result to?

episodesList.title: Sameer's New Beginning
episodesList.summary: Naina is daydreaming about Sameer and their romance. Sameer has a new beginning as he is joining his uncle's company to work.

episodesList.title: Anand Pays off His Debts
episodesList.summary: Naina taunts Sameer by serving him money for breakfat as she thinks he has a habit of wasting it. Anand pays his brother the amount he owed him and sks his brother to give him in writing that he has recieved the amount incase it comes up in the future.

episodesList.title: Anand Faces Humiliation
episodesList.summary: Anand's elder brother get to know from Kamlesh that Anand got fifty thousnad rupees from Sameer. He then decides to humiliate Anand infront of the whole society. Elsewhere, Naina and Sameer are having an argument about their household supplies.

episodesList.title: Changes In Life
episodesList.summary: After the long argument, Naina decides to leave the house, but doesn't leave and stays. Anand has decided to leave the house where he was living and has decided not to inform Naina about it. Sameer visits the offce and lets his uncle and Divyang know who's the boss!

episodesList.title: Sameer Seperated From The Business
episodesList.summary: Sameer had an argument with Divyang and his Mama decided to seperate the firm and asks Sameer to run his own share and accuses him of learning nothing while his tenure. Will he get over this, stay tuned for more.

episodesList.title: Naina Goes To Chacha's Place
episodesList.summary: Naina's chacha comes to pick Naina up from Sameer and her house to take her to his place. Sameer and Naina are both upset by that fact but are also angry and upset with each other.

episodesList.title: Manoj's Proposal
episodesList.summary: As Manoj and his father with Sameer and one other friend have gone to the girls house for Manoj's marriage proposal, they find the girl very cute and even the girl says yes. But the twist in the story is that the girl says yes for Sameer. What will happen next?

episodesList.title: Sameer Gets Emotional Before Party
episodesList.summary: Sameer before arriving at party becomes emotional upon thinking about Naina. But later both meet at party and have short conversation and in between that Sameer notices the zip of Naina's dress was open and he helps her closing well.

episodesList.title: Opening Up
episodesList.summary: The confrontation starts amongst the two of them and they start arguing. Manoj scolds Sameer and tells him about how people used to praise their love and now, look at them both. Both, Sameer and Naina go their respective houses and open up in their confidants. What's next?

episodesList.title: Naina Meets With An Accident
episodesList.summary: Naina is worried because she left Sameer when he needed her the most. While she is searching for a rickshaw to go back to her house, a car hits her on the road. Sameer's mother tells him that he is incomplete without Naina and he must tell her everything that happened at the factory truthfully.

episodesList.title: The Buisness Chaos
episodesList.summary: After Sameer's uncle throws him out of the business, he and Naina are in a tough spot. Bela gives this news to her husband who is shocked to hear this. Sameer's mother offers him and Naina to come live with her in Delhi.

episodesList.title: Anand's Advise
episodesList.summary: After the mishap in Naina and Sameer's life, Anand gives some advise to Naina and Sameer regarding what to do next in business. He asks Sameer to take up a job as insurance policy seller and asks Naina to open up a boutique.

episodesList.title: The Saree Exhibition
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina set up a Saree exhibition with their family. Sameer tries to control his anger when his uncle comes in at the exhibition. His uncle tells him that if he can sell more than two dresses he himself will come and work as a salesman for him.

episodesList.title: Things Go Downhill
episodesList.summary: When the day after the exhibition no one shows up at Naina and Sameer's boutique they both get tensed. Finally, when two customers show up at their boutique the volcano of happiness erupts for both Naina and Sameer, but when they get to know that both of those customers were sent by Kamlesh, things go downhill fast.

episodesList.title: Love Is Crazy
episodesList.summary: Naina is upset because of Sameer and she doesn't even eat food. When Sameer pressurizes her to eat she gets even more upset and tells him that she won't eat. Sameer tells her that he will keep standing there until and unless she doesn't eat, Naina tells him to keep standing. Sameer stands there for 2 hours.

episodesList.title: Sameer In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Sameer's world goes in a whirlpool when Munna tells Naina that Sameer is taking the measurement for female clothes. Naina is angry looking at Sameer take the measurements of girls to sew their clothes. When acustomer comes again and again and asks Sameer to take the measurements, he gets into deep trouble.

episodesList.title: Preeti's Life
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer after reading a lot of letters from Preeti have known a lot about Mumbai. Naina reads out a letter from Preeti stating about how her life has been in Mumbai. The letter also states about her mother-in-law in comparison to her mother.

episodesList.title: Dream On
episodesList.summary: After the shoot starts in Sameer and Naina's mansion, Sameer on seeing the actors attitude and fame, he dreams on to be an actor and this desire is even more flamed when he gets a small role in the ad shoot.

episodesList.title: The Key To Going To Mumbai
episodesList.summary: As the dream of going to Mumbai lives on, Anand is strictly against it and is not ready to listen to Naina or Sameer. And Sameer and Naina both know that if they crack through Anand, even Naina's father will crack. What will happen?

episodesList.title: The Mind Opening Taunts
episodesList.summary: After Sameer and Naina decide to go to mumbai, they are visited by their uncle and he taunts them a lot commenting on the difference between hero and zero. Will it affect Sameer?

episodesList.title: Planning Is On
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer are upheld on their plan of going to Mumbai and fulfilling Sameer's dream of becoming an actor. Naina asks her father to accompany them to Mumbai if he wants to sure of their safety.

episodesList.title: Love Is In The Air
episodesList.summary: Naina decorates the whole house and lights it up with candles to have a good time with Sameer. Sameer tries to avoid her and throws his tantarums and then Kanji interrupts. Naina takes advantage of Sameer's tantarums and invites him insde.

episodesList.title: Sameer's House Sold
episodesList.summary: Sameer sells his house to fulfill his dream of getting a new bungalow for Naina. He even tries not to let her know about the sale of his house. And they both pack their luggage to leave for Bombay.

episodesList.title: Waves Of Happiness
episodesList.summary: In this episode, everyone gets together in the family and all are happily giving farewell to Sameer and Naina. All are busy in games and dance and happy as well.

episodesList.title: Bombay Trip
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina leave For Bombay finally by packing up their luggage. All family members bid them farewell in the railway station. Even Sameer promised Naina that he will make a better house for her than she was having.

episodesList.title: House Shifting
episodesList.summary: After reaching Bombay, Naina and Sameer get a taxi to reach their rented house but forget the key to their house. Becoming out of options, they wait for Naina's friend to arrive so that they can enter into their new house through a master key.

episodesList.title: Troublesome Situations
episodesList.summary: After reaching Preeti's house, Naina and Sameer request her mother-in-law to not to reveal that they are married. Though Preeti's mother-in-law kept on blabbering facts still gets convinced at last.

episodesList.title: First Day In Colony
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer finally shifted to their own house but her father tries disturbing them. And later Sameer goes to an office for his acting carrier as a hero.

episodesList.title: Scope For Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer on the first day in the colony and Sameer go in search of his work as he wanted to work in films. On the way, he hears many appreciations upon the film industry and feels happy.

episodesList.title: Unnecessary Troubles
episodesList.summary: Preeti's Mother-in-law creates troubles for Sameer and Naina and gives unnecessary advice to get them settled with less money. And later Sameer and Naina go out to meet a producer for him.

episodesList.title: Meeting The Producer
episodesList.summary: Sameer, Naina and Naina's father all reach the office of the producer, who after a long wait, agrees to meet them. After seeing Sameer's portfolio, he doesn't give away any expression and walks away.

episodesList.title: Society Problems
episodesList.summary: After their lie uncovers in front of the society panel, they decide to not let them live in the society and ask them to leave. But Naina, with the help of Preeti, solves that problem. But the problems don't end there.

episodesList.title: Sameer romances Naina
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina convince Naina's father upon their opinion. Naina imagines her father as Dharmendra and dreams of a movie project for Sameer and romance together at night.

episodesList.title: Missing Naina
episodesList.summary: After Naina goes missing from a local train station, Sameer and Naina's father panic as to where she went. Their neighbour offers to help and they are more than grateful for it. Will they find Naina in time?

episodesList.title: Colony's Troubles
episodesList.summary: Naina's father gets himself into some other's house mistakenly and gets blamed as characterless. Naina and Sameer reach in the venue and handle the situation as the colony member were about to call the police.

episodesList.title: Allegations
episodesList.summary: All people of the colony are very irritated with the abnormal behavior of Naina's father and try to maintain distance from him. But this makes him feel more inferior and mentally ill.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Interview
episodesList.summary: Sameer finally reaches to a director's office for an interview where he gets rejected due to his dancing skills. He returns from there and goes to Naina to let her know about his grief.

episodesList.title: First Anniversary
episodesList.summary: Naina's father allows Sameer and Naina to celebrate their first anniversary by going out. Sameer surprises her with chocolates but mistakenly are liquor chocolates.

episodesList.title: Acting Classes
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina are in a fix, where they ask Naina's father for forty thousands rupees so that Sameer can join the acting classes and she defends her point by mentioning that by learning acting, he shall find work more easily.

episodesList.title: Shivani Likes Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina plans to sort everything out with the society members during the christmas party but Nirmala calls them and tells them that they shouldn't risk it by going to the party. Sameer comes up with a plan and takes help from Shibani.

episodesList.title: The Christmas Party
episodesList.summary: As the Christmas party begins, Sameer and Naina are ready to execute their plan and Naina's father advises them to be careful with their secrets.

episodesList.title: Society Function
episodesList.summary: A function takes place in the society of Sameer and Naina and Sameer sings a song there for a game which Naina wins. Later Naina gets familiar with every other neighbor and even convince her friend's sister in law.

episodesList.title: Naina And Sameer Caught
episodesList.summary: Vaneeta stops the dinner and asks Rakesh about Sameer and Naina, not getting an answer about it they start looking for them, and finally find them in a corner.

episodesList.title: Rakesh And Sameer's Memorable Time Together
episodesList.summary: Rakesh and Sameer leave for the acting classes, and while doing so, Rakesh asks Sameer to handover the cheque of the acting fees to him and Sameer replies by saying that he doesn't have it and there starts an argument.

episodesList.title: Acting Classes
episodesList.summary: Sameer finally after joining the acting classes, goes classes regularly with Naina's father. In today's episode, Sameer talks to one of his mates for which he gets scolded by his father in law.

episodesList.title: Sameer And Aditya's Friendship
episodesList.summary: Sameer meets at the tea stall in fine morning and Aditya offers him chili items and he starts eating the same without his consent. Later Naina's father gets worried about Sameer as he went to acting classes alone.

episodesList.title: Frustated Rakesh
episodesList.summary: After the act put up by Sameer, Rakesh is deeply hurt by it and slaps Sameer. Naina and Sameer apologise but he isn't ready to budge and decides to leave the house and go back.

episodesList.title: Sameer's Plan
episodesList.summary: Naina's father breaks his leg and their house's roof has leakage which is to be made right within a month and hence the society secretary decides to send Naina and her father back to Ahmedabad. Sameer suddenly picks up some plan to tackle the situation.

episodesList.title: Sameer In Trouble
episodesList.summary: After getting shifted to Naina's friend's house, Sameer gets into trouble as he misbehaves the mother in law of Naina's friend while in sleep. Later he apologizes to her and tries to escalate the matter but the matter gets into control later.

episodesList.title: What Is Acting?
episodesList.summary: Sameer in his acting classes requests his teacher that before he starts acting, he would like to eat something. Then, his teacher explains to all what is the true meaning of acting.

episodesList.title: Method Acting
episodesList.summary: Sameer has no more doubts regarding his method acting as he feels more comfortable around Aditya as his acting companion. Also, Naina has some good news to share.

episodesList.title: Samaina Are Having A Baby
episodesList.summary: Naina tries to talk with Sameer but he ignores her. Sameer finds Naina crying at home. Naina tells Sameer that she is pregnant. When Naina and Sameer give this news to Naina's father he gets excited. Preeti buys a pager as a gift for Naina without telling her mother-in-law or husband.

episodesList.title: Separation
episodesList.summary: In today's episode of Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai, Sameer, and Naina are staying away from each other and try talking to each other in sign language through the window at night.

episodesList.title: Naina And Kitty Party
episodesList.summary: Now that Naina is expecting and Rakesh and Sameer both know about it, they are being extra cautious to take care of Naina. Meanwhile Naina gets an invitation to attend a kitty party. Will she go?

episodesList.title: Naina In Trouble
episodesList.summary: Preeti and Naina are going through Naina's wedding album and Vanita and gang comes out of nowhere and they start asking about Naina's husband which turns out to be another lie.

episodesList.title: Complete Mess
episodesList.summary: In today's episode of Yeh Un Dinon Ki Baat Hai, all the society members interrogate Naina if she is fine as she had vomited in the function last night. All of a sudden, the person with the test reports arrives and Naina faints.

episodesList.title: Aamir's Arrival
episodesList.summary: One of the society members gets a person named Aamir who is Naina's husband according to them but actually he is not. When he arrives in the society everybody thrashes him for leaving Naina alone.

episodesList.title: Revealing The Truth
episodesList.summary: After the arrival of Raghav, a new problem arises about revealing the truth. Raghav requests Naina, her father and Sameer to continue the same lie as it is at least till he gets his offer for the job. Without any way left, they decide to continue.

episodesList.title: Holi Festival
episodesList.summary: In today's episode, everybody is celebrating the festival of colors Holi. Preeti kicks off the festival by putting colors on her husband even after his constant denial. All the people of the society are playing Holi together.

episodesList.title: Shibani Expresses Her Love
episodesList.summary: After party effects have not gone according to the plans, Shibani expresses her love for Sameer in front of everyone and post that, Sameer starts speaking which shuts everyone up.

episodesList.title: First Paycheck
episodesList.summary: After Naina and Sameer receive the first paycheck of their stay in Mumbai, they buy happiness after setting up their house but Preeti's mother-in-law comes to taunt them at a bad time. Naina and Rakesh both look for a job.

episodesList.title: Naina Gets A Job Finally
episodesList.summary: Sameer gets the appointment letter of Naina and asks about the same to her and she tells the truth that she is going to join the job as she was getting bored at home. Sameer worries about her to work in such a big city. What will Sameer do?

episodesList.title: Sameer Worries For Naina
episodesList.summary: While Naina is on her way to the office, she asks Sameer about where he is off to, to which he replies that he will go and drop her to the office. Naina's day at office isn't going that great.

episodesList.title: Convincing Gadkari
episodesList.summary: Rakesh is trying his level best to convince Mr. Gadkari to accept Aditya and his acting, but whatever they are trying doesn't seem to work. Rakesh finally chooses a move to share a story with Mr. Gadkari.

episodesList.title: Naina Feels Cheated
episodesList.summary: After Gadkari and Aditya have solved their differences, Naina as she tries to enter her boss' cabin, she overhears him narrating the story she suggested and feels cheated.

episodesList.title: Bakshi Makes Fun Of Sameer
episodesList.summary: Bakshi makes fun of Sameer's audition and tells Naina not to ever double-cross him. Naina gets a surprise when Sameer and her father throw a party for her. When Sameer asks her about his audition she hesitates to tell him what happened in the office.

episodesList.title: Sameer Defends Naina
episodesList.summary: Naina's father is upset because Naina left her job without thinking anything. Sameer tries to defend Naina. Naina tells her father that Bakshi wouldn't have let her succeed in anything so she wanted to try doing something on her own.

episodesList.title: Pandit's Marriage
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer decide that they will comply with the marriage of Pandit as he had helped him during his marriage. Later along with Pandit, they go to see the would-be bride and see what happens next.

episodesList.title: Meeting With Aruna Irani
episodesList.summary: Naina and Sameer get excited as they are about to meet Aruna Irani to recite the story. Naina calls her to confirm the appointment and she confirms the same as well. On the other side, everyone is happy about the marriage of Pandit.

episodesList.title: Naina Is Nervous
episodesList.summary: Naina is tense because she is meeting Aruna Irani for the first time, she keeps forgetting her story because of nervousness. Sameer tries to cheer her up. Shubham is upset because Pandit leaves without telling anyone.

episodesList.title: Aditya Loves Tanvi
episodesList.summary: Tanvi's mother frustratedly blames Sammer, Naina and their family for Tanvi's marriage that broke up. Sameer later comes to know that Aditya and Tanvi love each other.

episodesList.title: Trouble In Storytelling
episodesList.summary: Naina gets a little trouble while narrating the story in front of Aruna Irani but somehow manages to get to the point. On the other hand, Sameer makes the marriage of Aditya complete. Where will they turn next?

episodesList.title: Another Rejection For Sameer
episodesList.summary: After Naina's script passes the test, it's time for Sameer to audition for the lead of the show. Aruna calls Sameer and she rejects him for the role, which actually shocks Naina and she is angry.

episodesList.title: Angry Naina
episodesList.summary: Naina angrily arrives with her bags packed and asks her father to pack bags as well. She decides to return Ahmedabad along with her father. And in that time, Sameer arrives and tries convincing Naina to not to leave him alone.

episodesList.title: Naina Knows The Truth
episodesList.summary: Naina happens to see the marriage certificate of Aditya and Tanvi. Sameer tells her the truth about it. Naina is disappointed and explains Sameer that he should have told her before. Now, the issue can be serious.

episodesList.title: Naina Is Worried
episodesList.summary: Aruna calls up Naina and tells her that she wants to watch the first episode of their TV serial with her. She also tells her to bring Sameer. Hearing this Naina gets tense because she has already promised her neighbors that she will watch the first episode with them. What will Naina and Sameer do now?

episodesList.title: Get Together For The Show
episodesList.summary: All the society members, Aruna, Sameer and Naina are gathered in the common room where they plan to watch their first episode on the TV together.

episodesList.title: Tanvi And Aditya's Secret Is Out
episodesList.summary: After Tanvi's mother gets hold of the court marriage letter, she goes to the house, slaps Tanvi and creates a ruckus out of the topic and it's fuss all over in the society.

episodesList.title: Aditya's Ultimate Test
episodesList.summary: Aditya tries to consolidate his mother-in-law and begs for his forgiveness. Meanwhile, Tanvi makes up with her in-laws. But little did Aditya know, what he has to go through in order to gain back the trust of his mother-in-law.

episodesList.title: The Family Gets Together
episodesList.summary: Tanvi's mother finally accepts Tanvi and Aditya's marriage. Naina voiceover's the story about how dramatic love stories used to be in those days. The family gets together for a small gathering.

episodesList.title: Naina Consolidates Her Father
episodesList.summary: Naina's father is furious to know that Preeti's mother-in-law is forbidding him to meet her daughter. Naina's tries to consolidate her father and asks him to be patient so that he doesn't cause any issues in Preeti's relation with her in-laws. But her father is not ready to listen to anyone.

episodesList.title: It's Celebration Time
episodesList.summary: Naina shares the news of her being pregnant. Everyone comes to her house and celebrates the cause. But Sameer can see that Naina is missing her sister so he deliberately decides to call her up and hands over the phone to Naina. Naina shares her thoughts with her sister and regrets the fact that she is not able to join them.

episodesList.title: Naina Learns Her Sister's Risk
episodesList.summary: Everyone is happy and celebrating the news of Naina's pregnancy. Her sister also comes and joins them on this auspicious occasion. Naina asks her sister that how could she come and learns that her sister lied at her house to be with Naina.

episodesList.title: Future Or Family Dilemma
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Vinita seal the deal for his new house. He has the money ready but then Pandit calls him and tells him about the business loss that Mamaji had. Mamaji is drowning in debt. What will Sameer do?

episodesList.title: Relations Before Money
episodesList.summary: Sameer gets the support of Naina on the decision that they should help Mamaji with the money. This is something that they are doing with a big sacrifice in their future.

episodesList.title: Relationship Gets Stronger
episodesList.summary: Naina has a minor stomach ache and Sameer gets very tensed. They are expecting the baby in another two weeks. Sameer and Naina have their relationship strengthened. They remind what they mean to one another.

episodesList.title: The Baby Is Born
episodesList.summary: Some trouble happens just before Naina's water broke. Things are sorted out but then she isn't in a condition to go to the hospital. They call the doctor home and thankfully everything is fine.

episodesList.title: It's A Happy World For Naina And Sameer
episodesList.summary: Naina's father can't keep his hands off his newborn grandchild. Everyone is so happy to see the smile on his face. It's time for the evening's function and everyone shows up to greet the baby. The atmosphere is joyous and celebrations are happening. The time has come for the Name Ceremony.

episodesList.title: They Need A Goodnight Sleep
episodesList.summary: Suman wakes up crying and Sameer and Naina are unable to calm her. Naina's father also comes in. The family sings together to make the baby sleep. The next day, Preeti finds her father and Sameer sleeping while Naina was doing the chores alone with the baby in her arms.

episodesList.title: A Surprise For Naina
episodesList.summary: Sameer and Naina are with the baby. Sameer is overprotective about the child. They also want to go back to Ahmedabad to visit their old house. Naina has a surprise waiting for her. Sameer tells her that he has bought their old house and they own it.

episodesList.title: The Entire Family Get-together
episodesList.summary: Everyone comes together in the new house that Sameer and Naina has. Everyone forgives and reconciles their relationships with one another. They play a game of truth and have a lot of fun.

episodesList.title: The Reunion
episodesList.summary: Naina, Sameer, Munna, Pandit, and the gang go to their childhood school for the reunion. They reminisce about their school days and enjoy their time. Lochan sir also recites a poem and they all play part in the stage function.

plotHtml:
Set in 1990 in Ahmedabad, Naina Agarwal is a 16-year-old girl. Her mother died when she was young and she grows up neglected in a conservative family. Naina's father, Rakesh Agarwal, has an orthodox mindset, supporting only his son Arjun's dreams, and neglecting Naina. Meanwhile, Sameer Maheshwari studies at a boarding school in Nainital, but gets suspended and returns to his maternal grandfather, Jaiprakash Maheshwari, in Ahmedabad. His mother, Vishakha, comes to Ahmedabad to get him back to Delhi but Jaiprakash refuses to let Sameer go, believing Ahmedabad would help him. Sameer has a very bitter relationship with his mother due to her remarriage. Sameer joins Naina's school.
Sameer clashes with Naina after her honesty had got him into trouble. While Naina grows fond of Sameer, Sameer resents her. Sameer was the cool and popular kid liked by every single girl in his class.
A series of misunderstandings, one involving leaked question papers, further damage their relationship.
Sameer decides to take revenge on Naina after Rakesh publicly humiliates him. He bets with the seniors about making Naina say "I Love You" to him.
As they grow closer, Naina and her friend Swati begin testing Sameer's sincerity.
They grow closer in mount abu and sameer starts to ennjoy nainas simplicity and her ability to understand and uplift him. Filled with immmense guilt he tries confessiong about the bet but fails. naina finds out on her own after saying i love you and is left absolutely devasted and decides to distance herself and only focus on her studies and family however the betrayal leaves her wounded sameeer realises his feelings for naina and works as a helper listening to taunts all day in her sisters wedding, munna pandit stay with him to support sameer in his redemption arc. He gets insulted on a daily basis by her family and is falsely accused of being the reason behind arjuns leg injury which he was faking but he stays composed to show naina he is genuine this time and wants her to accept his apology. Preeti upon finding out also tries convincing naina along w shefali. Towards the end of the wedding they both secretly share a campa cola drink which implies that naina has forgiven him while simultaneously also accepting his love. Sameers grandfather Jaiprakash had already approved of their secret love but doesnt stay long enough in the world to support them in the future.
After Jaiprakash's demise,Sameer stops eating and feels extremely lonley. Sameer moves to Delhi without informing Naina. He reconciles with Vishaka and bonds with his stepsiblings. The couple finds their way back to eachother and continues their long-distance relationship through a telephone with the help of sameers new friend Amrita. Naina helps sameer become a better person with her pure love and support but sameer falls into a wrong group of people and starts ruining his life with inappropraite magazines and alcohol breaking his promise to naina, his step grandmother despises him and makes his stay harder. After snapping out he actually starts to improve but his step grandmother fills cruel things into his head about himself. Sameer starts considering himself unlucky for his loved ones due to guilt and emotional struggles. He tries to disconnect from Naina, but Vishaka sends him back to Ahmedabad after noticing his condition.
Naina enrolls in VJN College and makes Sameer realize that his assumptions are wrong. Sameer and Naina rekindle their relationship in college but Naina breaks off their relationship after Arjuns affair gets caught. Nainas dad threatens to kill himself and Arjun unable to gather courage and accept the affair ruins shefalis name in the colony. Naina realises that their relationship would require a lot of courage and sacrifice but tells sameer that she doesnt want him to hate her and smile when he thinks back to his first love. After Naina agrees to her marriage with another guy Sameer feels that Naina never reciprocated her feelings for him and left him like a coward even though she previously promised him different things, in order to cope with the heartbreak he starts to date Sunaina and also tries to stir jealousy in Naina. However, after Nainas uncle finds out that they guy chosen for Naina is abusive and she already had someone she loves deeply he approves of her relationship and the couple eventuslly starts to date once again. Around the same time they get caught by the Agarwal's. Nainas family slaps her and attempts to marry her off forcefully. Sameer and Naina elope briefly with the help if Preeti and their friends- Swati, Hema, Kamya, Munna, Pandit. Later, Sameer and Naina's marriage is fixed. Sameers family disapproves their marriage because they disliked Nainas look and her middle class background however, sameer fights everyone disapproving and keeps constant respect for Nainas family which makes his parents think that Naina isnt the right fit for him.The Agarwal family remains divided over the marriage, but the couple marries with the help of friends and the remaining family. Sameer and Naina start living in a separate bungalow. Their marriage faces challenges due to differences in lifestyle and mindset. Sameer is removed from the family business, sells the bungalow and moves to Mumbai to explore new career opportunities. Naina takes up writing and their serial becomes a success.
Naina gives birth to their daughter, Suman. Sameer buys back his old bungalow in Ahmedabad. They return to Ahmedabad and reconcile with their family members. Naina, Sameer, and their friends reunite. The story concludes happily in 1998, with Naina and Sameer succeeding in their careers and life.

title: Yaaradi Nee Mohini
summary: Yaaradi Nee Mohini (transl. Who Are You, Ghost) is an Indian Tamil language Supernatural thriller soap opera starring Shreekumar, Nachathira, and Chaitra Reddy. It aired from 24 April 2017 on Zee Tamil and ended on 22 August 2021 by crossing 1200 episodes. The show claimed to be the second-highest budgeted series on South Indian television. and it is the second longest ran serial of Zee Tamil after Sembaruthi.
plot:
Mutharasan is the grandson of a rich landlord. After his mother dies, his father Thanikachalam marries Neelambari. Mutharasan trusts and respects Neelambari not knowing that she is plotting to kill him. Meanwhile, his cousin Vennila loves him and wants to marry him. Neelambari secretly plots against him to acquire his father's property for her children; however, a clause in the will forbids her, as it says Mutharasan's wife must sign. Neelambari brings her niece Swetha to marry Muthu and supports her. Meanwhile, the ghost of Chitra (Mutharasan's dead wife) is out to spoil Neelambari's evil designs. After a few days, Neelambari and her gang find it is the spirit of Chitra who spoils their plan.
Swetha plans to marry Mutharasan by hook or by crook. She murders Vennila's mother and grandmother, after which she gets engaged to Mutharasan. Swetha's ex-husband Yuvaraj comes to stop the marriage. Swetha discovers this and plans to kill Mutharasan's father. Now Vennila, becomes too lonely as everyone who supported her is dead.
Here comes a clever character Kalai, wife of Maruthu (Neelambari's first son) who finds the power of Chitra and stands along with Vennila. Maruthu later causes an accident to kill Kalai but she slips into a coma. Chitra's mother appears to reveal the truth to Mutharasan but later gets killed by Neelambari. Later, Mutharasan takes a liking to Ruthra and adopts her. Mutharasan does not know that Ruthra is his daughter and mistakenly believes she is an orphan, though Ruthra knows it from her grandmother, Sumangali. Swetha plans to separate Ruthra and Vennila from Mutharasan. In a series of events, Mutharasan identifies the true caring nature of Vennila and how people in the house are taking advantage of her and stand beside her in all her problems.
A priest informs Mutharasan that he has a biological child born by Chitra before her death. In an attempt to know his child, he climbs the "Siddhar Malai" and gets to know that Ruthra is his daughter. When he returns, Ruthra is abducted by a family who claim that Ruthra is the daughter of Pasupathi and Chitra. Mutharasan doesn't believe this, but is attacked by them and hospitalised. In a series of events, the members who claimed Ruthra are killed by divine interventions and forces. Eventually, Vennila brings a herb from "Siddhar Malai" and cures Mutharasan's ailment. The story now moves ahead to unveil how Mutharasan finds out the true colors of his family. Neelambari fixed Mutharasan marriage with Swetha but Mutharasan married Vennila with all revenges and problems aired by Swetha and Swetha is admitted to the hospital for treatment. Now she is cured and returns to take revenge against Vennila again.

articleSections.title: Launching
articleSections.text:
A first look for the series was officially released on 4 February 2017, together with the first look for Poove Poochudava. Cast members from both shows were interviewed on Puthandu 14 April 2017 on the Chithirai Puthandu special programs hosted by Deepak Dinkar and Archana Chandhoke.
This horror-based love story was initially produced by V. Shankar Raman for K Studios. S. Sabreesh Kumar under Monk Studios took over the series in 2017 and continued producing the show till the series' end in 2021.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Popular Tamil TV actor Sanjeev was selected to portray the lead role as Mutharasan. In May he left the show because of an inconvenience of his role. Shreekumar replaced him in the role of Mutharasan from episode 271. Malayalam actress Nachathira made her TV acting debut with the series by playing Vennila. Chaitra was selected to portray the second leading role and main antagonist as Swetha. Fathima Babu joined the series as the main antagonist Neelambari and Yamuna Chinnadurai was selected to play Mutharasan's first wife who becomes a ghost. Besides Minnal Deepa, Barath, Aravindh Khathare, Vinitha and Surjith Ansary were added to the cast. The series features many new cast entries.

articleSections.title: Broadcast history
articleSections.text: In Zee Tamil series history, Yaaradi Nee Mohini is the first series to contain over a thousand episodes. Programming head Siju Prabhakaran, creator Tamil Daasan, producer Sabareesh Kumar, director Priyan and the entire team celebrated the special occasion.

articleSections.title: Ratings
articleSections.text: It became the most watched Tamil television programme in the years 2017 and 2018 with the highest ratings of 12.46 million impressions at 8:30PM slot.

articleSections.title: Special and crossover episodes
articleSections.text: On 17 November 2019, Yaaradi Nee Mohini held a marriage function called Yaaradi Nee Mohini Kalyanam for one hour. * Yaaradi Nee Mohini's cast and crew joined Maha Sangamam with the series "Gokulathil Seethai" from 3 August 2020 to 16 August 2020. * On 22 January 2021, Yaaradi Nee Mohini held a three-hour Mega Episode focusing on Swetha's pregnancy.

title: Yaqeen Ka Safar
summary:
Yaqeen Ka Safar (Urdu: یقین کا سفر, lit. 'The Journey of Trust') is a Pakistani television drama series produced by Momina Duraid through MD Productions for Hum TV. It was written by Farhat Ishtiaq, based on Ishtiaq's novel Woh Yakeen Ka Naya Safar and was directed by Shahzad Kashmiri. It aired from 19 April 2017 to 1 November 2017 for a total of 29 episodes.
Yaqeen Ka Safar tells the story of Asfand and Zubiya, who grow after facing hardships and struggles. It was written and produced by the creators of Humsafar, Mata-e-Jaan Hai Tu, Diyar-e-Dil, Udaari and Bin Roye. Its ensemble cast consists of Ahad Raza Mir as Dr Asfandyar, Sajal Ali as Dr Zubiya, Shaz Khan as Daniyal, Hira Mani as Gaiti and Suhaee Abro as Noorie in leading roles. It aired simultaneously in Pakistan, the UK, the US, Australia, New Zealand, Ireland, and the UAE on the same date and time. The first half of the show was set in Karachi and later in Neelum Valley.
Yaqeen Ka Safar was one of the highest-ranked dramas in Pakistan in 2017.
plot:
Yaqeen Ka Safar starts with three stories.
Zubia Khalil is a young girl mourning her mother's sudden death at the hands of her physically violent father. Zubia needed to visit a friend's house to borrow important lecture notes and she insisted that her mother accompany her, despite her father forbidding her mother to leave the house alone. When Khalil, father of zubia discovered Zubia's mother disobeyed him, he slapped her so hard she fell and ended up hitting the corner of the bed, dying on the spot. Zubia's aunt, Mahjabeen Khala consoles the devastated; Zubia tells her the truth. But Khalil threatens her and the whole family to stay silent regarding the cause of the mother's death.
The second story involves a family in Islamabad celebrating their son Daniyal's wedding to Gaiti Ara. Daniyal is a young lawyer who has recently graduated from London and is extremely fearless, confident, brave and honest. Asfandyar is Daniyal's younger brother, who will soon leave for Karachi to complete his medical studies after his brother's wedding. Daniyal is a lively person and quite ambitious as well. The family maintains a significant reputation in the community as Usman, Daniyal and Asfandyar's father, is a successful lawyer, too. Asfandyar is engaged to Faryal.
The third storyline involves Noori, a young girl living in a rural village of Sindh (Rab Nawaz.) who is gang-raped by a minister's son, Jahangir Shah, along with two of his friends. The police inquire about the incident and ask her quite inappropriate questions. Noori's younger brother stands up for her, but her parents remain silent because of their poverty. The police threaten Noori's father. Their family is insulted in the village, so Noori leaves her home. She is then found by and taken to Karachi by Rumana, an NGO lady in Karachi. Rumana informs Daniyal about the Noori gang rape incident.
reception: The serial received critical praise, especially for the storyline, cinematography and performances of the star cast. While praising the refreshing storyline without much romantic angle and multiple themes of the series, The Express Tribune wrote, "Yaqeen Ka Safar is honest and original, and has changed the paradigm of Pakistani dramas." While reviewing positively, Buraq Shabbir of The News International said it was more realistic than other serials aired at that time stating, "It views people as professionals while tapping into their personal lives as well, making it more relatable". DAWN Images praised Mir's complex and nuanced portrayal of Dr. Asfandyar.

articleSections.title: Development
articleSections.text:
Hum TV's senior producer Momina Duraid of MD Productions, developed Yakeen Ka Safar. The channel hired the director Shahzad Kashmiri who previously directed Roye for the same channel. Along with Kashmiri, they finalised Mirza Zeeshan Baig as the art director. It was Baig's return to Hum Television after he directed Diyar-e-Dil, Mann Mayal, Sanam, Dil Banjaara and Alif Allah Aur Insaan for the same channel. Tameen Nazami and Safdar Hussain Rind were the cinematographers. The serial is based on award-winning writer Farhat Ishtiaq's novel Woh Yakeen Ka Ek Naya Safar. Ishtiaq also wrote the screenplay, while Muhammad Wasi-ul-Din composed the script, who has previously worked with her with the channel's series Diyar-e-Dil and Bin Roye. Ishtiaq has previously worked with Duraid, where she wrote mega-hit drama serials in Pakistan television history, Humsafar, Mata-e-Jaan Hai Tu, Diyar-e-Dil. Bin Roye and Udaari. Waqar Ali and Suhail Haider composed the song, while MAD Music gave the background score. Hadiqa Kiani and Richa Sharma performed the OST. Yaqeen Ka Safar is the second collaboration of writer and director after 2015's hit film Bin Roye. The show aired a weekly episode for 35–40 minutes (minus commercials) every Wednesday.
There were several discussions regarding its time slot. It was announced that the show would premiere on 12 April 2017, airing an episode on Friday's replacing Dil Banjaara. However, since Dil-e-Jaanam bought lower ratings to channel's Wednesday slot, Yakeen Ka Safar was shifted to Wednesdays and was delayed till 15 April 2017 due to promotional reasons.

articleSections.title: Casting
articleSections.text: Sajal Ali, Ahad Raza Mir, Shaz Khan and Hira Salman were selected to portray the leading roles of Zubiya, Asfandyar, Daniyal and Gaeti. Aly made her television comeback two years after her 2015 TV series Gul-e-Rana. After completing her Bollywood debut, Mom, Sajal portrayed Dr. Zubiya and signed O Rangreza for the same channel. Mir, who made his television debut in Sammi, was finalised after his success in portraying the role of Salar in Sammi. The actor received critical acclaim and appraisal for his role as Dr Asfandyar. Film actor Shaz Khan was finalised to portray the role of Daniyal during his filming session in the channel's upcoming film Parwaaz Hay Junoon. While Salman returned to the network after her 2015 TV serial Preet Na Kariyo Koi, portraying the role of Gaeti, Salman joined filming after completing her ARY project Sun Yaara, alongside Salman her husband Mani was also cast where he portrayed the role of Dr. Haroon. The production house also chose actors Farhan Ali Agha, Mohammed Ehteshamuddin, and Maryam Nafees to play the roles of Usman, Noori, Khalil and Khajista.

articleSections.title: Release
articleSections.text: Yakeen Ka Safar premiered on 19 April 2017 and aired weekly, with a new episode being broadcast every Wednesday at 8:00 pm. The show aired on Hum Europe in the UK, Hum TV USA in the US and Hum TV Mena in the UAE, with the same times and premiere date. It was broadcast by Hum Network's new channel Hum World HD for the US and Canada. It was rebroadcast on Hum TV in Pakistan, premiering on 8 October 2018 at the 10 pm slot. In 2019, it also aired on the national channel PTV Home started in August 2019, airing two episodes (Friday and Saturday) every week. A dubbed version is currently airing on Hum Pashto 1 in Pashto under the title دباور سفر.

articleSections.title: Home media and digital release
articleSections.text: Yakeen Ka Safar was also released on Hum TV's YouTube channel alongside its airing, but later the channel deleted all its episodes. It was also released on the iflix as a part of the channel's contract. When the contract was terminated in 2019, all its episodes were removed and thus could not be streamed digitally anymore. Later Yakeen Ka Safar was also released on OTT, the platform MX Player. In July 2019, the channel re-uploaded all episodes on YouTube. A few episodes are also available on Amazon Prime Video.

articleSections.title: Reception
articleSections.text: The serial received critical praise, especially for the storyline, cinematography and performances of the star cast. While praising the refreshing storyline without much romantic angle and multiple themes of the series, The Express Tribune wrote, "Yaqeen Ka Safar is honest and original, and has changed the paradigm of Pakistani dramas." While reviewing positively, Buraq Shabbir of The News International said it was more realistic than other serials aired at that time stating, "It views people as professionals while tapping into their personal lives as well, making it more relatable". DAWN Images praised Mir's complex and nuanced portrayal of Dr. Asfandyar.

plotHtml:
Yaqeen Ka Safar starts with three stories.
Zubia Khalil is a young girl mourning her mother's sudden death at the hands of her physically violent father. Zubia needed to visit a friend's house to borrow important lecture notes and she insisted that her mother accompany her, despite her father forbidding her mother to leave the house alone. When Khalil, father of zubia discovered Zubia's mother disobeyed him, he slapped her so hard she fell and ended up hitting the corner of the bed, dying on the spot. Zubia's aunt, Mahjabeen Khala consoles the devastated; Zubia tells her the truth. But Khalil threatens her and the whole family to stay silent regarding the cause of the mother's death.
The second story involves a family in Islamabad celebrating their son Daniyal's wedding to Gaiti Ara. Daniyal is a young lawyer who has recently graduated from London and is extremely fearless, confident, brave and honest. Asfandyar is Daniyal's younger brother, who will soon leave for Karachi to complete his medical studies after his brother's wedding. Daniyal is a lively person and quite ambitious as well. The family maintains a significant reputation in the community as Usman, Daniyal and Asfandyar's father, is a successful lawyer, too. Asfandyar is engaged to Faryal.
The third storyline involves Noori, a young girl living in a rural village of Sindh (Rab Nawaz.) who is gang-raped by a minister's son, Jahangir Shah, along with two of his friends. The police inquire about the incident and ask her quite inappropriate questions. Noori's younger brother stands up for her, but her parents remain silent because of their poverty. The police threaten Noori's father. Their family is insulted in the village, so Noori leaves her home. She is then found by and taken to Karachi by Rumana, an NGO lady in Karachi. Rumana informs Daniyal about the Noori gang rape incident.
